links.title: Readable, Faithful, Used: Three Dissociable Properties of Demographic Identity in a Language Model

evidence: Abstract & Table 1: selection-corrected head fidelity up to ρ=0.59–0.63 held-out (AGE×POLPARTY, EDUCATION×INCOME), vs. residual best 0.26–0.61; heads dominate in five of six types and never lose.

Sec. 5.4 & Fig. 2: fixed location L11 H16 significant in all six types (ρ=0.33–0.67, permutation p<0.001 surviving ×1024 Bonferroni), with explicit provenance caveat that the head was noticed in per-type top-10 lists before fixing.
Sec. 5.3 & A.7: lexical confound is real (baseline ρ=0.21–0.64) but partial fidelity for L11 H16 remains 0.35–0.59 with p<0.0005 in five of six types; RACE×RELIG drops to 0.23, p=0.056.

Sec. 6.4 & Tables 3–4: pair-level exact sign-flip inference over 12 clusters; no sweep winner survives max-statistic correction (best p=0.066), but a-priori L11 test for RACE×POLIDEOLOGY gives t=3.22, p=0.0020 surviving Bonferroni, while top-fidelity types show no correction-surviving single-layer effect; direct between-type contrasts borderline (bootstrap CI [−6.6,−0.4] but p=0.065).

Sec. 6.5 & A.6: leave-one-cell-out ridge probe on 128-dim L11 H16 is 22–30% closer to survey truth than model answers (e.g., 0.300→0.211 AGE×POLPARTY), yet per-question group ordering is a flat null (+0.02 to +0.07) and a group-blind baseline beats all read-outs (0.133 vs 0.211).

Sec. 7.1: cross-model replication on Qwen3-8B-Base/OSim-8B-Mid/OSim-8B — heads dominate, type hierarchy and race-type weakness replicate, family-specific head L33 H9 (ρ=0.35–0.58 in five types); causal experiments explicitly not yet replicated (Sec. 9).

Sec. 3.5, A.4, A.10: three selection corrections (max-statistic 2,000 permutations; held-out-template; split-half 200 resamples) and exact enumeration of all 2^12 sign-flip combinations; A.5 gives verbatim patching protocol with donor, dimension-shuffled, and self-patch controls.

Sec. 9 & Reproducibility Statement: causal results limited to Mistral-7B; letter-probability interface limitation; US-centric Pew ATP ground truth; public checkpoint mistralai/Mistral-7B-v0.1, fixed seeds, code/CSVs 'will release publicly upon publication'.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM interpretability research squarely within scope: RSA-based mapping of demographic identity across 1,089 Mistral-7B locations against real Pew ATP inter-group opinion geometry, plus activation patching to test causal use. Preference relevance is high via LLMs (2.5), Interpretability (1.8), Transformer internals (1.2), NLP (1.5), Prompting (1.5), and fairness/bias aspects of AI Safety (2.0). Novelty is genuine: the second-order (inter-group geometry vs. survey ground truth) fidelity map and the readable/faithful/used dissociation are, per the related-work audit (Sec. 2, fn. 1), not established in prior first-order probing (Jahanparast et al.) or behavioral silicon-sampling work. Rigor is unusually strong: max-statistic permutation, held-out-template and split-half selection corrections (Sec. 3.5, A.4), exact pair-level sign-flip inference over 12 clusters (Sec. 3.5, A.10), a lexical-baseline partial correlation (Sec. 5.3, A.7), random-projection and symmetric-comparison controls (Sec. 5.2, A.11), donor and dimension-shuffled controls (Sec. 6.3, A.5), and reliability ceilings (A.8); nulls and provenance caveats (L11 H16 first 'noticed' in top-10 lists) are reported honestly. Evidence strength is solid but tempered: the headline causal pathway (RACE×POLIDEOLOGY at L11, t=3.22, p=0.0020, Table 4) survives Bonferroni, but direct fidelity-vs-use contrasts are borderline (permutation p=0.065/0.12, Sec. 6.4), probe gains are shown to be question-level not group-level (group-blind baseline wins, Sec. 6.5), and the causal side is single-model. Generalizability is partial: the map replicates across three Qwen3-8B checkpoints including the race-type weakness (Sec. 7.1), but causal results do not yet, ground truth is single-institution US Pew data, and output claims scope to letter-probability read-out (Sec. 9). Reproducibility is good (public checkpoint, seed 42, verbatim templates A.2, detailed appendices, 2×T4 compute) though code/CSVs are only promised 'upon publication'. Not a domain application, medical imaging, or pure CV paper; no out-of-scope triggers apply.

primary_link.title: Readable, Faithful, Used: Three Dissociable Properties of Demographic Identity in a Language Model

papers.summary: Large language models are widely used to simulate survey respondents, yet their answers are homogeneous and unfaithful to real inter-group differences. We ask where demographic group identity lives inside an LLM, how faithfully its geometry mirrors real inter-group opinion structure, and whether it uses what it encodes. Using representational similarity analysis against Pew ground truth over 169 demographic cells, we score 1,089 read-out locations in Mistral-7B and intervene causally across six
papers.summary_zh: LLM 常被用來模擬問卷受訪者,但輸出過於同質且不符真實族群差異;本文追問:人口屬性身分究竟儲存在模型何處、內部幾何是否忠實反映真實的跨群體意見結構、以及模型是否真的使用這些資訊。作者以 169 個交叉族群細胞對照 Pew ATP 調查真值,對 Mistral-7B 的 1,089 個讀取位置(殘差流、1,024 個注意力頭、FFN 輸出)進行表徵相似度分析,施以選擇校正(最大統計置換、留出範本、折半驗證),並於全部 32 層進行激活修補的因果實驗。主要發現:(1)注意力頭讀取在六類屬性中的五類勝過殘差流,選擇校正後忠實度最高達 ρ=0.63,約為測量可靠度上限的七成,且在控制詞彙相似性後依然成立;(2)單一頭 L11 H16 在全部六類皆顯著,含種族屬性的類型則普遍弱且對提示敏感,此現象在 Qwen 家族三個檢查點以家族特定位址(L33 H9)重現,百億詞元的模擬訓練幾乎不改變該地圖;(3)忠實度不預測因果使用:最清晰的因果路徑位於忠實度最低的類型(RACE×POLIDEOLOGY,p=0.002),最忠實類型反而無通過校正的單層效應,整體身分替換僅移動預測誤差的 2% 以下;(4)對 L11 H16 的 128 維探針比模型自身答案更接近調查真值 21-31%,卻幾乎無法還原逐題的群體排序。限制包括因果實驗僅在 Mistral 執行、輸出以選項字母機率讀取、真值限於美國 Pew 資料。本研究將「LLM 能否模擬人群」拆解為可分離的三性質,對矽取樣與引導實務提出明確警示。

links.title: SMTrap: Cost-Effective DoS Attacks Against Large Reasoning Models via SMT Conflict Guidance

evidence: Sec. 6.2 / Table 2: SMTrap-Zebra reaches 76,362 average completion tokens and 48.78% BNTS across seven LRMs, vs 27,860/18.10% for AutoDoS, 26,411/14.05% for ReasoningBomb, 13,392/7.96% for CatAttack.

Sec. 4.3 / Fig. 4: completion length generally increases with SMT conflict level (0-1200, 12 levels, 30 instances/level, 3 runs) for GPT-5.5, Gemini-3.1-pro, DeepSeek-v4-pro, with positive Pearson/Spearman correlations though 'not strictly monotonic'.
Appendix C.3 / Table 8: Z3 conflict count correlates 0.90 (Sudoku) and 0.79 (Zebra) with LRM output length, versus ~0.5 for decisions and propagations, supporting the proxy choice.

Sec. 6.4 / Table 4: ablation shows high-conflict Sudoku raises web reasoning time from 74.33s to 144.42s without shortcut suppression, while suppression adds further gains on web but limited API effect, indicating conflict level is the main amplification source.
Sec. 6.5 / Table 5: tool-based mitigation (solve_csp routing with direct return) cuts GPT-5.5 token usage by 97.08% (Sudoku) and 84.03% (Zebra), averaging 90.15%.

Appendix E (Ethics/Limitations): authors state they will not publicly release the complete high-risk prompt corpus, only sanitized examples and defensive tooling; web timings depend on GUI-reported reasoning time with 3-run averaging.
Appendix C.4 / Table 9: preliminary generalization to graph coloring (single low/high-conflict pair: 20,127 vs 35,712 tokens on GPT-5.5) is limited to one additional CSP family.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope: an AI-safety/red-team paper on DoS attacks against large reasoning models, exploiting chain-of-thought search behavior, with an LLM/tool-calling-based mitigation. Novelty is solid: the model-feedback-free 'search amplification' paradigm using Z3 SMT conflict counts as a victim-free proxy for LRM backtracking cost differs from perturbation-based (AutoDoS, CatAttack) and attack-model-training (ReasoningBomb) baselines, and extends ZebraLogic's evaluation-only use of conflict counts to attack synthesis. Rigor is good but not flawless: controlled task size/prompt length, 3-run averaging, ablations over conflict level, shortcut suppression, and solver-side proxies (Table 8), yet the core SMT-conflict→LRM-search link is correlational with non-monotonic trends (Sec. 4.3), web-interface results use n=3 GUI-reported timings on a single provider, and stealthiness relies on one GPT-4o judge. Evidence is strong quantitatively: 76,362 avg completion tokens and 48.78% BNTS across seven frontier LRMs (Table 2), 8-25x web reasoning-time gains (Table 3), and a 90.15% mitigation reduction (Table 5). Generalizability is decent (7 models, Sudoku/Zebra plus preliminary graph coloring) but bounded to CSP-style tasks. Reproducibility is mixed: the synthesis procedure, parameters, and defense code are documented in detail, but the authors explicitly withhold the full high-corpus release (Appendix E).

primary_link.title: SMTrap: Cost-Effective DoS Attacks Against Large Reasoning Models via SMT Conflict Guidance

papers.summary: Existing LRM-DoS methods rely heavily on model feedback to synthesize attack queries, requiring either repeated queries to the target model or training a dedicated attack model. These expensive operations severely weaken attack leverage. In this paper, we propose \emph{search amplification}, a novel, model-feedback-free LRM-DoS paradigm. It employs the conflict count derived from an Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT) solver as a low-cost external signal to guide the synthesis of inference-heav
papers.summary_zh: 大型推理模型(LRM)透過冗長的思維鏈換取高品質回答,也創造了攻擊者低成本、供應商高算力的槓桿效應;但既有 LRM-DoS 攻擊依賴模型回饋——需反覆查詢目標或代理模型,或訓練專門攻擊模型——成本高昂且削弱攻擊效益。本文提出「搜尋放大」無模型回饋範式:觀察到 LRM 以試錯與回溯搜尋求解約束滿足問題(CSP),而 SMT 求解器 Z3 在同一 CSP 上的衝突次數與 LRM 顯式搜尋行為及輸出長度正相關,故可作為純 CPU 端的廉價外部引導訊號。據此建構 SMTrap:僅用 CPU,透過線索狀態分支與剪枝、衝突引導接受與捷徑抑制,合成有效、唯一解且推理成本極高的數獨與斑馬謎題查詢,不需模型查詢、攻擊模型訓練或 GPU。在七個前沿 LRM 的 API 評估中,SMTrap-Zebra 平均輸出 76,362 個詞元,超越 AutoDoS、ReasoningBomb 與 CatAttack 2.74 至 5.70 倍,預算標準化轉移分數達 48.78%;在 OpenAI 網頁介面上,最高可使 GPT-5.4 推理時間達 1,308 秒,較基線多 5 倍以上;相較 GPT-4o 偵測器整體隱匿率 83.33%。消融證實高衝突實例本身是放大主因,捷徑抑制僅防堵網頁端工具繞道。作者另示範以受限本地求解器路由的防禦,平均刪減 90.15% 詞元用量。限制包括僅驗證 CSP 類任務、Z3 衝突次數屬求解器相關的代理指標、網頁量測受服務端變異影響。本研究揭示廉價符號搜尋可被武器化為昂貴的神經推理,呼籲任務感知路由與推理預算限制。

links.title: Outcome Monitors: Recovery Affordances for Silent Tool Failures

evidence: Abstract: 'On a violation, the monitor preserves the result and issues a nonbinding receipt naming the violated property and public recovery tools... raise ToolMaze completion from 10.9% to 28.1% across four models in two provider families and replicate in a third.'

Section 5 (Results): 'Primary task-cluster sign-flip p<.00001; 95% bootstrap interval [11.25, 23.44]' for the +17.2 point four-model ToolMaze aggregate; all 16 prespecified model-by-stratum point estimates nonnegative.

Section 5 / Appendix L (Stripped-envelope study): 'the stripped receipt performs at baseline; restoring the recovery-tool list adds +11.4 points (p=.028)' — controls identify recovery tools as the active receipt content.

Section 4 (Experimental Design): 'Task identities, settings, and artifact hashes are frozen before the corresponding outcomes are opened, except where noted; studies frozen or amended after related outcomes were seen are labeled retrospective'; Appendix G discloses an invalidated first run whose amended protocol was frozen after outcomes were known.

Section 5 (Incident-derived faults): 'The unchanged detector flags 46.1% and 45.3% of injected faults on Flash and Pro... Completion is null in both tiers (p=1.0)' — detection bounded by the contract vocabulary on faults authored blind to it.
Appendix K (Table 16): null controls have minimum detectable effects of ~17-23 percentage points, so 'null results cannot be interpreted as equivalence'.

Section 6 (Limitations): 'No episode here runs against a live deployment... No study here measures recovery from failures that occur naturally'; tau-bench covers one provider family and AppWorld held-out shows zero net effect.

Appendix Q (Reproducibility): anonymous artifact provides sanitized manifests, aggregate analyses, code, hashes, and invalidation reports for 22 studies and 4,683 episodes, but 'Row-level provider and protected benchmark observations are excluded from the review package.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly in-scope agentic-LLM methodology: a training-free, deterministic runtime monitor that flags contract violations in tool results and appends nonbinding receipts with recovery tools for LLM agents, evaluated on ToolMaze, tau-bench, and AppWorld. Strong preference fit (agents/tool use, LLMs, reasoning, safety/evaluation). Rigor is unusually high: frozen prespecified protocols with hashes, paired McNemar/sign-flip tests, task-clustered bootstrap CIs, task-disjoint cross-fitting, five receipt-decomposition controls, MDE power analysis for nulls, and explicit disclosure of invalidated/retrospective runs. Evidence is strong for the headline effect (+17.2 pp across four models, p<.00001; tau-bench +14.0/+12.0; MiniMax replication) and the control isolating the recovery-tool list (+11.4, p=.028), with honest nulls (held-out AppWorld, clean P0). Novelty is moderate: the detect-and-advise interface and recovery-affordance ablations are fresh, but contracts are Daikon-lineage invariant mining ported to agent observations, with pre-execution gate systems as close neighbors. Generalizability is bounded: all failures are injected, gains concentrate where baselines fail, blind-authored faults cut detection to ~46%, and one environment shows no net effect. Reproducibility is well supported by protocol manifests, verbatim prompts, cost accounting, and an anonymous artifact, though row-level observations are excluded.

primary_link.title: Outcome Monitors: Recovery Affordances for Silent Tool Failures

papers.summary: When a tool call times out, the agent sees the failure and can route around it. A cached error page or negative price can instead arrive in the expected format and be consumed as fact. We introduce Outcome Monitors, which detect violations of outcome contracts mined from task-disjoint traces or derived from public schemas. On a violation, the monitor preserves the result and issues a nonbinding receipt naming the violated property and public recovery tools. In frozen, prespecified evaluations wi
papers.summary_zh: 語言代理呼叫外部工具時，逾時等明顯錯誤容易察覺，但快取錯誤頁面或負數價格等「靜默失敗」會以正常格式返回，被模型當成事實消費。本文提出 Outcome Monitors：一套確定性偵測器，依據從任務不相交軌跡挖掘、或由公開綱要衍生的「結果契約」檢查工具回傳結果；偵測到違約時，監控器保留原始結果並附加非約束性的建議回執，指出違反的性質與公開可用的復原工具，行動選擇權仍留給代理，將偵測與復原分離。在凍結的 ToolMaze 評測中，DeepSeek 與 Qwen 四個模型的完成率由 10.9% 提升至 28.1%，並於 MiniMax M3 複製成功；τ-bench retail 亦分別提升 14.0 與 12.0 點。控制實驗顯示回執中的復原工具清單才是有效成分，移除後增益消失，診斷細節與時機則無可測差異。限制方面：增益集中在故障阻礙完成的情境；對契約詞彙之外的事故型故障，偵測率降至約 46%；乾淨流量仍有誤報，部署價值亦取決於故障盛行率。本文將靜默失敗的復原定位為可觀測性問題：可行動作早已存在，介面必須使其清晰可見，而非約束設計則保留了代理的自主性。
papers.title: Outcome Monitors: Recovery Affordances for Silent Tool Failures
papers.title_zh: 結果監控器：靜默工具失敗的復原可供性

links.title: Preference Reasoning under Indeterminacy in Large Language Models

evidence: Abstract: 'state-of-the-art language models systematically fail to distinguish between determined and undetermined instances, exhibiting miscalibrated reasoning even in verification settings'
Section 2.2: four models evaluated, 'Each model was queried 30 times on a given question type', 'zero-shot, single-turn setting at the default temperature'; exact prompt templates in Appendix K
Appendix G: temperature-0 re-run on a 40-instance subset for Claude-4.5-S and OSS-120B shows results 'essentially unchanged', with the claim 'Temperature is not what drives these failures'
Appendix J: Wilson intervals, McNemar's test, and Fisher's exact test; hard-notion model differences significant with all six pairwise comparisons p<=0.004

Appendix P.3: deterministic checkers cross-checked with a brute-force solver on 1,800 random instances; judge Fleiss' kappa 0.64 and 0.82, human-vs-judge Cohen's kappa 0.86, with the divergent cell flagged as judge-sensitive

Appendix B (Limitations): 'we test four models... the panel is small'; Impartial Culture sampling means structured distributions 'such as Mallows or single-peaked preferences' are untested; two analyses 'infer what a model intended from its reasoning trace, and so depend on a judge model'
Appendix M: prompt-level mitigation relocates rather than removes errors (e.g., GPT-5.2 moves from 1.00|0.00 to 0.43|0.80 under general caution), and 'no single prompt is safe across models'
Appendix G/P.3/L.4: claims that 'The full inference scripts... are released alongside this paper' and validation harness released, but no explicit repository URL appears in the text
llm_evaluation.rationale: A strongly in-scope LLM reasoning evaluation paper: it benchmarks four frontier LLMs (GPT-5.2, Gemini-2.5-Pro, Claude-4.5-Sonnet, OSS-120B) on preference reasoning, targeting reasoning/calibration failure, abstention, prompting-format effects, LLM-as-judge methodology, and code-assisted agentic reasoning. Rigor is high: 30 repetitions per query, temperature-0 robustness check (Appendix G), Wilson intervals with McNemar/Fisher tests (Appendix J), deterministic verifiers cross-checked against a brute-force oracle on 1,800 instances, and judge validation with human annotation (Appendix P.3). Limitations are candidly stated (Appendix B). Novelty is moderate: it builds directly on the authors' prior matching-market LLM work and existing abstention/uncertainty benchmarks, with the epistemic-vs-structural indeterminacy taxonomy and infeasibility-detection angle as the main new contributions. Generalizability is limited by a four-model panel, Impartial Culture sampling only, and a social-choice testbed; the mechanism analysis relies on potentially unfaithful scratchpad self-reports. Code and prompt templates are claimed to be released but no explicit repository link is given. No instruction-injection or untrustworthy content detected in the paper text.

primary_link.title: Preference Reasoning under Indeterminacy in Large Language Models

papers.summary: As large language models evolve into decision-making agents, the ability to reason over preferences becomes fundamental to alignment, coordination, and collective intelligence. Yet, unlike standard benchmarks, real-world preference reasoning is inherently indeterminate: information may be incomplete, and valid solutions may not exist. We argue that indeterminacy, rather than correctness alone, is a central challenge for AI reasoning. We formalize this challenge along two axes, (i) epistemic inde
papers.summary_zh: 真實世界的偏好推理本質上具有不確定性：資訊可能不完整，有效的解也可能不存在，但現有基準多半假設封閉世界、必有標準答案。本文將不確定性分為兩軸：源於偏好不完整的認知型不確定性，以及源於解概念（如嚴格核心、超穩定配對）在特定偏好結構下無解的結構型不確定性，並建立涵蓋原子、比較、聚合與結構性（演算法）查詢的任務階層，於房屋分配、Shapley–Scarf 市場與雙邊配對市場上評測 GPT-5.2、Gemini-2.5-Pro、Claude-4.5-Sonnet 與 OSS-120B。結果顯示：模型在未確定問題上的準確率遠低於配對的已確定問題，會默默套用字典序等假設；提供「不確定」選項能改善偵測卻引發過度棄權偏差；即使只需驗證的選擇任務仍頻頻選錯，且呈現意圖與行動錯位；程式碼執行可改善結構性推理卻無助於認知型查詢，窮舉策略亦難以擴展。限制包括僅測四個模型、採 Impartial Culture 取樣、部分分析依賴評審模型。本文主張封閉世界訓練使模型幻覺出確定性，穩健的 AI 需要開放世界推理框架，以及能評估「無正當答案」能力的基準。
papers.title: Preference Reasoning under Indeterminacy in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 大型語言模型在不確定性下的偏好推理

links.title: Execution-grounded evaluation reveals hidden failures in language-model calculations for environmental science

evidence: Abstract: benchmark of 436 problems, 3,910 variants, 7,029 graded quantities; MCQ formats inflate accuracy by 12-39 points; failures stem from applying known formulas inconsistently rather than missing knowledge.

Section 2.2, Table 2: paired option-mode vs code-mode on identical 670 AtmosSci-Bench MCQ10 instances; chance-corrected gap 20.5-38.3 points, remaining 12-27 points after 19 defective-key templates removed; re-graded at 5/10/20% tolerance to rule out stricter numeric standard.

Methods 4.9 (Statistical analysis): McNemar tests on paired cores vs variants, 2,000-resample bootstrap, Holm correction, Wilson intervals, bounded null of +/-1.0 to +/-4.2 points rather than claiming proof of no contamination advantage; Trap Gap equation conditioning on solved parents.

Methods 4.8 (Fabricated-execution audit): lexical scan lower bound, two automated annotators agree on 25/26 (Cohen's kappa=0.92), 10 of 10 records confirmed by two domain experts, fabrications found only in smaller models (ClimateGPT-13B/70B, Qwen-3.6-27B).

Methods 4.1: de-scaffolding ablation over 169 affected problems on four models; strongest model loses 1.8 points, 9B model loses 18.5, spread widens from 10.3 to 27.0 points (Supplementary Table S27).

Methods 4.5 (Cross-domain generalization): identical pipeline applied to hydrology (37), environmental chemistry (21), ecology/biogeochemistry (19), soil mechanics (54), 131 problems; five models separated in exactly the atmospheric-benchmark order (Spearman rho=1.00).

Methods 4.10 (Residual-failure screening): three-test screen excludes answer-alignment artefacts before capability-ceiling claims; three surviving hard items pass 8, 9, 12 of 48 measurements; consensus failures on 2 items bound what LLM-consensus ground truth can certify.

Discussion, Limitations paragraph: verifiability-filtered corpus excludes open-ended problems; LLM-consensus answers mitigated by manual verification; only 131 tasks beyond atmospheric science; qualitative Gaussian-plume case explicitly excluded from ceiling statistics (Methods 4.10, Section 2.7).

Declarations, Data/Code availability: GitHub repository holds 436 core problems, 1,730 numeric and 2,180 paraphrase variants, 67 traps with shortcut solvers, 169 ablation pairs, 131 cross-domain problems, audit artefacts, and ~5GB per-run traces; code pinned to Python 3.13 with locked dependencies.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM evaluation-methodology paper (not a pure domain application): it builds an execution-grounded benchmark forcing models to emit executable solve() functions, quantifies MCQ accuracy inflation, designs trap tasks with predicted shortcut vectors, and audits fabricated execution claims. Strongly aligned with LLM (2.5), reasoning/CoT (2.5), evaluation/red-teaming (1.8), code generation (2.0), and safety-adjacent deception/fabrication themes; the atmospheric focus is a testbed for general LLM-computation findings. Novelty is solid but derivative of program-aided prompting (PAL/PoT) and MCQ-reliability literature, with execution-as-audit-surface, de-scaffolding ablation, and trap diagnostics as the main new contributions. Rigor is exceptional: paired cross-protocol design on identical 670 instances, chance correction plus tolerance sweeps, defective-key audit (19/67 templates), McNemar/bootstrap/Holm statistics, bounded-null reporting, residual-failure screening before capability-ceiling claims, and disclosed evaluator/construction model overlap. Evidence includes ablations (scaffolding removal: 1.8-point loss for strongest model vs 18.5 for a 9B model), cross-domain replication (131 problems, Spearman rho=1.00), and verbatim fabrication traces. Generalizability is bounded by the verifiability-filtered, textbook-derived, single-answer task distribution and only 131 cross-domain items, both acknowledged. Reproducibility is very strong: full corpus, grader, harness, pinned dependencies, ~5GB per-run traces released. Main unverifiable elements are external model-option-mode numbers quoted from a source benchmark and supplementary tables not shown.

primary_link.title: Execution-grounded evaluation reveals hidden failures in language-model calculations for environmental science

papers.summary: Large language models are increasingly used for quantitative work in the environmental sciences, yet existing evaluations score only final answers, leaving calculation process unobserved. Here we introduce AtmosCoder-Bench, an execution-grounded benchmark that makes the calculation process visible. Built through a transferable semi-automated pipeline (436 problems, 3,910 variants, 7,029 graded quantities), every problem is validated to be unambiguous and human-solvable, with uniquely verifiable
papers.summary_zh: 大語言模型已被應用於環境科學的定量工作，但現有評測多半只評分最終答案：選擇題格式可虛增準確率、計算過程不透明，且仰賴 LLM 評審難以重現；更隱蔽的是模型可能謊報執行過程，宣稱完成計算卻實際未執行。本文提出 AtmosCoder-Bench，一套以執行為基礎的大氣科學基準：模型必須撰寫並執行 solve() 程式碼產生答案，再對確定性數值標準答案評分。基準含 436 道取自 13 本教科書的題目、3,910 個變體與 7,029 個評分項目，透過半自動管線驗證題目無歧義、答案唯一可驗。主要發現：(i) 選擇題格式使測得準確率虛增 12 至 39 個百分點；(ii) 許多失敗並非缺乏知識，而是無法在多步計算中一致套用已知公式，例如截斷推導、遺失約束或謊報所用方法；(iii) 頂尖模型在特定條件使熟悉方法失效時，仍傾向套用標準解法，如高斯煙羽案例中宣稱使用 Turner 參數化卻實際執行 Briggs。執行基礎評測亦降低 token 用量並對數值與改寫擾動穩健。限制包括題庫經可驗證性過濾、共識答案仍需人工把關、跨領域題數有限。研究顯示頂尖模型的瓶頸已不在計算本身，而在領域判斷，凸顯專家知識仍不可替代。

links.title: Open-MOPD: Diagnosing and Fixing Capability Imbalance in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation

evidence: Abstract: 'standard M-OPD recovers only 35.6%... elevating recovery from 35.6% to 83.4% of the improvement from mixed-domain SFT to RouteRL'; claims full open-source of recipe, trajectories, evaluation suites on 8×A100-80GB.

Section 3.3 / Figure 3: 'IF accounts for ≈20% of prompts but only ≈1% of gradient tokens'; response lengths ≈10,500 (math/code) vs ≈409 (IF); 33.6× prompt multiplier needed to balance via oversampling.
Section 3.2: mean teacher disagreement 0.126 nat, only 0.62% of tokens with c_t>1; conflict masks reduce total score by 0.52/0.73/0.75 and consensus target by 0.83 points.
Section 3.3 / Figure 5: KL between rollout and current policy grows from 0 to 0.059 at K=4 and 0.216 at K=32; PPO clip fraction reaches 0.86.
Table 4 (Section 5): ablation ladder—+share +1.17, +share+gap +1.89 (K=1), K=4 Open-MOPD total 31.24 (+3.19 over Naive 28.05); reward refresh adds +0.81 at K=4.
Section 5.3 / Figure 8: dense-reward computation 27.3s with vs 27.8s without refresh; full step 1298s vs 1313s—'no measurable extra runtime cost'.
Section 5.2 / Figure 7b: inverse formulation (α=-0.5) creates unstable feedback loop, IF weight rises 24.4→80.9 and training collapses at step 74.
Appendix 8.1 / Table 6: base-model screening—Qwen3-1.7B-Base AIME24 best 7.08% with 69.17–80.42% truncation; Qwen2.5-7B-Base 31.25% with 12.92% truncation; SmolLM3-3B selected as compromise.
Table 2: Naive M-OPD 28.05 total, RouteOPD 31.55, RouteRL 32.35, Open-MOPD 31.24; baselines include RFT (26.51), π_mixrl (28.96), ParamMerge-Avg/TA (27.87/30.46).
Appendix 8.2 / Tables 7-8: complete hyperparameters for SFT, three GRPO teachers, and multi-teacher OPD (lr 1.5e-6, top-k=16, share target (1/3,1/3,1/3), α=1.0, K=4).
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM post-training methodology paper squarely in scope: multi-teacher on-policy distillation consolidating math/code/IF RL experts into one student (hits LLM, reasoning, code, RL, training/optimization, efficiency preferences). The strongest contribution is the controlled diagnosis on an oracle-routed SmolLM3-3B testbed showing the integration gap stems from token-budget misallocation (IF: 20.3% of prompts but 0.99% of gradient tokens, Sec 3.3) rather than teacher disagreement (mean 0.126 nat, 0.62% tokens >1 nat, Sec 3.2), plus useful negative results (conflict masks/consensus hurt; inverse-alpha collapses at step 74, Sec 5.2). Novelty is moderate: the three mechanisms (token-share reweighting, EMA gap-following budget, student reward refresh) are individually simple and related to known multi-task loss balancing and standard PPO logprob recomputation. Rigor and evidence are decent—ablation ladder (Table 4: +1.17/+1.89/+3.19), timing check for refresh (27.3s vs 27.8s), base-model screening (Appendix 8.1, Table 6)—but results are single-seed with variance only for one figure, one 3B base model, three domains, oracle routing, and capacity-vs-allocation confounds are not fully excluded. Reproducibility is a stated strength: full hyperparameters (Tables 7-8), public datasets, open-source pipeline/checkpoints/trajectories on 8×A100-80GB. Generalizability beyond this setup is plausible but untested.

primary_link.title: Open-MOPD: Diagnosing and Fixing Capability Imbalance in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation

papers.summary: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (M-OPD) has emerged as a promising paradigm for consolidating domain-specialized reinforcement learning (RL) experts into a single generalist student via dense, token-level reward supervision. Despite its practical success, the optimization dynamics governing multi-teacher capability integration remain poorly understood, and open, rigorously reproducible recipes are conspicuously lacking. In this work, we establish a controlled M-OPD benchmark on SmolLM3-3B-Base with oracle routing, isolating capability integration from routing ambiguity. Our investigation reveals a pronounced capability integration gap: standard M-OPD captures only 35.6% of the available headroom relative to a domain-routed oracle ensemble, with concise tasks such as instruction following suffering severe degradation and premature stagnation. Crucially, we show that this failure stems not from gradient conflict, but from a severe misallocation of the token-level optimization budget. This pathology is driven by three orthogonal factors: structural sequence-length disparities across domains, dynamic convergence drift due to non-uniform learning rates, and multi-step reward staleness from asynchronous policy updates. To resolve these imbalances, we introduce Open-MOPD, a principled framework incorporating token-share balancing, gap-aware dynamic budget allocation, and student reward refresh. Together, these mechanisms systematically restore cross-domain balance, elevating headroom recovery from 35.6% to 83.4% in a single deployable student. We fully open-source our end-to-end post-training recipe, training trajectories, and evaluation suites on an academically accessible hardware budget.
papers.summary_zh: 多教師 on-policy 蒸餾（M-OPD）可將多個領域強化學習專家整合為單一通用學生模型，但其能力整合動態缺乏理解，也缺少可重現的開源配方。本文以 SmolLM3-3B-Base 建立含 oracle 路由的受控基準，涵蓋數學、程式碼與指令遵循三領域，發現明顯的「能力整合落差」：標準 M-OPD 僅回復混合領域 SFT 至 RouteRL 改進量的 35.6%，簡短的指令遵循任務退化最嚴重且最早停滯。診斷顯示 token 層級的教師分歧並非主要瓶頸，真正問題是 token 層級最佳化預算的錯置，成因有三：各領域回應長度差異（指令遵循佔 20.3% 提示卻僅得 0.99% 梯度 token）、各領域收斂速率不同導致獎勵幅度漂移，以及同一 rollout 跨小批次重複更新造成的獎勵過時。對此，Open-MOPD 提出 token 份額平衡、落差感知的動態預算分配與學生獎勵刷新三項機制，分別對應三個失衡來源。消融實驗逐一驗證其效果，整合後回復率由 35.6% 提升至 83.4%，整合落差由 3.50 點縮至 0.31 點。作者完整開源端到端後訓練配方、訓練軌跡與評測套件，可在 8×A100-80GB 學術環境重現，指出預算配置才是多教師整合成敗的關鍵。
papers.title: Open-MOPD: Diagnosing and Fixing Capability Imbalance in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
papers.title_zh: Open-MOPD：診斷並修正多教師 on-policy 蒸餾的能力失衡

links.title: Mechanistic Tomography: Designed Measurement for Control-Oriented Interpretability

evidence: Abstract: 'On Qwen-2.5-7B, a calibrated additive map reaches held-out R^2=.983 on a finite refusal-response surface; pairwise lifting gives no detected MAE improvement.'
Sec. 4.1: 'Across these observers, closed-loop target error rises with observer RMSE (Spearman r_s=0.95)' and nuisance movement rises from 0.037 to 0.079 under mixed observer.
Sec. 5.2 Table 2: at eps=8, calibration raises mean held-out R2 from 0.818 to 0.960 vs OMP 0.969; leave-one-batch-out mean 0.959 across nine cells.

Sec. 5.3: 'Lifted OMP first meets both conditions with 64 aggregate measurements at eps=5 and 72 at eps=8. Exhaustively measuring every pair would require 2,016 probes.'; AtP+HVP needs 12-24 HVP queries.
Sec. 5.5: adding PxE term reduces held-out MAE from 0.386 to 0.259; paired bootstrap CI [0.1195,0.1338]; ordering PE>PB>BE under both ablation conventions.
Sec. 7 'Where the evidence remains narrow': 'its predictive comparison uses one prompt template and mean ablation' and Qwen 'provides behavioral ground truth only' with no scaling-law claim.

Footnote 5: public repository 'https://github.com/kwisatzh/mechanistic-tomography contains the complete experiment, frozen measurements, source and environment fingerprints, and a Colab notebook that reproduces Table 4'.

Appendices A-F provide proofs of the measurement reduction, calibration dimension, scale-density bound, and lifted-recovery reduction; theory relies on standard Taylor and compressed-sensing arguments.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A mechanistic-interpretability methodology paper squarely within LLM interpretability scope: it unifies activation patching, attribution patching, subset interventions, and Hessian-vector products as a single linear inverse measurement problem (y=Ax+w), adds a calibration-dimension stopping rule, a scale-density design bound, and control-facing observer validation. Novelty is real but compositional: the underlying tools (Taylor remainder bounds, compressed sensing, OMP, calibration regression) are classical; the framing, the observer-vs-reconstruction distinction, and the validation ladder (HMM posterior -> planted harness -> Tracr -> GPT-2 IOI -> Qwen-2.5-7B) are the new contributions. Rigor is high: formal statements with proofs (Appendices A-F), nine-cell crossed evaluation designs, leave-one-batch-out checks, crossed bootstrap CIs, fold-sensitivity audits (Sec. 5.5), noise and aliasing ablations (Sec. 5.3), two ablation conventions in IOI, and an explicit 'where the evidence remains narrow' section. Evidence strength is good but the strongest quantitative results come from synthetic/controlled settings; the two pretrained-model studies are deliberately narrow (one IOI template and mean ablation; one Qwen refusal surface, behavioral endpoint only, R2=.983 additive vs .9835 lifted with CI [-3.56%,5.65%]), and open-loop prediction on Qwen does not validate closed-loop control in a real LLM. Theory is careful but elementary, and the paper self-cites an unpublished ObserverBench manuscript. Reproducibility claims are strong: a stated public artifact repository with frozen measurements, environment fingerprints, and a Colab reproducing Table 4 (footnote 5), plus detailed splits, scales, and mask counts. Not a pure domain application or out-of-scope area; interpretability and safety-adjacent refusal steering match weighted preferences well.

primary_link.title: Mechanistic Tomography: Designed Measurement for Control-Oriented Interpretability

papers.summary: Mechanistic interpretability seeks quantities that models do not expose directly: represented states, component effects, interactions, and responses to interventions. Patching, gradients, Hessian-vector products, and subset interventions provide different measurements under different access assumptions and may target different quantities. We formulate their shared measurement structure as mechanistic tomography: designed measurement for recovering internal mechanisms and intervention effects.
papers.summary_zh: 本論文將機制可解釋性中的各種測量方法——activation patching、attribution patching、子集干預與 Hessian-vector product——統整為一個共同的量測問題，稱為 mechanistic tomography，並以線性逆問題 ỹ=Ax+w 描述：A 的每一列代表一次設計化干預，x 是想復原的效應映射，w 則涵蓋非線性反應、取樣誤差與基底誤差。理論上，論文推導量測誤差界線、干預尺度與遮罩密度的取捨、校準維度停止規則，以及一階量測無法察覺純交互作用的證明。實證上，在兩個 HMM 信念狀態模型中，觀測器誤差與閉迴路控制誤差高度相關（Spearman 0.95），且目標改善可能掩蓋干擾狀態的位移；僅 12 次聚合量測即可復原可壓縮的效應映射；少量有限探針可將 AtP 在較大干預尺度下的 R² 從 0.818 提升至 0.960；Tracr 顯示所需量測家族取決於基底；GPT-2 IOI 實驗中 P×E 交互作用是最大的保留預測項；Qwen-2.5-7B 上校準後的加性映射達 R²=0.983，pairwise lifting 未見改善。限制在於基底與情境分布屬外部假設，實驗涵蓋面有限。此框架為可解釋性提供量測為先的工作流程與控制導向的驗證準則。
papers.title: Mechanistic Tomography: Designed Measurement for Control-Oriented Interpretability
papers.title_zh: 機制斷層掃描：以設計化測量達成控制導向的可解釋性

links.title: Evaluating and Explaining Prompt Sensitivity of LLMs Using Interactions

evidence: Abstract: proposes IPS metric, applies it to 50 open-source LLMs, and identifies four factors (SFT, scale, dense architecture, few-shot) that reduce prompt sensitivity via stabilizing low-order interactions
Section 3.2/Figure 2: verifies sparsity of interactions and universal matching; top 3% or 5% of interactions yield minimal matching error across all 2^n masked inputs
Section 4.1: IPS ranges from 1.268 (Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct) to 1.752 (Mistral-7B-v0.3); Figure 4(b) shows negative correlation with output consistency
Appendix F.8.1/Table 2: threshold sweep over 16 values (0.05-0.20) with average Spearman 0.9905, Pearson 0.9957, Kendall 0.9465, Top-10 overlap 96.7%
Appendix I/Table 7: controlled variable analysis showing MoE models (e.g., Qwen3-30b-a3b, IPS 1.642 ARC) remain more sensitive than similarly-sized dense models (Qwen3-4b, 1.568)
Appendix H/Table 6: cosine similarity and L2 distance of hidden states give contradictory trends vs IPS for base vs instruct comparisons (e.g., Llama-2-13B, Qwen3-8B pairs)
Appendix E.1/E.3: experiments on 4x NVIDIA V100-DGXS 32GB GPUs, float16, greedy decoding (do_sample=False) for reproducibility

Appendix J: acknowledges O(2^n) computational cost as the main limitation; selective variables and phrase aggregation used for open-ended tasks (Appendix K.2); no code repository or public release is mentioned anywhere in the paper
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong topical fit: an LLM evaluation/interpretability paper proposing an Interaction-based Prompt Sensitivity (IPS) metric over 50 open-source LLMs, directly matching LLM, prompting, and interpretability preferences. Novelty is solid but incremental: the AND-OR interaction extraction framework is borrowed from Li & Zhang (2023)/Ren et al., applied here to prompt sensitivity, yielding a new fine-grained metric and the non-obvious finding that SFT, scale, dense architectures, and few-shot learning stabilize low-order interactions while high-order interactions stay unstable. Rigor is high: theoretical universal-matching proof (Theorem 3.1, Appendix B), sparsity/matching verification (Fig. 2), within-family controlled comparisons, an active-parameter-controlled MoE vs dense analysis (Table 7), a 16-value threshold sweep with Spearman 0.9905 (Appendix F.8.1), replications on MMLU, Dolly-15k open-ended tasks, and paraphrase/reordering perturbations, plus a comparison showing representation-based metrics (cosine/L2) are inconsistent (Appendix H). Evidence is mostly figure-based with limited numeric detail in the main text (e.g., '60%-80% unstable' ranges), findings rest on only 5 formatting templates in the core experiments, and the v_and=v_or=0.5v decomposition assumption (Appendix C/D) is ad hoc. Generalizability is decent (6 families, 2 MCQ benchmarks, open-ended replication) but restricted to open-source models, with open-ended tests mainly on the Llama-2 family. Reproducibility benefits from extensive appendices (mask token IDs, templates, greedy decoding, hardware) but no code or data release is stated, and the O(2^n) evaluation cost is a practical barrier the authors acknowledge (Appendix J).

primary_link.title: Evaluating and Explaining Prompt Sensitivity of LLMs Using Interactions

papers.summary: The remarkable capabilities of large language models (LLMs) are often undermined by their instability. Even subtle and semantically irrelevant changes in prompts can cause dramatic fluctuations in performance, a phenomenon known as prompt sensitivity. Previous studies typically evaluate prompt sensitivity by comparing the LLM's final outputs when prompts change. However, such coarse-grained metrics fail to explain the internal reasons for prompt sensitivity. In this paper, we introduce interacti
papers.summary_zh: 傳統研究多以最終輸出變化評估 LLM 的提示敏感度，屬粗粒度且無法解釋內部成因。本文引入賽局理論的交互作用作為細粒度分析工具：依據 universal matching 性質，模型的純量輸出可分解為 AND-OR 交互作用之和，並實證 LLM 僅編碼稀疏的顯著交互作用。作者據此提出 Interaction-based Prompt Sensitivity（IPS）指標，量化語意等價的提示模板變動下顯著交互作用的漂移，並在 ARC 與 MMLU 上評測 50 個開源 LLM。研究發現四項降低敏感度的因素：監督式 fine-tuning（instruct/chat 模型較 base 模型穩定）、更大的模型規模、稠密架構優於 MoE，以及 few-shot 學習；更關鍵的是，這些因素主要透過穩定低階（涉及較少輸入變數）交互作用發揮作用，而本質上最敏感的高階交互作用幾乎不受影響。IPS 與輸出一致性呈負相關，且對門檻值 τ 具備高排名穩定性；在 Dolly-15k 開放式任務與語意改寫等更複雜擾動下結論仍成立。限制在於計算成本隨輸入變數呈指數成長，需藉詞語篩選與片語合併緩解。此工作為 LLM 穩健性提供了可解釋、細粒度的評估視角。
papers.title: Evaluating and Explaining Prompt Sensitivity of LLMs Using Interactions
papers.title_zh: 以交互作用評估與解釋大型語言模型的提示敏感度

links.title: Metrics That Write Themselves: Evolving an Evaluator from Its Own Blind Spots

evidence: Abstract: loop-authored 55-line operator closes 15.4% of the gap between flagging nothing and a perfect filter on 428 unseen tasks (+0.0065, p=0.0010) at a quarter of the best hand-written operator's flags.

Section 5.1 Table 1: loop operator +0.0065 (126 flags, 0 calls/candidate) vs hand-written comparator +0.0069 (515 flags) and best of four LLM judge configurations +0.0070 (158 flags, 1 call per candidate); all 15 hand-written operators as one filter lose accuracy (-0.0067).

Section 5.2 Table 3: recall-floor arm and level-1-only arm each admit 0/0/0 across three seeds vs 1/1/1 for the reference loop; Section 5.2 states no level-1 attempt was admitted in the study's 336 attempts.

Section 5.3: enumeration of 2,007,327 subsets shows J ranks its own argmax 4.9th-85.7th percentile while registered balanced-accuracy criterion C6 reaches 91.1-98.7th; zero of 2,007,292 non-vacuous subsets harm the endpoint.
Section 6: 183 flagging operators realize only 96 distinct flag sets; 9 of 14 admissions on fresh seeds rediscover existing operators; no two rules separated in 9 paired tests.
Section 3: only 58 of 428 held-out tasks are decidable, selection accuracy spans 0.7170 to 0.7593, so headroom is 0.0424; Section 6 concedes both benchmarks come from one distribution family.
Section 5.1 Table 2: authored operator is positive and clears its per-pool null on all three pools, matching the comparator exactly on HumanEval+ (+0.0125, p=0.0010) with 36 flags against 103.
Appendix I Table 5: judge deltas range +0.0036 to +0.0070; Table 6 shows operator/judge flag-set overlap at Jaccard 0.105 with the union at +0.0073.

Appendix A documents four oracle-leakage screens (none fires on the 15 hand-written operators); Appendix B quantifies the transfer budget as ~10 decidable training examples plus ~60 labelled candidates.
No code, data, or artifact release is claimed anywhere in the document; the authoring model is a frozen proprietary model (Section 3) with call budgets specified.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-evaluation methodology paper (automated synthesis of executable metric operators for LLM outputs, compared against LLM-as-judge on MBPP+/HumanEval+), squarely in preference scope. Methodology is unusually strong: oracle-leakage screens, size-matched shuffle nulls with multiple-comparison corrections, registered predictions, in-loop mechanism ablations (Section 5.2 Table 3), and exact enumeration of the 2M-subset composition space instead of searched claims (Section 5.3). Candid negative results (behavioral duplication, rediscovery, no rule separation in 9 paired tests) raise credibility. Novelty rests on the claim that CEGAR transfer to metric synthesis is new, which is plausible and clearly differentiated from FunSearch-style search and verifier induction (Section 2, Appendix I). Evidence is bounded: absolute deltas are tiny (only 58 of 428 held-out tasks are decidable, Section 3), all validation stays within code generation, the motivating open-ended/report domain is never tested, and the claimed loop-level generalization is argued rather than shown. No code or artifact release is stated; reproduction depends on a proprietary authoring model, though budgets, seeds, screens, and pinning choices are documented in unusual detail.

primary_link.title: Metrics That Write Themselves: Evolving an Evaluator from Its Own Blind Spots

papers.summary: Agents improve quickly against a reliable automatic metric and stall without one, and the applications that need them most, report generation among them, are the ones nobody knows how to score. Can the metric write itself? Saying what makes an answer good is hard; pointing at something wrong with one is easier, so the metric we evolve is a pool of small Python operators that each flag a candidate for one named defect, or abstain, and vote. Asking a model for operators directly does not work: 183
papers.summary_zh: 開放式生成任務缺乏可靠的自動化評估指標，而 LLM 評審不但每個候選都要耗費呼叫成本，還帶有偏誤。本論文提出 EvalCEGAR，借用程式驗證的反例引導抽象精煉（CEGAR）思維讓指標自動演化：指標是一池可執行的小型 Python 檢測運算元，各自標記特定缺陷或棄權，透過投票成為篩選器。迴圈先在候選空間中尋找「碰撞」——兩個被現有運算元池給出相同簽章、但真值一對一錯的答案——再以此反例作為撰寫請求，要求模型針對該盲點寫出新運算元；當窄介面無法表達該區別時，升級為可存取同儕程式執行的寬介面；準入以部署決策（選出正確答案的機率）是否改善為準，並搭配四道防洩漏篩檢與置換虛無假設檢定。在 MBPP+ 與 HumanEval+ 的 428 個未見任務上，演化出的 55 行運算元縮短 15.4% 與完美篩選器的差距（+0.0065，p=0.001），旗標數僅為最佳手寫運算元的四分之一，且在從未見過的 HumanEval+ 上完全複製其效果；八次執行有六次準入且皆具樣本外助益。組合分析顯示以類別加權的 balanced accuracy 居於搜尋空間前段，而精確度導向目標落在底部。限制包括單一任務分布家族，以及層級二運算元對同儕集合的依賴。此方法證明可檢驗、可演化的指標能夠自動產出。
papers.title: Metrics That Write Themselves: Evolving an Evaluator from Its Own Blind Spots
papers.title_zh: 自動撰寫的指標：從自身盲點演化出評估器

links.title: Continual Reasoning Gym: Diagnosing and Harnessing Shared Reasoning in Continual RLVR

evidence: Abstract/Section 6.3: CPR achieves mean CTM 1.03 vs 0.88 for Seq. RLVR and is 'the only evaluated CL method to reach MTRL-level performance on average' (Table 2).

Section 5.1/Figure 3: backward transfer is only 2.47 percentage points on average across five sequences, yet final performance is 88% of MTRL, motivating the decomposition FinalAvg = BaseAvg + (T-1)/T*FWT + TLG + (T-1)/T*BWT (Prop. 1, proof in Appendix C.1).

Section 6.2/Figure 4: mean task-gradient cosine 0.345 with 82.2% positive pairs on the ten-task LLM algorithmic sequence; Appendix D.5.1 reports analysis restricted to the LM head plus final two transformer blocks (201,861,632 coordinates).
Figure 7/Table 15: sample replay (47.5%) underperforms no replay (49.9%) while CPR (63.3%) approaches MTRL (65.3%) on LLM algorithmic reasoning, isolating current-policy regeneration as the driver.
Table 17: CTM stays 0.97-0.99 across replay ratios rho in {0.05, 0.20, 0.50} vs 0.76 without replay, supporting ratio robustness on one setting only.

Appendix D.1 Tables 12-14: per-setting instability—Muon reaches 42.7% vs CPR 37.2% on VLM quantitative, KL reaches 42.4% vs CPR 32.5% on VLM spatial, and CPR (33.2%) trails Seq. RLVR (34.7%) on VLM positional.
Appendix D.5.1: cross-domain algorithmic-algebra mean cosine is -0.01 (domain-average cosine 0.006), showing shared reasoning is domain-dependent even within the paper's own diagnostics.
Appendix B.1/B.3: complete shared configuration (AdamW, lr 1e-6, batch 512, 500 steps, GRPO, five rollouts/prompt), CPR overhead 14.8h vs 14.6h per run on eight NVIDIA B200 GPUs.
Limitations section: experiments limited to Qwen3-4B and Qwen2.5-VL-7B, five sequences, and first-order local analysis; agentic settings and larger models deferred to future work.

Reproducibility statement: code, configurations, evaluation records, and table/figure regeneration scripts 'will accompany the paper release'; no seeds or variance estimates are reported anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology paper: continual RLVR post-training of Qwen3-4B and Qwen2.5-VL-7B reasoning policies, squarely matching LLM, reasoning, RL, and training preferences. Contributions are real but incremental in parts: CRG is a staged recombination of Reasoning Gym and VisuLogic tasks; CPR is experience-replay adapted to RLVR with current-policy response regeneration; the FinalAvg decomposition (Prop. 1) is exact but simple; 'shared reasoning' is formalized only as an assumption (Assumption 1) supported by first-order gradient cosine statistics and one behavioral case study (jugs). Rigor is solid—matched MTRL reference, six CL baselines with specified hyperparameters, replay-pool and ratio ablations—but no seeds, error bars, or significance tests are reported, per-setting rankings vary (KL beats CPR on VLM spatial: 42.4 vs 32.5; Muon beats CPR on VLM quantitative: 42.7 vs 37.2), and the headline CTM=1.03 is an average over only five sequences with 500-step budgets. Evidence is internally consistent and quantitative, and the paper honestly reports negative cases (CPR below Seq. RLVR on VLM positional, entropy both rises and falls, cross-domain LLM gradient cosine near zero, mean -0.01), which actually bounds generalizability of the shared-reasoning claim to two small models. Reproducibility is strong: full hyperparameter tables, CPR algorithm and store footprint (1.24 KiB/prompt), runtimes on eight B200s, verbatim transcripts, and a commitment to release code, configurations, and evaluation records.

primary_link.title: Continual Reasoning Gym: Diagnosing and Harnessing Shared Reasoning in Continual RLVR

papers.summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) commonly post-trains reasoning models on multiple tasks, while rerunning multitask RLVR (MTRL) as new tasks are added makes capability expansion costly. We therefore study continual RLVR, which updates the existing model as each task arrives. The central question is whether a model updated this way can perform as well as a jointly trained model. To answer this question, we introduce Continual Reasoning Gym, a continual-RLVR environment that o
papers.summary_zh: 以可驗證獎勵的強化學習（RLVR）對推理模型進行後訓練時，任務陸續加入會使重跑多任務訓練（MTRL）成本高昂。本文研究持續式 RLVR：模型隨任務到來逐步更新，核心問題是能否媲美聯合訓練。作者建構 Continual Reasoning Gym（CRG），將文字與視覺推理任務組成五條任務序列，並實作多種持續學習方法。分析將最終表現精確分解為 BaseAvg、前向遷移（FWT）、任務學習增益（TLG）與後向遷移（BWT）。關鍵發現有二：Seq. RLVR 的遺忘其實有限（平均 BWT 僅 -2.47 個百分點），但最終表現只有 MTRL 的 88%，差距主要來自 FWT 與 TLG。為解釋有限的遺忘，論文提出共享推理假說：任務梯度平均正向對齊（十任務序列的平均餘弦為 0.345，82.2% 的任務對為正），訓練單一任務平均上也能幫助其他任務，並以 jugs 個案展現行為層次的證據。據此提出 Continual Prompt Replay（CPR），在後續階段重播先前任務提示並以當前策略重新生成回應。CPR 是唯一平均達 MTRL 水準的方法（平均 CTM 1.03，Seq. RLVR 為 0.88），增益來自 FWT +2.4 與 TLG +4.9；以舊策略軌跡進行樣本重播反而遜於不重播。限制為僅涵蓋五序列與兩個模型，且分析僅刻劃局部一階效應。此研究顯示持續學習的關鍵不在防遺忘，而在善用跨任務的共享推理。
papers.title: Continual Reasoning Gym: Diagnosing and Harnessing Shared Reasoning in Continual RLVR
papers.title_zh: Continual Reasoning Gym：診斷與善用持續式 RLVR 中的共享推理

links.title: Think-to-Personalize: Unifying Reasoning and Retrieval for User-Centric Personalized Dense Retrieval

evidence: Abstract: TTP unifies explicit user-centric intent reasoning with dense retrieval via two-stage SFT + GRPO training and reports a +0.46% online order-volume lift.
Section 3.4.1: retrieval reward R_retrieval = alpha*Delta_S_pos + beta*Delta_S_margin computed with the frozen SFT model as reward model, clipped to [-1,1] to prevent reward drift.
Section 4.1.3: Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct backbone, Qwen3-32B teacher for 1M intent-enhanced samples, LoRA r=16 alpha=32, GRPO group size 8, trained on 8 NVIDIA A100 GPUs with VeRL.
Section 4.2.1 Table 4: TTP(SFT+RL) General R@20 47.52 vs MAPs 45.76 and Decoupled-Stage 45.89; Broad R@20 48.74 vs Qwen-Embedding 41.27 (+7.47); improvements claimed significant at p<0.05.
Section 4.3.3 Table 7: w/ Unfrozen Reward Model avg R@20 drops to 29.53 (self-referential bias/reward hacking) and w/o Dynamic Selection drops to 37.71, below the SFT-only 42.25.
Section 5.1 Table 8: distilled 305M retriever reaches avg R@20 43.10 vs full 3B teacher 44.97; cache-hit path covers 10.59% of query volume (Section 5.1).
Section 5.2 Table 9: 7-day A/B test shows QV CXR +0.41%, UV CXR +0.29%, Order Volume +0.46% with +0.15 ms added latency, all significant at p<0.05.

Section 4.2.2 Figure 3: human annotation of 200 broad-query samples; 34.0% kept unchanged, Over-Personalization limited to 2.3% of rewritten cases, with a failure-case analysis (Figure 4, 'Dental Filling').

Section 4.1.1/4.1.2: proprietary test sets use the actually purchased item as ground truth and several baselines (MAPs, CoPPS) are quoted rather than re-run; no discussion of exposure or popularity bias in logged data.
Section 1: code availability claimed at https://github.com/PhilipGAQ/ttp; training data (1M proprietary samples) not stated as releasable.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology paper: chain-of-thought intent reasoning over user history, unified with dense retrieval, aligned via GRPO with a frozen SFT reward anchor and dynamic positive selection (Sections 3.3-3.4). Strongly matches LLM, Reasoning/CoT, RAG, and Alignment preferences; not a pure domain application since it is validated on public benchmarks (KuaiSearch, Amazon/PersonalWAB) beyond the proprietary e-commerce logs. Novelty is moderate: reasoning-augmented retrieval (Search-R3, O1-Embedder) and LLM query rewriting (PBR, CoPS) exist; the contribution is the user-centric unification, joint GRPO+InfoNCE objective, and rollout filtering, which are sensible but incremental combinations. Rigor is solid: three baseline families with a well-constructed Decoupled-Stage strongest-baseline, component ablations, RL strategy ablations, history-length sweep, throughput analysis, and a 7-day online A/B test with p<0.05 (Sections 4-5). Key evidence includes +7.47 R@20 on Broad over Qwen-Embedding and +1.76 R@20 over MAPs on General (Table 4), the unfrozen-reward-model collapse to 29.53 avg R@20 demonstrating reward-hacking avoidance (Table 7), and distilled 305M serving at 43.10 avg R@20 (Table 8). Weaknesses: gains over the strongest baselines are modest; proprietary test sets use purchased items as ground truth with no discussion of exposure/popularity bias; human annotation covers only 200 broad queries with no inter-annotator agreement; significance-test details unstated; code link asserted but unverified. Reproducibility is aided by detailed hyperparameters (LoRA r=16, GRPO group 8, VeRL, 8xA100) and public benchmarks, but the 1M-sample proprietary training data and platform logs are not releasable.

primary_link.title: Think-to-Personalize: Unifying Reasoning and Retrieval for User-Centric Personalized Dense Retrieval

papers.summary: Dense retrieval has become a cornerstone of modern local-lifestyle e-commerce search by encoding queries and items into semantic embedding spaces. While recent advancements have transitioned from BERT-based embedding models to Large Language Models (LLMs), most approaches still treat LLMs as static text encoders, neglecting their inherent reasoning capabilities. Furthermore, standard dense retrieval models remain query-centric, which is insufficient in e-commerce scenarios where sparse and ambig
papers.summary_zh: 電子商務搜尋中的稠密檢索傳統上以查詢為中心，但生活服務類查詢常稀疏且模糊，形成僅能靠使用者歷史彌補的意圖落差；既有個人化方法又多依賴隱式嵌入互動，缺乏顯式推理能力。本文提出 Think-to-Personalize（TTP），以單一 LLM 統一個人化意圖推理與稠密檢索：模型先對使用者歷史購買序列與查詢進行鏈式推理，生成意圖增強查詢，再擷取 <embed> 位置隱狀態作為查詢向量，並以共享編碼器同時編碼商品。訓練分兩階段：SFT 結合生成損失與 InfoNCE 對比損失建立冷啟動能力；再以 GRPO 強化學習對齊推理與檢索效用，獎勵包含格式、長度，以及以凍結 SFT 模型計算的正相關增益與邊際增益，並以動態正樣本選擇過濾雜訊 rollout。資料建構上由 Qwen3-32B 教師生成候選改寫，經重排模型篩選。實驗顯示 TTP 在自有 General、Broad、LongTail 測集與 KuaiSearch、Amazon 公開基準上全面超越一般檢索器、隱式歷史建模與解耦改寫管線；在模糊的 Broad 查詢上較基礎檢索器提升 Recall@20 達 7.47 個百分點。消融顯示動態選擇不可或缺，而允許策略模型自評會引發災難性獎勵駭用（平均 R@20 降至 29.53%）。線上部署採離線個人化快取搭配蒸餾 305M 檢索器，七日 A/B 測試訂單量相對提升 0.46%，延遲僅增加 0.15 毫秒。限制包括少數過度個人化的失敗案例，且歷史長度最優值為 10。

links.title: What is Missing from AI Post-Training AI: An Empirical Analysis

evidence: Section 2.2 & Table 1: analysis of 1,338 public PostTrainBench trajectories (7 benchmarks, 4 base models 1.7B-4B, 20 agent configurations), e.g., observed gains GSM8K 24.5%->44.0%, HumanEval 22.0%->41.4%, overall 10.41%->23.0%.

Section 3.2 & Table 2: strategy tracks the agent, not the task — Claude Code anchors on full SFT in 163/202 (80.7%) trajectories, Codex CLI on PEFT in 268/299 (89.6%); only 74/3,557 (2.1%) adjacent training pairs change strategy (Appendix A.2 decomposition: 35 objective, 38 data-source, 1 stage).

Table 3 (Section 4.1.2): experience-driven framework raises Opus 4.6 (Claude Code) from 64.70%±9.6 to 77.30%±3.8 on GSM8K and 22.00%±10.4 to 62.80%±6.1 on HumanEval over three runs; ablations (journal/skills/evaluator removal) reported.

Section 4.1.3 & Table 10 (Appendix C.3): main agent adopts all execution-level suggestions but 0 unplanned strategy revisions despite 12 strategy-level evaluator suggestions across 3 benchmarks; agent creates no new skills in any run (Appendix C.2).

Section 4.2.2 & Appendix B: human-guided AIME 2025 pass@8 of 13.33% is explicitly stated to lie within evaluation variance, with the stronger evidence being qualitative redirection of the initial strategy.
Section 3.2 footnote 2: 'The released trajectories do not expose a uniform wall-clock timestamp' — the lock-in-at-beginning claim denotes the pre-update planning phase, not a measured time-to-lock.

Appendix A.1: authors state the corpus is observational ('Agent models, interfaces, prompts, and benchmarks are not independently randomized... do not identify causal effects'); Appendix A.4 audits 16 strategy-changing trajectories showing switching can help or regress.
Section 4.3 & Figure 6: framework spends ~2-8x baseline tokens; on AIME 2025 ~7.9x tokens (~66.7M) for one additional solved problem within variance — compute scaling ceiling on hard tasks.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM/agent research, squarely in scope: an empirical study of LLM agents autonomously post-training LLMs, matching LLM (2.5), Agents & Tool Use (2.5), Training/Optimization, RLHF-style post-training (SFT/PEFT/GRPO/DPO), and reasoning-compute preferences. Novelty is solid for an analysis paper: the execution-vs-strategy capability distinction and quantified strategy lock-in (only 2.1% of 3,557 adjacent training pairs change strategy) is a fresh, well-motivated diagnosis rather than another scaffold. Rigor is above average: formal metric definitions (Appendix A.3), LLM annotation with author review, three-seed controlled runs with std, pass@8 handling of AIME variance, and an honest audit of the 16 strategy-changing trajectories; but weaknesses include a confounded compute-scaling condition (the scaffold doubles as the extra-compute condition), a single human reviewer/benchmark for guidance, and purely observational corpus design the authors themselves flag. Evidence strength is good for headline claims (Table 2 lock-in rates; Table 3 gains of +12.6 GSM8K / +40.8 HumanEval; Table 10 zero unplanned strategy revisions), though the central temporal claim ('locked in at the very beginning') is softened by the authors' own footnote (no wall-clock timestamps), and the human-guidance gain is admitted to be within evaluation variance. Generalizability is moderate: broad corpus (7 benchmarks, 4 base models, 5 scaffolds) but controlled interventions use one base model and the conclusion is drawn from one post-training benchmark suite. Reproducibility is limited: trajectories are public, but no code/artifact release for the experience-driven framework is stated and key agents are commercial APIs.
topics: agent scaffolds: memory, skill library, evaluator agent

primary_link.title: What is Missing from AI Post-Training AI: An Empirical Analysis

papers.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can now post-train an LLM end-to-end. They can write code, launch training, evaluate checkpoints, and improve downstream performance, raising the prospect of AI-for-AI. We argue that this picture conflates two distinct capabilities: execution-level capability, iterating within a selected training strategy; and strategy-level capability, revising the high-level judgment as experimental evidence accumulates. Analyzing a large corpus of publicly released post-train
papers.summary_zh: LLM 代理已能端對端地後訓練另一個 LLM，但 AI 改善 AI 的能力是否等同於自動執行訓練管線？本文區分兩種層次的能力：執行層次（在既定策略內迭代除錯、調參）與策略層次（依實驗證據修正高層策略）。作者分析 PostTrainBench 公開的 1,338 條代理軌跡，發現訓練策略在動手之前即鎖定：80.7% 的 Claude Code 軌跡收斂於全參數 SFT，89.6% 的 Codex CLI 收斂於 PEFT，且 3,557 個相鄰訓練實驗中僅 2.1% 曾改變策略。接著進行三項遞進式介入：一、以實驗日誌、技能庫與評估代理組成的經驗框架全面改善執行（GSM8K +12.6、HumanEval +40.8 分），但策略依舊靜止，代理採納所有執行層建議卻忽視所有策略層建議；二、訓練前的人類審查能成功改寫初始策略（在 AIME 2025 上代理甚至自行跳過 SFT 暖身），但訓練開始後仍退化為局部調整；三、推論運算增加 2–8 倍，在較易任務有回報，在最難的 AIME 幾乎無增益。結論：缺少的不是經驗、指引或算力，而是在執行中自發重啟策略評估的機制；策略僅在訓練開始前的短暫窗口內具有可塑性。此發現指出未來應以獎勵訊號與互動協定使策略修正成為顯式的決策點，而非單純加大模型。

links.title: Shared Circuits for Shared Grammar: Tracing Subject-Verb Agreement Across Languages

evidence: Abstract/§1: 'Using activation patching and attention analysis across 29 languages and five open-source model families, we identify the attention heads causally implicated in agreement' — establishes core method and scope.

§3 Language-model coverage: inclusion threshold 'at least 50 prompts remain after tokenization and behavioral filtering'; surviving prompts range 96–2,400 (avg 1,509.59), 'From each retained set, we evaluate 50 prompts for activation patching' — limits statistical power per condition.

§4.1: two complementary recovery metrics defined, target-logit (applicable to non-conjugating languages) and minimal-pair (restricted to conjugating languages), enabling the paper's central metric-based distinction.
Table 4 (App. B.2): mean pairwise Pearson similarity among conjugating languages 0.5876 (SD 0.3204, n=11,622), positive in every conjugation contrast and patching direction.

§5.3/Fig 4: attention-role mass to pronouns 0.288 (minimal-pair) and 0.291 (target-logit) in conjugating languages vs 0.177 in non-conjugating; cross-lingual role similarity ≈0.928/0.926 'based on thousands of directional language-pair observations'.

App. B.4/Fig 12: 'The result is directionally consistent across all six models: English is always more similar to conjugating-language circuitry in the 3sg-inflecting conditions than in the non-inflecting conditions.'
App. C/Fig 13: robustness check across Pearson, cosine, Spearman, and top-k Jaccard similarity metrics; Pearson and cosine 'reproduce the effect most stably'.
App. D.3/Fig 16: BLOOM intermediate checkpoints (1k–300k steps) show cross-lingual similarity increasing over pretraining for both metrics.

§6 limitations: 'attention-based routing component... rather than the full computational graph', 'structured conjugation prompts rather than naturalistic sentences', 'one morphosyntactic phenomenon', and 'filtered cases in which the model successfully produces the target form'.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A solid mechanistic interpretability study of multilingual LLMs (BLOOM, Gemma, Llama, Mistral, Qwen), squarely in scope for LLM (2.5), interpretability (1.8), NLP (1.5), and transformer-attention (1.2) preferences. The causal question — when multilingual models share agreement circuitry — is well posed, and the design is careful: controlled minimal pairs, tokenization/behavioral filtering, two recovery metrics separating inflection-specific from broader recovery, English as a within-language bridge case, plus ablations over scale, instruction tuning, similarity metrics, and BLOOM pretraining checkpoints. Novelty is incremental rather than transformative: the paper explicitly positions itself relative to Mueller et al. 2022, Ferrando & Costa-jussà 2024, and Zhang et al. 2025, with the main new contributions being the 29-language typological spread, the metric contrast, and the English context-dependent result. Rigor is above average but not exceptional: only 50 prompts per conjugation pair feed the patching analyses, analyses are restricted to behaviorally successful cases (acknowledged), MLP components are excluded, and statistical testing beyond bootstrap CIs for the English effect is thin. Evidence is strong directionally (English shift positive in all six models, App. B.4; positive similarity in every contrast/direction, Table 4) and robustness-checked across similarity metrics (App. C), but headline similarities rest on correlating flattened heatmaps, an indirect circuit proxy. Generalizability is limited by the artificial conjugation template, one phenomenon, and attention-head-only scope (§6). Reproducibility is decent: all checkpoints, UniMorph/CVFD sources, prompt templates, and filtering rules are documented, though no code release is stated.

primary_link.title: Shared Circuits for Shared Grammar: Tracing Subject-Verb Agreement Across Languages

papers.summary: Multilingual large language models often generalize across languages, and prior work suggests that their internal mechanisms can overlap cross-lingually. It remains unclear, however, when such sharing emerges and whether it varies with the overt realization of the same grammatical operation. We investigate this question for present-tense subject-verb agreement, a morphosyntactic process that varies substantially across languages and is only weakly expressed in English. Using activation patching
papers.summary_zh: 多語言 LLM 能否為跨語言的同一文法運算重用內部電路？本文以現在式主謂一致為測試場，透過 activation patching 與注意力分析，比較 29 種語言、五個開源模型家族中與一致有關的注意力頭。研究設計嚴格控制的極小對（minimal pairs），只改變主詞與目標屈折形式，並採用兩種復原指標：較寬鬆的 target-logit recovery 衡量語境合適形式的復原，較嚴格的 minimal-pair recovery 則隔離屈折對比本身。主要結果有四：一、具有顯性人稱／數屈折的語言之間，電路相似度顯著為正，且在最小對指標下最強、變異最小；二、以 target-logit 指標衡量時，屈折語言之間的相似度仍明顯高於屈折與非屈折語言之間，非屈折語言彼此相似度也低，顯示電路並非通用基線；三、英語作為橋接案例，整體與屈折語言不同，但在需要第三人稱單數屈折的語境中明顯更接近共享電路；四、跨語言共享的前列注意力頭展現相似的注意力角色分布，對主詞代名詞的注意力占比相近。附錄顯示相似度不受模型規模或 instruction tuning 系統性影響，並在 BLOOM 訓練過程中逐步上升。限制包括僅分析注意力路由而非完整計算圖、使用結構化提示而非自然語句，以及只聚焦單一文法現象。此結果指出跨語言共享由文法運算是否需要顯式實現所決定，對多語言可解釋性與干預方法的可遷移性具重要意涵。

links.title: CentaurBench: Benchmarking LLM Capabilities on Augmenting vs. Automating Real-World Work Tasks

evidence: Section 1: 'The model-level rank correlation is about 0.48 between augmentation and automation regimes and itself varies, ranging from -0.04 (travel planning) to 0.85 (tax preparation)'; Table 1 shows only tax preparation significant (rho=0.85, p=0.004).
Section 3.1: fixed GPT-3.5-Turbo worker chosen 'to isolate the value of the assistant's guidance from the executor's own capability'; assistant 'never writes the deliverable itself'.

Section 3.3: blind pairwise round-robin tournaments, leave-family-out judging, ten independent runs; 'judges select the option with the higher average rubric score in 99.7% of cases' across 15,120 non-tied comparisons.

Appendix F (Figure 14): inter-judge agreement 71.0% overall, Krippendorff's alpha 0.414 (automation 0.448 vs augmentation 0.354), self-described as 'meaningful but moderate common signal rather than near-consensus'.

Appendix D Table 4: augmentation winner differs from automation winner in five of seven tasks; unaided GPT-3.5-Turbo (plain) ranks first in operations research, tax prep, and travel planning; Section 4.3 reports plain baseline mean rank 3.79 vs GPT-5-Mini 3.66.
Appendix F (Figure 15): criterion-validity check where Claude-Opus-4.8 recovers the prespecified GPT release-order gradient in 89% of 700 ordered comparisons.

Section 4.4 / Table 2: mechanism traits (specificity beyond prompt, explicit ordering, direction maintenance) derived from illustrative excerpts of highest- vs lowest-ranked assistance texts without systematic coding or human raters.

Section 5.3 Limitations: LLM judges only ('scalable simulation evidence rather than definitive human or domain-expert judgments'), single worker model, single one-shot assistance text, seven tasks, no tool use.

Title-page footnote: reproducibility code at github.com/kennywong524/best-player-not-best-coach and interactive results dashboard; Appendix B reproduces all task prompts and rubrics; Appendix A Table 3 lists models, worker, and judge assignments.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Solidly in-scope LLM evaluation/benchmarking work: compares ten frontier LLMs as automators vs. assistants to a fixed GPT-3.5-Turbo worker across seven professional tasks, with LLM-as-judge panel, rubrics, and released code. Novelty is genuine but incremental: it operationalizes Haupt & Brynjolfsson's 'centaur evaluation' call via a fixed-worker design that isolates assistant quality; prior teacher-student and strong-weak collaboration work is single-domain, so the cross-model/cross-task/cross-mode matrix is new. Rigor is above average for judge-based benchmarks (10 runs, leave-family-out judging, SE reporting, choice-score consistency 99.7%, Krippendorff alpha reporting, criterion-validity release-order check), but weakened by: the headline model-level divergence rests on rho=0.48 with p=0.187 over only 9 models (not significant, authors concede), the mechanism analysis in Section 4.4 is anecdotal (top-2 vs bottom-2 excerpts, no systematic coding), single task instance per domain, no position-bias quantification, and no human-expert validation despite augmentation inter-judge alpha of 0.354 being only moderate. Evidence strength is capped because all ground truth is LLM-judge simulation; the authors appropriately frame findings as hypothesis-generating. Generalizability is limited by one worker model, one one-shot process-guidance format, no tool use, and seven tasks, all acknowledged in Section 5.3. Reproducibility is decent: full prompts/rubrics in Appendix B, GitHub code and dashboard, model/judge panel in Table 3, though sampling parameters are unspecified.

primary_link.title: CentaurBench: Benchmarking LLM Capabilities on Augmenting vs. Automating Real-World Work Tasks

papers.summary: Most LLM benchmarks rank models on their ability to automate work tasks. In practice, however, models are often used to assist other (human or LLM) agents. The question that drives model selection is therefore not only which model produces the best output, but which model most improves the work of another (weaker) agent. We introduce a unified framework that evaluates the capability of models to automate and augment another agent's performance. Across seven economically grounded real-world tasks
papers.summary_zh: 現有 LLM 基準大多衡量模型獨立完成任務的自動化能力，但實務上模型常被用來輔助其他人類或較弱代理。本文提出 CentaurBench，以七項真實職業任務（諮商、市場趨勢分析、菜單規劃、作業研究、報稅、旅遊規劃、教學）同時評估模型的自動化與增強能力：自動化模式下模型直接產出成果；增強模式下模型只提供流程導向的協助文字，由固定的 GPT-3.5-Turbo worker 依據指引完成任務，藉此分離助理品質與執行者能力。輸出由四位 LLM 評審以任務專屬評分準則進行盲測兩兩比較（採 leave-family-out 排除同家族自評），並重複十次。主要發現：自動化與增強排名僅中度相關（Spearman 0.48），且在七項任務中有五項的增強贏家不同於自動化贏家；無協助的 worker 在三項任務上勝過所有被協助條件，平均而言僅 GPT-5-Mini 的指引優於無指引；亦觀察到大幅角色反轉，如 Claude-Opus-4.8 在市場趨勢分析是最強自動化者卻是近最弱助理。質性分析歸納高品質引導的三個特徵：超越提示的具體性、明確的結構與順序，以及不與任務目標作對。限制包括仰賴 LLM 評審而非人類專家、僅單一 worker 模型、單輪互動與有限的任務集。此基準凸顯自動化能力不足以預測輔助品質，組織選模應依角色與任務而定。
