links.title: Open at the Edge, Captured at the Center: llama.cpp and the Political Economy of Local AI Inference

evidence: Abstract: 'mixed-methods analysis of llama.cpp, combining 7,681 merged pull requests from March 2023 through March 2026 with repository discussions, corporate statements, and contributor blogs' — establishes LLM-inference-infrastructure scope.

Section 3.2: classification relies on changed file paths with title-based fallback (model names; CPU instruction names like AVX/NEON), and affiliation assignment uses ggml-org membership, commit email domain, and self-reported company field with manual conflict review — transparent but unvalidated.
Section 3.2 acknowledges limitations: 'merged PRs ... do not directly measure user adoption, revenue, or strategic importance' and 'GitHub provides at most 300 changed files per PR.'

Section 4.2.1: 'Across the 69 model families with five or more merged PRs, model owners contribute a median of zero PRs to their own implementations, accounting in aggregate for just 6.7% of model-related activity'; hardware backends median 40 PRs vs model families median 5.
Section 4.1.2 / Figure 6: NVIDIA's Vulkan PR share 'surged from Q4 2024 onward, reaching approximately 50% of all Vulkan activity by 2026'; PR #10206 adds vendor-specific VK_NV_cooperative_matrix2.
Section 4.2.2: February 2026 ggml.ai absorption into Hugging Face, with SAFE-financing interpretation of why absorption 'was an available path' — interpretive causal claim.
References: entries 'Lee (2026)' and 'Smith (2026)' are marked 'Placeholder entry; verify bibliographic details before submission' — uncorrected quality-control defect.
Figure 4 and footnote 13: CUDA ~800 merged PRs vs Metal ~420, triangulated against release-download shares (CUDA 24.3%, Metal 8.7%) with the caveat that downloads are 'an imperfect proxy.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: A mixed-methods political-economy study of llama.cpp, the dominant local LLM inference runtime. Topic relevance is solid but not maximal: it squarely matches LLM (2.5), Inference & Serving (1.5), and Scaling & Efficiency (1.3) preferences via quantization, hardware backends, and local deployment of LLaMA-class models, yet it contributes no language-modeling methodology itself. Novelty is above average: it is the first systematic account of capture dynamics at the local inference layer, with genuinely new empirical findings (model owners contributing a median of zero PRs to their own implementations; NVIDIA steering Vulkan via vendor extensions while AMD/Moore Threads use CUDA compatibility layers). Rigor is moderate: the Section 3.2 classification and affiliation protocol is transparent and self-critical, but lacks inter-coder reliability or validation of PR classifications, and several causal readings (e.g., SAFE financing making HF absorption 'comparatively easy' in 4.2.2) are interpretive; two placeholder references ('verify bibliographic details before submission') signal quality-control lapses. Evidence strength is moderate: claims are specific and traceable (7,681 PRs, Figures 1-7, PR #8006/#10256/#10206, download-share triangulation in footnote 13), but affiliations are admittedly error-prone and the demand-side proxy is weak. Generalizability is limited by the single-case design; reproducibility is partial since data are public but no code/data release, annotation protocol, or inter-annotator procedure is documented.

primary_link.title: Open at the Edge, Captured at the Center: llama.cpp and the Political Economy of Local AI Inference

papers.summary: Critical scholarship on open AI has focused on model releases and cloud ecosystems, leaving the local inference infrastructure that makes open-weight models runnable on user-owned devices largely unexamined. We address this gap through a mixed-methods analysis of llama$.$cpp, combining 7,681 merged pull requests from March 2023 through March 2026 with repository discussions, corporate statements, and contributor blogs. We show that local inference broadens participation at execution while reloca
papers.summary_zh: 開放 AI 的批判研究多聚焦模型釋出與雲端生態，卻少有人檢視讓開放權重模型能在自家裝置上執行的本地推論基礎設施。本文以混合方法研究 llama.cpp：分析 2023 年 3 月至 2026 年 3 月間 7,681 個已合併的 pull request，依變更檔案路徑分類並連結作者所屬機構，輔以企業聲明、貢獻者部落格與倉庫討論。結果顯示個別貢獻者占比從早期約 65% 降至 2026 年的約 30%；硬體後端擴及 17 種，CUDA 後端約 800 個 PR 卻主要由 ggml 核心維護，NVIDIA 自身僅占少數，AMD 與 Moore Threads 透過相容層搭便車，而 NVIDIA 又以廠商專屬 Vulkan 擴充影響跨平台後端；模型所有者對自家模型實作的貢獻中位數為零，支援工作落在核心維護者與少數策略性企業。2026 年 2 月 ggml.ai 併入 Hugging Face，凸顯模型發現、轉換與載入預設的集中化。作者據此主張政策應關注基礎設施層：以 6(b) 調查格式依賴、推動模型相容性認證，並對推論工具提供公共資助。
papers.title: Open at the Edge, Captured at the Center: llama.cpp and the Political Economy of Local AI Inference
papers.title_zh: 開放於邊緣、集中於核心：llama.cpp 與本地 AI 推論的政治經濟學

links.title: WhiteMatter: All-to-All Cross-Layer Connections via KV Mixing

evidence: Abstract/§4.2: full-cache WhiteMatter reaches 19.968 held-out perplexity vs 21.747 for same-depth vanilla (8.2% lower) and beats the 24-layer vanilla at 20.181
§4.2: half-cache WhiteMatter (k=8) reaches 20.377, 5.0% below equal-cache LCKV w=7 (21.461) on identical data/optimizer recipe

§4.4: cyclic Gauss-Seidel g=16 reaches within 1% of exact autoregressive perplexity in 4 passes, 13.9× faster than autoregressive prefill and 11.2× faster than Jacobi on a 4-layer controlled model; Appendix B reports 15.5× on a larger cyclic-trained 8-layer model
§5.3: removing deep-to-shallow feedback leaves perplexity 7.5% above full-cache WhiteMatter; static (non-dynamic) routing costs ~2% perplexity, isolating both components
Limitations + Table 2 (§4.5): training/prefill cost 2.3–2.5× and 3.1–3.3× vanilla FLOPs; main results limited to small models at 8B-token budget with no optimized end-to-end decoding benchmark
§4.3 Table 1: downstream gains concentrated in LAMBADA/WikiText/PIQA/HellaSwag; ARC-E and OBQA are not consistently improved among 16-layer models
llm_evaluation.rationale: A solid transformer-architecture/efficiency paper squarely within LLM scope: dynamic content-dependent cross-layer KV mixing with deep-to-shallow feedback, plus a cyclic Gauss-Seidel schedule for token-parallel training/prefill. Preference relevance is moderate-high (Transformer Architecture, KV-cache memory, inference/training efficiency, LLM pretraining) but does not touch the highest-weight preference clusters (agents, reasoning, Japanese LLM). Novelty is good: it combines feedback connections (Fan et al., LCKV), dynamic dense mixing (MUDDFormer), and KV sharing (CLA/FusedKV) into a token-dependent all-depth routing scheme not previously realized, though it is an intersection of known ideas. Rigor is strong: controlled depth-16/24/32 baselines, cache-matched LCKV comparison, k-sweep, feedback and dynamic-routing ablations, two-seed schedule study, FLOP accounting validated against closed form, and an unusually honest Limitations section (including an unexplained Jacobi oscillation). Evidence is consistent and quantitative but confined to ~52M-parameter models trained on 8B tokens, so claims do not establish scaling; downstream gains are mixed on ARC-E/OBQA. Generalizability is limited by scale and single dataset/tokenizer, acknowledged by the authors. Reproducibility is good (data release, tokenizer, optimizer details, evaluation harness) but no explicit code release is stated.

primary_link.title: WhiteMatter: All-to-All Cross-Layer Connections via KV Mixing

papers.summary: In a Transformer, each layer attends to past tokens only through KV produced at its own depth, despite the presence of deeper representations during autoregressive decoding. Feedback architectures allow shallow consumer layers to attend to KV produced by deeper past-token representations, but give all consumer layers the same fixed connection patterns to source layers. We propose WhiteMatter, which connects every attention layer to the representations from all layers of each past token, with con
papers.summary_zh: 在 Transformer 中，每一層只能讀取與自身同深度的 KV，無法存取過去 token 的深層表示；回饋式架構雖補上深到淺路徑，卻給所有層固定的連接模式。WhiteMatter 提出：在每個 token 位置由資料相依的路由器把全部 L 層隱藏狀態混合成 k 個共享 KV 通道，供後續各層各取一個通道，連接權重可隨層與 token 變化，k<L 時還能壓縮 KV 快取。為解決訓練與 prefill 的循環相依，作者採用循環 Gauss–Seidel 迭代，並以前置 dummy token 維持因果遮罩相容性。在 8B token 的 FineWeb-Edu 上從頭預訓練 16 層模型：k=16 時困惑度 19.968，比同深度 vanilla 低 8.2%，並優於 24 層模型；k=8（半快取）為 20.377，比同等快取的 LCKV 低 5.0%。受控實驗顯示 g=16 時四次循環迭代即達自迴歸困惑度的 1% 以內，prefill 快 13.9 倍；解碼計算與 vanilla 相近。代價是訓練約 2.5 倍 FLOPs、prefill 約 3.3 倍，且實驗僅限小規模模型，尚未有端到端解碼基準。此架構展示了深層表示跨層共享的品質增益與快取效率潛力。
papers.title: WhiteMatter: All-to-All Cross-Layer Connections via KV Mixing
papers.title_zh: WhiteMatter：以 KV 混合實現全對全跨層連接

links.title: Are LLMs becoming similarly creative? Evidence from three years of models

evidence: Section 3 (Methodology): evaluates AUT and Infinity-Chat100 prompts against 68 models from 12 providers released March 2023-July 2026 via OpenRouter with temperature and top-p set to 1.0

Section 3 (Regression specification): mean prompt-level cosine distance using all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings regressed on nine release bins, cross-family pairs only, with 1,000 family-balanced resampling iterations
Table 1: bootstrap OLS slope per bin is -0.01385 [95% CI -0.01695,-0.01044] for AUT and -0.00167 [-0.00267,-0.00074] for Infinity-Chat

Section 4 (Results): mean cross-family AUT distance falls from ~0.50 in the earliest release bin to below 0.40 in the most recent; all 1,000 resampling iterations produced negative slopes for both prompt sets
Appendix A (Data coverage details): 668/690 AUT and 6,677/6,900 Infinity-Chat100 responses observed (~3.2% missing), with pairwise distances computed only over prompts both models answered

Section 5 (Limitations): authors acknowledge single samples give only point estimates of output distributions and that hidden relationships such as distillation and shared training data are not accounted for; Section 5 (Future work) lists robustness checks across prompt wording, sampling parameters, and model size as not yet performed
llm_evaluation.rationale: Squarely an LLM-focused empirical study (LLM output homogenization/creativity over time) with an evaluation-methodology angle, so preference relevance is high; it is not a pure domain application. Novelty is moderate: prior work documents homogeneity snapshots, and the first longitudinal cross-model regression is a genuine but incremental contribution built on existing prompt sets and a standard embedding metric. Rigor is decent but limited by a simple design: single response per model per prompt, one small embedding model (all-MiniLM-L6-v2), OLS on binned cosine distance, and acknowledged unaddressed confounders (distillation, shared training data, length/style effects). Evidence is directionally strong (all 1,000 family-balanced resampling iterations negative; CIs exclude zero for both prompt sets) but the Infinity-Chat effect is small (-0.00167/bin) and no ablations over sampling params, prompt wording, or embedding choice are run. Generalizability is plausible (68 models, 12 providers, two prompt sets) but the authors label the analysis preliminary. Reproducibility is moderately supported: prompts, API settings, embedding model, regression spec, and missing-data table are documented, but no code/data release is stated and API outputs are not exactly re-generable.

primary_link.title: Are LLMs becoming similarly creative? Evidence from three years of models

papers.summary: Many benchmarks track Large Language Model (LLM) performance on tasks with verifiable answers, but less is known about how LLM performance is evolving on open-ended tasks, where creativity, originality and diversity may matter as much as quality. As LLMs increasingly support human ideation and creative work, understanding trends in LLM performance on open-ended tasks is critical. This paper presents a preliminary analysis of LLM creative outputs spanning three years of model releases, examining
papers.summary_zh: 既有基準多評估有可驗證答案的任務，對 LLM 在開放式創意任務上的長期趨勢則缺乏縱向分析。本文以 2023 年 3 月至 2026 年 7 月間 12 家供應商的 68 個模型為對象，讓它們回答替代用途測驗（AUT）與 Infinity-Chat100 的 100 個真實開放式提示，以 all-MiniLM-L6-v2 嵌入回應，計算跨供應商模型對的餘弦距離，再以九個發布時段分箱進行 OLS 迴歸，並以 1,000 次家族平衡重抽樣控制家族樣本數差異。結果顯示兩組提示的跨家族語義距離均隨時間顯著下降：AUT 每箱斜率為 −0.01385（95% CI [−0.01695, −0.01044]），Infinity-Chat 為 −0.00167；全部重抽樣皆為負斜率，方向穩健。這表示 LLM 的創意輸出正趨於同質化，與演算法單一文化的憂慮一致，且在明確要求發散思維的 AUT 上衰退最為明顯。作者坦承限制：無法排除蒸餾、共享訓練資料等隱藏因素，每個模型每題僅取單一回應，且發布日期只是模型世代的代理變數。此趨勢若持續，可能限縮人機共創中人類接觸到的想法範圍。
papers.title: Are LLMs becoming similarly creative? Evidence from three years of models
papers.title_zh: LLM 的創造力正趨於相似嗎？來自三年模型演進的證據

links.title: Eureka: Task-Conditioned Meta-Agent Orchestration for Scientific Discovery

evidence: Section 4.1-4.3: evaluation protocol and results (170/170 recursive tasks, 3,948 certificates) are entirely internal; no external benchmark, baseline system, or shared-task comparison appears anywhere in Section 4.

Section 4.4: Governed Evolution is compared only against three self-ablations (No Evolution, Always Evolve, Evolve on Stall); median cost 2525.4 and success 60.55% are in undefined cost units on unspecified tasks.

Section 5.3: the mathematical claim lambda_a > 0 for 0 < a <= 0.345 is described as an 'analytic derivation plus an outward-interval certificate candidate' that 'has not yet undergone an independent formal proof replay' and 'does not constitute a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis.'
Section 6.1: the QSOST full-rank conjunction result is self-classified as an 'open-problem solution candidate' still requiring 'external or formal review.'

Sections 1-2: the paper credits obligation/dependency execution to LLMCompiler (Kim et al. 2023), dynamic agent generation to TDAG (Wang et al. 2024), agent-program search to ADAS (Hu et al. 2024), workflow MCTS to AFlow (Zhang et al. 2025), and query-conditioned architectures to MaAS (Zhang et al. 2025), positioning Eureka as a unification rather than a new mechanism.
Section 4.5: context reduction from 9,490 to 4,005 median tokens and 65.38% recomputation avoidance are reported without the underlying task distribution, model, or cost-model definition.

Title page: code availability claimed at github.com/manxis-contact/Eureka, but no base-model specification, seed policy, or task-generation procedure is documented anywhere in the text to enable replay of the 16,000 concurrency or 30,000 promotion-gate experiments.

Sections 3.4-3.8: proofs (e.g., Theorem 3 recursive decomposition soundness, Theorem 8 lease serializability) are correct-looking but follow by standard induction/tower-property arguments, largely restating optimistic concurrency control (Kung & Robinson 1981) and database provenance results.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-preference: the paper's core is LLM-based multi-agent orchestration (Meta-Agent, task planning, agent formation, test-time governance), plus long-horizon reasoning and context compression, all high-weight preference areas. However, quality lags relevance. The theory (Sections 3.1-3.16) is carefully stated with explicit assumptions and honest failure regimes, but most results are formalizations of known techniques (optimistic concurrency serializability, set-cover hardness, MPC receding horizon, hysteresis switch bounds) applied to agent terms; the architectural components (obligation graphs, dynamic agent synthesis, workflow search) are acknowledged derivatives of LLMCompiler, TDAG, ADAS, AFlow, and MaAS. Evidence is weak: every quantitative result (170/170 tasks, 3,948 certificates, 60.55% success, 65.38% recomputation avoided) is self-evaluated on proprietary, undefined task families with no external benchmark and no comparison to any external agent system, only internal ablations; cost units, base LLM identity, seeds, and task provenance are never specified. The headline scientific claims - RH-adjacent Weil positivity to a<=0.345 and QSOST structural results - are explicitly unverified 'certificate candidates' without external or formal review, which the paper itself concedes. Generalization is tested only via internal renaming and within-family transfer. A code URL is given but insufficient for reproduction.

primary_link.title: Eureka: Task-Conditioned Meta-Agent Orchestration for Scientific Discovery

papers.summary: We present Eureka, a task-conditioned Meta-Agent architecture that compiles long-horizon tasks into dynamic obligation graphs with explicit acceptance semantics. During execution, Eureka forms Macro-Agents with specialized state, memory, operators, tools, verifiers, and local topology via receding-horizon planning, architecture promotion, and minimal-sufficient compilation. When bottlenecks recur, cost-benefit-gated evolution updates the local architecture under constraints. Theoretically, we es
papers.summary_zh: 固定架構的代理難以同時勝任結構異質的長期科學任務。Eureka 是任務條件化的 Meta-Agent：它把任務編譯成帶明確驗收語義的動態義務圖，以後退視界規劃與 ready-frontier 背壓只在資訊可確定處展開；當持續狀態共用與依賴密度顯示局部自治有正攤銷價值時，才促升為具專屬狀態、算子、驗證器與拓撲的 Macro-Agent，並在成本效益門檻下進行受治理的自我演化。論文附帶形式理論：固定架構遺憾下界、規劃失效、攤銷門檻、遞迴分解可靠性、子樹 ABI 資訊充分性與並行可序列化。實驗上 170/170 遞迴任務完成、產出 3,948 張驗收憑證且無未認證接受；編譯上下文由 9,490 降至 4,005 tokens，增量依賴重建避免 65.38% 重算，16,000 個並行執行皆可序列化。科學側：數學代理將 Suzuki 局部 Weil 正定性憑證候選推進至 0<a≤69/200=0.345，約達首質數門檻的 99.55%（明言非 RH 證明）；理論代理提出 QSOST 全秩合取候選等五組結構結果，部分仍待外部或形式審查。此工作把代理架構本身變成可在執行中形成與演化的對象。
papers.title: Eureka: Task-Conditioned Meta-Agent Orchestration for Scientific Discovery
papers.title_zh: Eureka：以任務條件化 Meta-Agent 編排邁向科學發現

links.title: Training-Free Inference-Time Self-Reflection and Cost-Bounded Early Stopping for Large Language Models

evidence: Abstract: 'the CONFIRMED early stop terminates 82-88% of items at equal accuracy, bounding inference to ~2.1 generations per question' on BBH
Section 4.9 / Table 11: GSM8K 93.6% -> 97.8% (+4.2pp), MATH 26.2% -> 40.4% (+14.2pp) at n=500 with disjoint 95% Wilson CIs; Section 4.9 reports McNemar p<0.01 on both benchmarks

Section 4.8 / Table 10: every threshold tau>=0.6 halts the loop at 1.00 average steps (declared confidence overconfident); Section 4.12 marks H6 REFUTED, sentinel identified as the effective cost-bounder
Section 4.11 / Table 13: Qwen2.5-72B replication — MATH 31.6% -> 43.2% (McNemar p<0.05), BBH 78.2% -> 78.4% (not significant), early-stop 81%/78%
Section 4.6.1 / Table 8: sentinel confusion matrix at n=500 — 16% false positives (confirming incorrect answers) 'fundamentally caps the loop's maximum accuracy'
Section 3.1.2: 'At inference time, R_meta is not computed numerically: there is no reward network... Equations (1)-(4) state a design principle' — components are prompt-level only

Section 5.2 Limitations: benchmarks 'cannot validate the tool-call-diversity reward or environment-level adversarial filtering'; GRPO blueprint 'not executed'; session sensitivity of ~7pp on identical BBH anchors
Section 4.1.1 / Table 3: matched-compute comparison — fixed-depth Self-Refine over-corrects to 71.2% on BBH; EvoResearcher 74.0% at 2.15 avg generations
Data Availability Statement: code, BBH subset, and scripts 'released as open-source under the MIT License' at a GitHub URL; dataset on HuggingFace (availability not verifiable from document)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-topic LLM paper: training-free inference-time self-reflection with cost-bounded early stopping over frozen backbones, evaluated on BBH/GSM8K/MATH. Preference relevance is high (LLM reasoning, inference-time scaling, prompting mechanisms), though the agent/tool-use framing is blueprint-only. Novelty is modest: generate-critique-revise loops are well established (Self-Refine, Reflexion, CRITIC per Section 2.3), and the headline 'meta-reward' is explicitly never computed numerically (Section 3.1.2) — the actual contribution reduces to a CONFIRMED-sentinel early stop plus prompt framing. Rigor is mixed: good practices (Wilson CIs, matched-compute baselines in Table 3, McNemar tests at n=500, refuted hypotheses honestly reported) but many cells at n=100 with ~8.7pp CI half-widths, an admitted ~7pp session variance on identical backbone/questions (Section 4.8 caveat), and a single weak adversarial probe (E5). Evidence is reasonably strong for the central claims: sentinel early-stops 82-88% at flat BBH accuracy (Table 7), +4.2pp GSM8K and +14.2pp MATH at n=500 with disjoint CIs and McNemar p<0.01 (Table 11), replicated on Qwen2.5-72B (+11.6pp MATH, Table 13). Generalizability is limited to pure-reasoning benchmarks; tool-call diversity and the RL/multi-agent blueprints are unvalidated (Section 5.2). Reproducibility claims (MIT GitHub repo, HuggingFace data) are present but unverifiable from the text, the backbone is an unspecified API model, and the mismatched corresponding-author email is a minor integrity flag. Overall: a credible, honest, but incremental empirical study wrapped in an overstated framework narrative.

primary_link.title: Training-Free Inference-Time Self-Reflection and Cost-Bounded Early Stopping for Large Language Models

papers.summary: Reinforcement-learning training of reasoning LLMs (e.g., GRPO) is expensive and requires a controllable environment, committing every contribution to a full training pipeline. We present EvoResearcher, a training-free, inference-time protocol that adds cost-bounded self-reflection to a single frozen LLM backbone. The protocol iterates generate -> self-critique -> revise until a maximum depth D is reached or the critique returns the CONFIRMED sentinel, an implicit early stop that lets the backbon
papers.summary_zh: 以強化學習（如 GRPO）訓練推理型 LLM 昂貴且依賴可控環境，而固定深度的反思迴圈又成本失控。本文提出 EvoResearcher：免訓練的推論期協定，在單一凍結骨幹上迭代「生成→自我批判→修訂」，並以 CONFIRMED 哨兵訊號、最大深度 D 與選用的信心門檻 τ 嚴格控制運算預算；四個元獎勵成分（正確性、效率、反思深度、工具多樣性）以提示層機制實作。在 BBH、GSM8K、MATH 上以 deepseek-v4-flash 評估，並於 Qwen2.5-72B 重現：乾淨 BBH 上準確率持平（約 74%），但 82–88% 的題目被提前停止，平均僅約 2.1 次生成；在單次推理較弱的 GSM8K 與 MATH 上，迴圈分別提升 4.2 與 14.2 個百分點（n=500 具統計顯著性），同時維持早停。信心門檻掃描顯示模型自我報告過度自信，τ≥0.6 均立即收斂至單次生成，故有效的成本控制機制是哨兵而非信心標籤。限制：僅涵蓋純推理基準，工具多樣性與多代理設計仍屬未驗證藍圖，結果亦受 API 會話變異影響。此協定為推論期運算擴展提供了務實替代方案。
papers.title: Training-Free Inference-Time Self-Reflection and Cost-Bounded Early Stopping for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 大型語言模型的免訓練推論期自我反思與成本上限早停

links.title: ReWEIGH the Evidence: Calibrating Token-Level Ordinal Visual Evidence to Mitigate Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models

evidence: Abstract: 'ReWEIGH reduces hallucinated object mentions by up to 21.3% ... the average added latency is 1.33% per token' across four 7B backbones and 11 models to 32B.
Section 3.1/Figure 1: rank-10 probability p90/p10 spread is 13.8x (LLaVA-1.5-7B) and 7.8x (Qwen2.5-VL-7B); affine equalization only reduces this to 11.0x and 4.2x, motivating the ordinal readout.
Section 3.2/Figure 3 and Appendix Table 12: token-specific medians reduce out-of-sample reference error by 92%/91% versus a global reference and beat all 1,000 shuffled-reference permutations.

Appendix B.4/Table 13: standalone detection AUROC favors probability (0.718 vs 0.679 on LLaVA-1.5-7B), yet under matched edit budget the calibrated rank intervention lowers CHAIR_S to 44.8 vs 50.0 — an honest negative result the authors use to scope their claim.

Section 5.1/Appendix A.2: layer and beta selected once per backbone on 500 seed-42 COCO train2014 images, with CHAIR reported on a disjoint 500-image val2014 subset; baselines VCD, OPERA, DoLa, PAI, ReVisiT use official implementations.

Table 3/Tables 20-21: global, shuffled, and mismatched-evidence ablations recover less than half of the CHAIR_S reduction; no-abstention changes metrics by ~0.4 points, which the authors report rather than overclaim.

Limitations: method 'cannot operate through closed APIs', requires per-backbone calibration tables and tuned operating points, and is evaluated only in English; transfer across models/languages untested.

Appendix A.5/Table 16: hardware, library versions, seeds, and cost accounting (1.33% cached, 2.40% end-to-end latency, 0.31% memory, 375 KiB/image cache) are documented, but no code or artifact release is stated.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A training-free decoding intervention for LVLM hallucination that aggregates vocabulary ranks (DMRR) over visual-token logit-lens readouts and applies token-specific, uncertainty-gated, bounded logit penalties. It sits squarely in multimodal/VLM hallucination-and-grounding work with interpretability-style internal readouts and inference-efficiency claims, so it matches mid-weight preferences (Multimodal AI, hallucination/factuality, interpretability, inference) rather than the highest-weight topics (LLM-only, Japanese NLP, agents, reasoning); it is not pure CV because the method operates on LM logits and decoding. Novelty is incremental over ReVisiT/logit-lens decoding lines, with the token-specific reference calibration and stability-based abstention as the main new ingredients. Rigor and evidence are strong: matched-edit-budget controls, permutation nulls, bootstrap CIs, component ablations, counterfactual evidence substitution, calibration-size/corpus sweeps, disjoint tuning/eval splits, and consistent CHAIR_I reductions (10.3–21.3%) across four 7B backbones plus 11 models from six families (7B–32B), with measured 1.33% cached latency overhead. Generalizability is good but per-backbone calibration/tuned operating points, white-box-only access, and English-only evaluation are acknowledged limits. Reproducibility detail is excellent (seeds, grids, environments, traces) though no explicit code release is stated.

primary_link.title: ReWEIGH the Evidence: Calibrating Token-Level Ordinal Visual Evidence to Mitigate Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models

papers.summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) often hallucinate, generating content that the input image does not support. Preventing such content during decoding calls for a candidate-specific measure of how strongly the image supports the token under consideration. The model's visual-token states offer a natural source of this evidence because projecting each state through the output head reveals which vocabulary items that position favors. These position-wise readouts cannot be pooled directly because
papers.summary_zh: 大型視覺語言模型（LVLM）常生成影像不支持的幻覺內容。本文提出免訓練的解碼介入方法 ReWEIGH，利用模型內部視覺標記狀態作為證據來源：將各視覺位置的隱藏狀態投影至詞彙表，讀出該位置偏好哪些詞。由於各位置的機率量級不可直接比較（同一序位的機率跨位置可相差逾一個數量級，仿射尺度校正亦無法消除離散），作者改用尺度不變的詞彙排名，以密集平均倒數排名（DMRR）彙整所有視覺位置的證據。考量不同詞元的典型證據水位各異（詞間差異解釋約 66% 變異），方法先在未標註影像上離線校正每個詞元的參考中位數，僅註冊估計穩定的詞元；推論時於 prefill 計算並快取影像證據，只對低於自身參考的候選詞施加有上限的 logit 懲罰。在四個 7B 主幹上，CHAIR_I 最多下降 21.3%，並大致維持或提升描述與通用多模態效能；結果更擴及六個架構家族、7B 至 32B 共 11 個模型，證據快取後每 token 平均僅增加 1.33% 延遲。限制包括需存取內部狀態而無法用於封閉 API、各主幹需個別校正，且僅在英文情境驗證。此研究顯示內部視覺證據的詞序校正可成為輕量且有效的幻覺緩解介面。
papers.title: ReWEIGH the Evidence: Calibrating Token-Level Ordinal Visual Evidence to Mitigate Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models
papers.title_zh: ReWEIGH：以詞序視覺證據校正緩解大型視覺語言模型的幻覺

links.title: Bayesian Partner Modelling enables Adaptive Replanning for LLM Coordination

evidence: Sec. 5.5 / Table 4: on Open G1, Full attains 1533 reward with 2.0 replans/ep vs Periodic-10 1490/43.0, Completion/held-item 1510/169.0, LLM-judge 1480/119.0
Sec. 5.3 / Table 2: skill accuracy nearly identical (0.79 vs 0.78 Open) while gap rate drops 0.41→0.20 (Open) and 0.38→0.28 (Ring)
Appendix 11.2 / Table 8: paired Full−No replan bootstrap CIs exclude zero for gap rate in 5 of 7 settings but for reward only in Open G1 and Open G3
Sec. 5.2: authors state TALENTS and GAMMA 'remain stronger than the LLM-based methods in most environments' and the LLM planner is a bottleneck

Sec. 4.1 Eq. 8: partner action likelihood approximated by the ego agent's own low-level controller; Sec. 11.6: complementary ground truth is a single authored lookup table with 'no independent raters'

Appendix 9.3 Table 6 and Appendix 10.3: full hyperparameters (θ_obs=0.04, Γ_conf=0.65, cooldown 6, temperature 0.0) and complete system prompts provided; Sec. 9.1 notes partner checkpoints 'supplied with the code'
Sec. 6 Limitations: fixed manually specified coarse skills, weaker in Forced Coordination, no human partners with within-episode strategy shifts
llm_evaluation.rationale: On-topic LLM-agent paper: hierarchical LLM planner (GPT-4o/GPT-5.2) with Bayesian partner-skill tracking used as a control signal for selective mid-skill interruption in multi-agent coordination. Strong fit to Agents/LLM preferences, though set in a game testbed rather than production agentic workflows. Novelty is moderate: the mechanism composes known Bayesian inverse planning (Baker/Wu/Jin) and LLM hierarchical planning; the contribution is the posterior-gated interruption rule and the belief-action-gap diagnostic framing built on Riemer et al.'s literal-functional ToM gap. Rigor is above average: formal hierarchical POSG formulation, 9 settings x 5 seeds x 4 partners, four ablations isolating posterior-as-context vs posterior-as-control, one-at-a-time sensitivity, paired bootstrap CIs with honest null results (Appendix 11.2), and candid limitations (Sec. 5.2/6: RL baselines TALENTS/GAMMA still beat all LLM agents in most layouts; minimal benefit in Forced Coordination). Weaknesses: high variance (e.g., 663±468), only 5 seeds, hand-authored deterministic complementary-skill ground truth with no independent raters (Sec. 11.6), approximate partner likelihood reusing the ego controller (Eq. 8), and some ablation cells where No belief outperforms Full (Table 3, Ring G3). Evidence clearly supports the replan-efficiency claim (2.0 vs 43-169 replans/ep, Table 4) and gap-rate reduction at matched skill accuracy (0.20 vs 0.41, Table 2), but reward superiority over baselines is not established. Generalizability is limited to one Overcooked/Burrito domain, a fixed 27-skill hand-specified library, and synthetic shaped-reward partners with no human evaluation. Reproducibility is good: full algorithm pseudocode, complete prompts (Appendix 10), hyperparameters (Table 6), seeds, and baseline code links; own-code availability is only implied via supplied partner checkpoints.

primary_link.title: Bayesian Partner Modelling enables Adaptive Replanning for LLM Coordination

papers.summary: Multi-agent Large Language Model (LLM) systems often struggle to collaborate with new teammates whose strategies shift mid-task. Because agents execute multi-step or temporally extended skills, they frequently continue executing outdated plans long after public evidence shows that a partner has changed its skill. Existing methods either treat partner tracking as passive context-leaving the agent aware of the shift but slow to act-or replan indiscriminately. We introduce BayesBeliefAgent, which p
papers.summary_zh: LLM 多代理系統與隊友協作時，常在夥伴策略已改變後仍執行過時技能，形成「信念—行動落差」：即使正確推斷夥伴意圖（字面心智理論），也未據此調整行為（功能心智理論）。本文提出 BayesBeliefAgent，將階層式 LLM 規劃器與輕量貝葉斯追蹤模組結合：代理對隊友正在執行的技能維持後驗信念，以自身低階控制器近似預測夥伴動作；唯有當夥伴的公開動作與目前 MAP 技能估計相矛盾（似然低於門檻），且估計穩定、信心充足、代理正在技能執行中並已脫離冷卻期時，才中斷當前技能並以更新後的後驗重新規劃。在 Overcooked/Burrito 三種佈局、12 個行為偏好夥伴的評測中，方法於 Open 佈局將信念—行動落差率從 0.41 降至 0.20，Ring 從 0.38 降至 0.28，矛盾後的互補技能選擇與重複技能率同步改善；相較定期、事件觸發或 LLM 評審等通用重新規劃啟發式，本方法每集僅約 2 次重新規劃即可達相近獎勵（對照 43–169 次）。消融顯示後驗作為控制訊號比僅作為提示脈絡更有效。限制在於技能集為人工指定的粗粒度集合，在緊耦合的 Forced Coordination 佈局效益有限，且 RL 基線（TALENTS、GAMMA）仍較強，凸顯高階 LLM 規劃器仍是瓶頸。
papers.title: Bayesian Partner Modelling enables Adaptive Replanning for LLM Coordination
papers.title_zh: 貝葉斯夥伴建模讓 LLM 協調能進行適應性重新規劃

links.title: CAViAR: A Causal Video Dataset for Fine-Grained Accident Reasoning in Real-World Scenarios

evidence: Abstract: introduces CAViAR with 2,249 real-world accident videos from CCD and Nexar, annotated with at-fault agent, affected agent, and rule-violation categories
Table 1: claims CAViAR is the only listed dataset providing At-Fault and Rule Violation supervision alongside VQA, causal, and dense captions
Table 3: fine-tuning gains are large for 2B models (e.g., Qwen3-2B MCQ +11.49) but marginal for 8B models (e.g., InternVL3-8B -0.23), supporting the scaling-insufficiency claim
Table 5: Weather accuracy (58.4/62.6) falls below the majority baseline (73.0) while Lighting is nearly solved (98.6/98.7), supporting uneven perceptual competence
Sec 4.2: judge validation on N=45 samples with Spearman ρ=0.851, Pearson r=0.882, and annotator κ=0.579
Sec 4.1: one run per model with bootstrap 95% CIs (≈±1.7 MCQ points) exceeding all 8B MCQ deltas; no validation split or early stopping
Table 7 + Sec 5: CCD holdout ablation shows MCQ 62.17-67.92% comparable to cross-corpus results, arguing the gap is not solely domain shift
Table 8: quantifies train/test shift (Accident Type TVD=0.362, majority class flips T-Bone→None)
Sec 5.1: limitations admit no formal inter-annotator agreement, no human baseline, and only open-weight VLM coverage
Sec 7: releases annotations, splits, prompts, frame indices, and scripts but not video files due to CCD/Nexar licensing
llm_evaluation.rationale: A video benchmark paper evaluating vision-language models on causal/responsibility reasoning for traffic accidents. Preference relevance is moderate: it involves VLM evaluation, LLM-as-judge, LoRA fine-tuning, and reasoning-gap analysis (relevant to reasoning, multimodal, and evaluation preferences), but the core contribution is a driving-domain dataset rather than core LLM methodology; it does not fall under the out-of-scope caps since language models are central to the evaluation. Novelty is solid but incremental: the responsibility annotation layer (at-fault agent, affected agent, rule violation) over existing CCD/Nexar footage is genuinely new per Table 1, though the Perception-Reasoning Gap finding confirms known VLM weaknesses. Rigor is above average: majority/random baselines, balanced accuracy, macro-F1, bootstrap CIs, human validation of the judge, TVD/JSD shift quantification, and a CCD holdout ablation isolating domain shift. Evidence strength is good but tempered by single-run experiments, no validation split, only 45-sample judge validation, and no reported inter-annotator agreement. Generalizability is limited by ego-view dashcam bias and source-corpus shifts, which the authors acknowledge. Reproducibility is reasonably strong (code, prompts, splits, scripts, fixed seeds, detailed hyperparameters) though videos cannot be redistributed.

primary_link.title: CAViAR: A Causal Video Dataset for Fine-Grained Accident Reasoning in Real-World Scenarios

papers.summary: While modern autonomous driving systems excel at perception tasks such as object detection and trajectory prediction, they lack the high-level causal reasoning required to interpret traffic accidents. In particular, determining responsibility, such as identifying who is at fault and which traffic rule was violated, remains largely unexplored in current benchmarks. To this end, we introduce CAViAR (Causal Accident Video and Incident Analysis Repository), a human-annotated dashcam benchmark compri
papers.summary_zh: 自駕系統擅長物件偵測與軌跡預測等感知任務，卻缺乏解讀交通事故所需的高階因果與責任推理。本文發表 CAViAR，一個人工標註的行車記錄器影片基準，含 2,249 段真實事故影片（取自 CCD 與 Nexar）與 20,108 個問答對，涵蓋環境條件、事故類型、因果說明，以及先前基準欠缺的結構化責任標註：表面肇事方、受影響用路人與表面違規類別（採司法管轄無關的十一類規則本體）。標註由兩位主要標註者與兩位審核者以初標加審查流程完成，GPT-4 僅用於語法潤飾而不新增事實。評測採 CCD 訓練、Nexar 測試的無洩漏切分，對象為 Cosmos-Reason2、Qwen3-VL 與 InternVL3（各含 2B/8B，零樣本與 LoRA 微調）。結果呈現明確的「感知—推理落差」：光照辨識近乎解決，但天氣與路況準確率在多數類基線上下；事故類型與責任推理大幅退化，違規識別即使微調後仍僅約 0.8/5.0，且模型傾向過度預測追撞。8B 模型微調增益有限，CCD 同源保留測試顯示領域偏移並非唯一因素，瓶頸在於將視覺證據映射至規則與代理角色。此基準揭露安全關鍵駕駛場景的推理瓶頸，有助推動接地感知的多模態推理研究。
papers.title: CAViAR: A Causal Video Dataset for Fine-Grained Accident Reasoning in Real-World Scenarios
papers.title_zh: CAViAR：真實場景細粒度事故推理之因果影片資料集

links.title: Beyond LLM-Based Reasoning: Lightweight GNNs for Agent Failure Attribution

evidence: Abstract & Sec. 1: claims AFANet 'matches or outperforms LLM-based baselines, including fine-tuned models on in-domain benchmarks' with far fewer parameters and near-zero inference cost.
Table 1 (Sec. 4.2): AFANet avg 24.82 vs Qwen2.5-14B-It+S avg 26.51; AFANet leads in-domain pair-level (17.42 muF1 / 16.35 MF1 vs 16.62 / 9.99) and OOD pair-level (6.90 / 4.16 vs 4.03 / 2.08).
Table 2 (Sec. 4.2): AFANet 65K trainable params, 1.1 hr training, 1.16s/0.37s inference vs 7B SFT 6 hrs, 199s/108s inference.
Sec. 4.1: 2-layer GCN default, hidden dim 64, Adam lr 1e-2, all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings, NVIDIA V100; ranking-based decoding used on Who&When, threshold-based on AEGIS-Bench.
Tables 3-4 (Sec. 4.3): backbone sensitivity (GCN/GAT/GraphSAGE, 1-3 layers) and ablations (no edges, w/o dev/stat features 21.04 avg, w/o GNN 22.24 avg) support design claims.
Table 5 (Sec. 4.3): TTA improves Who&When avg only from 13.96 to 14.75 (best variant Pair-Faulty).
Appendix B: AEGIS-Bench test 600, Who&When test 184 conversations; both datasets MIT licensed.
NeurIPS Checklist Q7 answered [No] for error bars/statistical significance; Q5 states code 'available upon acceptance' with datasets public (Sec. 4.1 footnotes 1-2, GitHub AEGIS codebase footnote 3).
Appendix E: limitations include challenging OOD generalization and that failures requiring deeper semantic understanding/long-horizon reasoning may be missed.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope agents/LLM-systems paper: diagnosing faulty agents and error types in failed LLM multi-agent trajectories maps directly to the Agents & Tool Use preference (agent misbehavior/recovery, multi-agent, agentic) with secondary relevance to LLMs, efficiency, and GNNs; the method itself is LLM-free (2-layer GCN over TF-IDF/SVD/deviation features), which dilutes but does not remove LLM relevance since baselines and problem framing are LLM-centric. Novelty is moderate: the contrarian reframing (structured lightweight modeling suffices, no LLM reasoning needed) is the main contribution, while components (GCN, dual pooling, TENT-style TTA) are standard. Rigor is decent (edge/feature/GNN ablations, backbone sensitivity, transparent re-implementations marked with **, efficiency table) but weakened by admitted lack of error bars/significance (Checklist Q7: [No]), a small OOD test set (184 conversations, Appendix B), and dataset-dependent decoding choices (threshold in-domain vs ranking on Who&When, Sec. 4.1). Evidence is detailed but partly stretched: Table 1 shows AFANet avg 24.82 vs Qwen2.5-14B-It+S avg 26.51, so 'matches or outperforms fine-tuned models' holds mainly on the argued-most-important pair-level metrics (in-domain pair 17.42/16.35 vs 16.62/9.99) and OOD pair-level, not on average or agent/error-level OOD; single-run results with mixed baseline reproduction (7B+S** 19.97 vs 17.99 reported). Generalizability is limited to two related benchmarks, with marginal TTA gains (13.96 to 14.75 avg, Table 5) and acknowledged reasoning-depth limits (Appendix E). Reproducibility is strong on hyperparameters, public MIT-licensed datasets, and AEGIS codebase links, but code is only promised upon acceptance.

primary_link.title: Beyond LLM-Based Reasoning: Lightweight GNNs for Agent Failure Attribution

papers.summary: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) often exhibit complex failure modes, which frequently cause agents to produce incorrect outcomes. This motivates the task of Agent Failure Attribution: given a failed multi-agent trajectory, identify the faulty agents and their corresponding error types. Existing approaches predominantly rely on LLMs to perform failure attribution, either through direct prompting, fine-tuning on synthetic data or complex agentic pipelines. While effectiv
papers.summary_zh: LLM 多代理系統的失敗常源於某個代理引入錯誤並透過互動傳播。既有的代理失敗歸因（AFA）方法多依賴 LLM 直接提示、在合成資料上微調或複雜的代理管線，不僅運算成本高，準確率亦有限。本文質疑重量級生成式解法的必要性，提出輕量圖神經網路框架 AFANet：將失敗軌跡轉為以對話輪次為節點的異質圖，邊包含相鄰輪次的時間連結與同一代理輪次間的連結；節點特徵結合 TF-IDF 經 SVD 降維後計算的偏離訊號（如與前輪、自身歷史、對話重心的餘弦偏離）、統計特徵，以及句向量語意特徵，經 GCN 等訊息傳遞後以平均與最大雙重池化取得代理表示，再以代理層二元故障偵測與錯誤類型分類的雙目標訓練。在 AEGIS-Bench（同分布）與 Who&When（分布外）上，僅 65K 參數的 AFANet 達到與微調後 LLM 及專有模型相當或更佳的平均表現，訓練僅約 1.1 小時、推論近乎零成本，遠低於 LLM 微調加 GRPO 的數十小時。結果對不同 GNN 架構與深度穩健，測試時熵最小化調適可進一步改善 OOD 表現。限制為跨顯著不同多代理設定的泛化仍具挑戰，部分失敗仍需深度語意理解；此研究顯示結構化建模已足以完成有效歸因。
papers.title: Beyond LLM-Based Reasoning: Lightweight GNNs for Agent Failure Attribution
papers.title_zh: 超越 LLM 推理：以輕量 GNN 進行代理失敗歸因

links.title: Squeezing the Cache, Preserving the Truth: Monotonic Equipotential Allocation with Geodesia-KV

evidence: Section 1/Abstract: training-free KV policies with 'monotonic block-wise precision allocation, exact rate-distortion residuals, and query-sparse reading' targeting hardware-ready compression.

Section 4.3: paired cluster bootstrap (20,000 draws) mapping mean paired NLL difference to log perplexity ratio; 'the eleven-window PG-19 test re-executed produces exactly the previously published six-window aggregates.'

Section 5.3: authors state the 5-bit point margin (0.10%) has a CI including one and 'the justified claim neither proves the superiority nor disproves the equality,' acknowledging Table 1 margins lack CIs.
Section 5.8 'Lessons Learned': records failed variants (spectral K–V states, Born gating, Hadamard rotation, layer profiles) that 'helped in one window, but hurt the other.'

Section 6: claims '100.0% Needle-In-A-Haystack (NIAH) retrieval accuracy' and 71.4–71.5% VRAM reduction across Qwen2.5-7B/14B, Llama-3.1-8B, Mistral-7B-v0.3, DeepSeek-V2-Lite with no supporting protocol, table, or ablation—largely unsupported relative to the paper's own standards.
Section 4.4: baselines are 'local semantic ports... not the executions of original version-pinned kernels,' and 'not substitute for an official code benchmark.'

Section 4.1: pinned model revisions (aa8e7253, b968826d), pinned dataset revisions, and preregistered PG-19 window offsets; Section 5.1/5.2 report effects under one percent with honest win-count reporting.
Related Work: 'We employ WikiText-2 and PG-19 for controlled language-model loss, and treat the absence of RULER/LongBench as a limitation.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: KV-cache compression for long-context LLM inference is squarely on-topic (LLM serving efficiency, long context, quantization, vLLM deployment). The method itself is an incremental combination of known ingredients (scalar quantization ladders, attention-mass saliency, Quest-style sparse reads) in a crowded field, but the evaluation methodology contribution—separating resident vs. read bits, causal Q=1 decoding to avoid chunked teacher-forcing artifacts, paired cluster-bootstrap CIs, preregistered windows, and a candid negative-results section—is unusually honest. Weaknesses: primary perplexity margins (0.04%–0.39%) are admitted to be statistically indistinguishable; headline Section 6 claims (100% NIAH accuracy, five model families, 71.7% VRAM savings, 1M-token context) lack any detailed protocol, tables, or ablations and are inconsistent with the primary experiments' two-model scope; baselines are 'local semantic ports' rather than official kernels; corpora are limited to WikiText-2/PG-19 with RULER/LongBench explicitly omitted. Pinned model/dataset revisions, manifests, regression tests, and byte-reproducible runs support reproducibility, though no explicit code release is stated.

primary_link.title: Squeezing the Cache, Preserving the Truth: Monotonic Equipotential Allocation with Geodesia-KV

papers.summary: Current assessment of KV-cache compression performance confuses resident bits with read bandwidth and is affected by the artifacts of chunked teacher-forcing. We present Geodesia-KV, a family of training-free KV cache policies based on monotonic block-wise precision allocation, exact rate-distortion residuals, and query-sparse reading, enabling proper hardware-ready compression. With proper separation of resident and read bits and causal evaluation, we show that Geodesia-KV significantly outperf
papers.summary_zh: 長情境 LLM 推論中,KV 快取記憶體隨上下文長度線性成長,且現有壓縮評估常把常駐位元與讀取頻寬混為一談,分塊 teacher-forcing 亦造成評測失真。本文提出 Geodesia-KV,一套免訓練的 KV 快取策略:將快取切成 64-token 區塊,依單調位元階梯 {16,8,4,2,centroid} 進行區塊級精度分配,以拉格朗日方式求解率失真最佳化,並用因果式 EMA 注意力質量避免未來查詢資訊洩漏;compressed-Quest 變體則儲存精確鍵值盒以支援查詢稀疏讀取。方法以原生 vLLM 外掛 GeodesiaKVCacheManager 整合,徹底免除稠密快取常駐。實驗採嚴格 Q=1 增量協定與叢集自助信賴區間:在 Qwen 模型上,5-bit 操作點以更低位元率達到與 KIVI-4 相當的困惑度;PG-19 十一本書完整測試中,compressed-Quest 相較 Quest 以 39.5% 更低常駐率與 15.4% 更低讀取率取得統計顯著的困惑度改善。系統層面於 RTX 4090 實測 71.7% 尖峰 VRAM 節省,在單張 16 GiB 消費級 GPU 實現 1M-token 情境生成,Needle-In-A-Haystack 檢索準確率 100%。作者誠實指出多數困惑度差距僅 0.1% 至 0.4%,部分比較信賴區間涵蓋一,並記錄量子啟發、Hadamard 旋轉等大量負面結果;容量分析顯示實際上限受限於訓練位置窗口而非快取記憶體。其價值在於建立因果、可重現且區分常駐與讀取位元的評測基準,並證明率失真理論可落地於量產推論系統。

links.title: LLM as Detector: An In-context Learning Approach for Tabular Anomaly Detection

§4.3 Knowledge ablation (Figure 5): causal-only 0.5902, statistics-only 0.7112, stats+causal 0.7245, full 0.7407, showing modest gain beyond statistics.

§3.2 Requirements: prompt fixes score decomposition into three terms with fixed budgets and bounded [0,100] output, i.e., the detection logic structure is pre-specified rather than LLM-discovered.
Appendix 4 (Figure 10): full prompt template includes dataset name, sample size, and feature count; distilled sample block truncated, and no code or data release is mentioned anywhere.
Appendix 2 Table 4: per-dataset AUC-ROC with standard deviations; e.g., LLM-Detector 0.9714 on SMD but 0.5189 on ACD where all methods are ~0.50.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-centric methodology paper: in-context code synthesis of a tabular anomaly scoring engine (Gemini-3.0, with DeepSeek V3.2/GPT-5.2 ablations), squarely engaging LLM, prompting/ICL, and code-generation preferences, though the application domain (tabular anomaly detection) is peripheral to the listed topics and out-of-scope categories do not apply. Evaluation is fairly broad (24 datasets, 15 baselines, AUC-ROC and F1 with stds over 3 seeds, plus ablations on knowledge components, backbones, N_distill, and causal discovery algorithms). Key weaknesses: the prompt pre-specifies the exact three-component scoring structure (outlier/causal/density with fixed budgets), so the LLM largely instantiates a hand-designed pipeline (z-scores, PC-algorithm causal violations, Mahalanobis) rather than free-form reasoning; the decisive ablation against an equivalent non-LLM handcrafted ensemble is missing; thresholds tau_c/tau_p are unexplained; dataset name/context is injected into the prompt, slightly undermining the unsupervised framing; and no code/data release is stated. Gains are real but driven by a subset of datasets (e.g., Fraud 0.7100, SMD 0.9714, NHIS 0.8848) while many datasets are near-random for all methods (ACD ~0.50, SPD ~0.50).

primary_link.title: LLM as Detector: An In-context Learning Approach for Tabular Anomaly Detection

papers.summary: Anomaly detection in tabular data is challenging because abnormal samples often arise as violations of cross-feature dependencies rather than simple marginal deviations. Existing detectors rely on geometric or reconstruction signals, while prior LLM-based approaches mainly fine-tune LLMs with normal samples or generate synthetic anomalies. We propose LLM-Detector, a framework that utilizes the in-context learning capacity of LLMs for structured, prompt-conditioned scoring synthesis, enabling LLM
papers.summary_zh: 表格異常偵測中,異常樣本常源於跨特徵依賴關係的違反,而非單純的邊際偏離;現有方法多仰賴重建誤差或密度稀疏性,既有 LLM 方法則需微調或合成異常樣本,成本高昂。本文提出 LLM-Detector,一個運用情境學習、完全免微調的兩階段框架:第一階段 Knowledge-to-Code 將正常訓練資料轉為統計輪廓、以 PC 演算法估計的因果圖(DAG),以及經 K-Means 蒸餾並映射回真實樣本的原型,組成結構化提示詞,再由 LLM 生成確定性的 Python 評分引擎;第二階段 Code-to-Score 執行引擎,對每個測試樣本計算三項有界分數:統計偏離 S_outlier、因果結構違反 S_causal,以及以馬氏距離為基礎的密度異常 S_density,聚合為 0 到 100 的異常分數。在 24 個表格資料集、15 個 SOTA 基線的評測中,LLM-Detector 於 12 個混合型資料集取得平均 AUC-ROC 0.7407,較次佳的 AnoLLM(0.6972)提升約 5%,於 12 個連續型資料集亦達頂尖(約 0.91)。消融實驗顯示三類知識缺一不可:僅因果知識為 0.5902,加統計資訊升至 0.7245,再加蒸餾樣本達 0.7407;Gemini-3.0、GPT-5.2 與 DeepSeek V3.2 後端皆有效,不同因果發現方法下結論亦穩健,且測試階段僅執行輕量程式,速度遠快於需訓練的方法。限制在於生成程式品質取決於 LLM 的程式碼合成能力,且因果圖屬估計值未必還原真實結構。此研究展示情境學習可作為程式碼合成機制,為領域感知的異常偵測提供輕量、隱私友善且免訓練的新典範。

links.title: A Multi-Agent Platform for Automated Enterprise Analytics and Insight Generation

evidence: Abstract: reports 95.3% functional accuracy over 300 end-to-end test cases, 24s mean latency, 4.52/5.0 LLM-as-a-Judge quality, 93.0% hallucination-free rate, and 22.6pp accuracy improvement over a single-agent baseline.

Section 3.2/3.3: five-agent sequential CrewAI crew (Data Retrieval, Data Analysis, Report Aggregation, Follow-up Questions, Chart Configuration) plus a query parameterization mechanism converting WHERE-clause literals into reusable dashboard filters.

Section 5.1.3: single-agent baseline uses the same GPT-4.1 model and BigQuery tooling in one prompt; full 300-test suite replicated across GPT-4.1, Claude Sonnet 4, Gemini 2.5 Flash, and self-hosted Llama 3.1 70B; 100 responses scored by three domain experts.

Section 5.2.1 Table 1: 286/300 (95.3%) total, Security Guardrails 40/40 (100%), Complex Analytics 26/30 (86.7%), Multi-Turn 21/25 (84.0%); Table 6: single-agent baseline 218/300 (72.7%) with security only 52.5%.
Section 5.2.6 Table 8: ablation shows removing Data Analysis Agent drops quality to 3.38 and hallucination-free rate to 85.0%, while functional accuracy remains 95.3% across configurations.
Section 5.2.7 Table 9: Llama 3.1 70B in the pipeline reaches 79.7% accuracy, exceeding the single-agent GPT-4.1 baseline (72.7%), supporting the architecture-over-model claim.
Section 5.2.8: human evaluation of 100 sampled responses yields Pearson r=0.89, inter-annotator κ=0.82, with a +0.14 LLM-judge positive bias concentrated in Actionability.

Section 5.4 Limitations: authors acknowledge single-domain enterprise data, human evaluation covering only 100 of 260 analytical responses, four-model cross evaluation, and inherent sequential latency.

Reproducibility gap: no code, prompt templates, test suite, or dataset release is mentioned anywhere in the paper; Section 5.1.1 notes the production dataset is internal enterprise data with Japanese-language product content.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core agentic-LLM systems paper squarely matching high-weight preferences (multi-agent orchestration via CrewAI, MCP tool use, text-to-SQL, LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation, security guardrails/prompt-injection defense, business workflow productization, with secondary Japanese-language content in the enterprise dataset). Evaluation design is unusually thorough for an industry paper: 300-test suite with per-category breakdowns, single-agent baseline (95.3% vs 72.7%), agent ablations (Table 8), cross-model replication over four backends (Table 9), and human validation of the judge (r=0.89, κ=0.82, Section 5.2.8). Numbers are internally consistent (286/300, 218/300, 243/260). Weaknesses: novelty is incremental over SiriusBI/MetaGPT/Data-to-Dashboard (Section 2), the 'query parameterization' and multi-tenant security are engineering contributions rather than research advances; the judge (Claude Sonnet 4.5) shares a model family with an evaluated backend and test cases are authored by the deploying team; no significance testing; core vs all quality subsets (n=205 vs 260) are not fully defined; no code, prompts, test suite, or data release, and the production dataset is proprietary; generalizability is limited to one e-commerce/pricing vertical, which the authors concede in Section 5.4.

primary_link.title: A Multi-Agent Platform for Automated Enterprise Analytics and Insight Generation

papers.summary: This paper proposes a multi-agent framework built on CrewAI [1] for conversational business intelligence. Five specialized AI agents operate in a sequential pipeline to process natural language queries, retrieve and analyze data, generate visualizations via the Model Context Protocol (MCP) [2], and deliver actionable insights. The platform features a defense-in-depth security architecture for multi-tenant data isolation and a query parameterization mechanism for transforming conversational insig
papers.summary_zh: 企業資料分析長期依賴人工撰寫 SQL 或操作複雜的 BI 工具,洞察產生耗時費力。本文提出建構於 CrewAI 的對話式多代理平台,由五個專業代理組成循序管線:資料檢索代理生成具結構感知的 SQL,資料分析代理解讀結果並透過 Model Context Protocol(MCP)產生圖表,報告彙整、追問與圖表設定代理負責多語回應、後續建議與視覺化中繼資料。平台特色包括將臨時查詢轉為可重用儀表板元件的查詢參數化機制,以及涵蓋輸入驗證、查詢防護、多租戶隔離與輸出掃描的縱深防禦安全架構。評估使用 300 個測試案例(合成與企業級競價資料),達成 95.3% 功能準確率、平均延遲 23.8 秒、LLM-as-a-Judge 品質分數 4.52/5.0 與 93.0% 無幻覺率;相較單代理基線(72.7%、3.76),準確率提升 22.6 個百分點、品質提升 20.2%,且 40 個對抗性輸入全數攔截。消融實驗指出資料分析代理對品質貢獻最大(移除後下降 1.14 分);跨模型驗證顯示 Claude Sonnet 4 達 93.0%,Gemini 2.5 Flash 以 17.4 秒換取 86.3%,連開源 Llama 3.1 70B(79.7%)都超越單代理 GPT-4.1 基線,證明架構分解比模型選擇更具影響力;人類專家評分與 LLM 評審高度相關(r=0.89,κ=0.82),選擇性平行化可再降 15.5% 延遲。限制包括僅驗證單一企業領域、人類標註僅 100 筆、循序延遲與約 2.7 倍 token 成本。此研究為可部署的企業 BI 系統提供了架構、安全與評測的完整範本。

links.title: Air Traffic Control Using Large Language Models: Prompt Engineering, Architecture, and Evaluation

evidence: Sec. 3.5: full factorial 9 models x 5 prompts x 2 ICL x 2 history x 3 attempts = 540 conversations, 19,440 turns; temperature 0.8, nucleus 0.95, 8,192-token context to prevent silent truncation.

Sec. 3.3: nine models evaluated (Qwen2.5-7B/14B/32B, Llama-3.1-8B, Gemma-2-9B, Mixtral-8x7B; GPT-5.4, GPT-5.4-mini, Claude-Sonnet-4.6) with GPT-5.5 deliberately excluded as judge to avoid self-scoring.

Sec. 4.1 / Table 1: lightest prompts best (C1-C3 ROUGE-L ~0.243-0.244 under ICL+self) vs C5 collapse to 0.159, a 35% relative drop; style block held constant to attribute differences to prompt content.

Sec. 4.3: ground-truth history rescues C5 (+0.057 ROUGE-L, p=0.004, dz=1.72, 9/9 models) while BLEU-1 improves for all models on every prompt (+0.044, p=0.004); judge hallucination-freedom falls 2.9 to 2.4 under teacher forcing.
Sec. 4.5 / Fig. 5: form-vs-content finding - pooled callsign/conciseness ~4.1 vs correctness ~2.1 out of 5; human expert shows same dimension profile ~1 point higher on the identical 180 outputs.

Sec. 4.7 / Table 7: judge-human agreement on 180 outputs is Spearman rho=0.67, kappa_w=0.60 with systematic leniency offset (+0.79 overall, widening to +1.44 on judge-low outputs); caveats state annotation was non-blind and single-annotator.
Sec. 3.6: judged subset is the 25 most-similar outputs per cell (4,500 total), acknowledged as describing each configuration at its best and conservative in the models' favor.
Sec. 4.8 limitations: single evaluation flight in one airspace, fixed pilot transcript that cannot produce repair turns, and untested generalization across facilities and traffic densities.

Availability: abstract states 'Code and data can be found here' but the link is a placeholder; Appendices 6-8 reproduce all five prompts verbatim, both full flight transcripts, and the judge rubric, partially supporting reproduction.
Sec. 4.4 / Table 2: scale does not predict quality - Qwen2.5-7B matches Qwen2.5-32B (0.234 ROUGE-L under ICL+GT) while Mixtral-8x7B (46.7B) is weakest everywhere (0.150, judge overall 1.45).
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-centric empirical study (prompt engineering, in-context learning, stateful multi-turn generation, LLM-as-judge validation, hallucination analysis) applied to air traffic control dialogue; language methodology is central, so it is not a pure domain-application cap case, but the aviation domain and aviation-only benchmark limit preference fit to the LLM/NLP/evaluation clusters rather than the highest-weighted reasoning/agent topics. Novelty is moderate: a first multi-turn, ground-truth-aligned ATC generation benchmark with human-validated judging and a teacher-forcing contrast isolating error accumulation, though the individual techniques (teacher forcing, LLM-as-judge, ICL ablation, leniency-bias quantification) are established. Rigor is solid: 540 conversations / 19,440 turns (Sec. 3.5), model-as-unit non-parametric tests with effect sizes (Sec. 3.7, Table 3), judge validated against a human expert (Sec. 4.7), and candid limitations. Evidence is internally consistent (e.g., C5 collapse ROUGE-L 0.159 vs C1 0.244, Table 1; GT-history rescue +0.057 p=0.004 9/9 models, Sec. 4.3) but weakened by judge scores restricted to the 25 most-similar outputs per cell (Sec. 3.6), a single non-blind annotator (Sec. 4.7 caveats), and a 3-vs-6 open/closed comparison. Generalizability is explicitly bounded: one evaluation flight, one airspace, fixed non-adaptive pilot (Sec. 4.8). Reproducibility is mixed: prompts, transcripts, rubric, and decoding parameters are fully reproduced (Appendices 6-8, Sec. 3.5), but the availability claim is an empty 'here' link and results depend on proprietary APIs and a specific judge model.

primary_link.title: Air Traffic Control Using Large Language Models: Prompt Engineering, Architecture, and Evaluation

papers.summary: Air traffic control (ATC) communication is a safety-critical dialogue that remains largely human-driven even as other parts of air traffic management have been semi-automated. In this article, we experimentally evaluate whether large language models (LLMs) can generate operationally realistic ATC transmissions. An experimental general-aviation flight flying over the San Francisco "Bay Tour" route is hand-transcribed and used as ground truth (P0). Through a pilot-in-the-loop process we design fiv
papers.summary_zh: 航空交通管制(ATC)通話是安全關鍵且仍高度依賴人力的環節,本文實驗評估大型語言模型能否生成操作上逼真的 ATC 傳輸。研究團隊手工轉錄一次舊金山灣區通用航空飛行的完整管制—飛行員對話(36 輪)作為唯一 ground truth(P0),設計由寬鬆到嚴格的五種提示結構(P1–P5),嵌入有狀態多輪管線,並以另一次互不重疊的飛行轉錄作為情境範例(ICL)。透過 9 個開源與閉源模型、完整因子組合、共 540 場對話與 19,440 個輪次,以 BLEU、ROUGE-L、TF-IDF、語意餘弦相似度,加上經人類專家驗證的 GPT-5.5 LLM 評審(七維度量表)進行評分。主要發現:提供完整範例航班使 9 個模型中 8 個相似度提升,但更嚴格的提示反而有害——最重的 P5 在自我歷史條件下崩潰(ROUGE-L 0.159),注入正確歷史可完全修復(+0.057),顯示錯誤沿對話歷史累積是主要失敗機制;閉源模型顯著優於開源,但規模無法預測品質,最大的 Mixtral-8x7B 反而最差。核心的負面結果是形式與內容脫節:模型在呼號處理與簡潔度得約 4.1/5,操作正確性卻僅約 2.1/5,亦即聽來像管制員卻常下錯指令。人類評審較 LLM 評審寬容約 0.79 分,兩者整體一致性為 κ=0.60。限制包括固定的飛行員腳本、單一飛行場域、單一且非盲測的標註者,以及評審僅取每格相似度前 25 名。結論建議現階段 LLM 應留在管制迴路之外,用於草擬例行傳輸、訓練模擬或篩查錄音,未來須以即時運行狀態進行接地。

links.title: Can a Lightweight Multimodal Model Estimate LLM Reasoning Performance? A Study for Compute-Optimal Document Inference

evidence: Abstract & Section 4.2: DRB achieves weighted F1 0.753 on BudgetDoc test set (n=2500); Class 6 recall 0.932, intermediate classes F1 0.463–0.740 (Table 3, Appendix A).
Section 3.1: 360 base documents × 5 models × 5 budgets = 9,000 labeled pairs; document-level splits 240/20/100 enforced to prevent leakage; prompts paraphrased via gemini-2.5-flash-lite.

Table 1 (Section 4.3): 13 of 15 model-dataset configs reduce adjusted cost (5.2%–99%); GPT-5.2 CDIP $0.09611→$0.00093 (−99.0%); F1 matches/improves in 9 of 15; GPT-5.1 CheckboxQA adjusted cost rises +35.6% and TAT-DQA shows F1 losses up to −5.7%.
Section 5 & Figure 1 vs Table 4 (Appendix C): text claims GPT-5.2 loses 12% F1 on CheckboxQA low→high (0.68→0.58), but Table 4 baseline F1s are 0.663 (low) vs 0.673 (high) — internal inconsistency.

Section 4.4/Table 2: model selection is exploratory; cross-family selection drops F1 −6.4% to −11.2% vs oracle while retaining large cost savings; authors state dedicated multi-provider supervision is future work.

Limitations: restricted to document-centric tasks; new providers require a calibration sample of configuration-outcome pairs; scanning latency overhead makes the approach unsuitable for ultra-low-latency pipelines.

Conclusion: 'BudgetDoc and the DRB baseline are released' but no repository URL is provided; Appendix B gives training details (20 epochs, A100 80GB, AdamW lr 5e-5, batch 4) and Appendix B gives cost-overhead formula ($0.00015/s T4).

Section 4 (Experiments): no ablations of estimator components (vision-only/text-only/config-only), no comparison to simpler estimator baselines, and no statistical significance testing or multi-run variance reported despite stochastic API outputs.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly aligned with LLM/reasoning/efficiency preferences: the core contribution is a pre-flight estimator (DRB, ~1B SigLIP-2+Qwen3-0.6B) predicting per-sample frontier-LLM performance across reasoning budgets, directly targeting test-time compute and over-thinking. Framing (supervised (document, prompt, model, budget)→performance benchmark, BudgetDoc) is reasonably novel beyond routing/cascade work. Evaluation is a thorough 9,000-pair combinatorial matrix with document-level leak-free splits and transparent adjusted-cost accounting, but rigor is limited by a small corpus (360 base documents), no architecture ablations, no simpler estimator baselines, no significance tests or run variance, and a baseline inconsistency (abstract says 'always-maximum-budget' while Table 1 uses auto-budget for Gemini). Evidence is weakened by an internal contradiction: Section 5/Figure 1 claim GPT-5.2 loses ~12% F1 on CheckboxQA from low→high effort (0.68→0.58), yet Table 4 baselines are 0.663 vs 0.673. Generalizability is confined to document tasks and two providers, with degraded out-of-distribution transfer (Table 2: −6.4% to −11.2% cross-family F1) and an acknowledged calibration requirement for new providers. Release of BudgetDoc/DRB is asserted without a URL; training details are otherwise adequate.

primary_link.title: Can a Lightweight Multimodal Model Estimate LLM Reasoning Performance? A Study for Compute-Optimal Document Inference

papers.summary: Uniformly allocating inference reasoning budgets to LLMs is expensive and prone to over-thinking penalties; especially in document tasks where visual layouts drive complexity. To address this, we introduce BudgetDoc, the first multimodal benchmark providing explicit supervision for model-budget-performance trade-offs across three document tasks. Using BudgetDoc, we train DRB (Document-Reasoning Balancer), an approx. 1B-parameter pre-flight estimator (SigLIP-2 + Qwen3-0.6B) that predicts ordinal
papers.summary_zh: 現代大型語言模型在推論時可控制推理預算,但對所有輸入統一配置既昂貴又可能適得其反,即所謂過度思考懲罰(over-thinking penalty)。本文探討輕量級多模態模型能否在執行推論前,估計大型 LLM 在各種推理預算下的表現。作者建立 BudgetDoc,首個針對模型-預算-效能權衡提供明確監督的多模態基準,涵蓋三種文件任務、五個前沿模型與多個預算層級,產出 9,000 筆標註組合對。他們訓練約 1B 參數的 DRB 估計器(SigLIP-2 視覺編碼器加上 Qwen3-0.6B 語言編碼器),為任意(文件、提示、模型、預算)組合預測七類序數效能標籤,測試集加權 F1 達 0.753,完美效能類別的召回率為 0.932。應用於逐樣本預算最佳化時,15 組模型-資料配置中有 9 組 F1 持平或優於最大預算基線,成本最多降低 99%;跨提供商的模型選擇僅為探索性案例,顯示仍需專門的多提供商訓練。限制包括僅涵蓋文件任務、新模型提供商需蒐集校準資料,且階層式掃描帶來延遲開銷,不利於超低延遲應用。此研究顯示外部的飛前估計可補足 Gemini 動態思考等機內自我評估控制,為計算最佳化推論提供實用槓桿。
