links.title: When Safety Overrides Vision: Exploring Dynamics between Vision Influence and Safety Alignment in Vision-Language Models

evidence: Section 3.1: evaluates Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, LLaVA-v1.6-Vicuna-7b-hf, Phi-3-Vision-128k-Instruct on VQA-v2, GQA, POPE with 2,000 sampled image-question pairs per dataset.

Section 4.2: defines layer-wise visual influence V_l = z_clean - z_corrupt using Gaussian-blur radius 30 corruption (Appendix 9.2), showing abstained generations retain visual sensitivity across layers.

Section 5.1: refusal direction r_l computed as diff-in-means between abstained and answered hidden states, citing Belrose 2023 and Arditi et al. 2024, indicating reliance on established representation-editing methodology.

Section 6.1: states refusal directions are 'estimated once using hidden states extracted from Qwen3-VL on VQA-v2 and subsequently applied across different evaluation settings' without explaining how directions transfer across models with different hidden-state dimensions.
Table 2: refusal suppression on Qwen3-VL POPE moves Correct 0.41->0.68 but Incorrect 0.03->0.33 (11x), weakening the caption claim that hallucination increases are 'comparatively modest'.
Appendix 9.1: abstention detected via case-insensitive substring matching against a fixed keyword list; safety-constrained and default prompt templates are provided.
Appendix 9.5: sensitivity analysis over intervention strength alpha with smooth monotonic behavior across the three models.
No statistical significance tests, confidence intervals, or error bars are reported for Table 1 or Table 2; no code or artifact release is mentioned anywhere in the paper.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A mechanistic-interpretability study of safety-induced abstention in VLMs (Qwen3-VL, LLaVA-v1.6, Phi-3-Vision on VQAv2/GQA/POPE). It sits squarely in multimodal LLM safety/alignment/interpretability (high-weight preferences: Multimodal AI, AI Safety, Interpretability, Alignment), not pure CV, so it is in scope. The controlled paired prompt design, corruption-based visual-influence metric, and activation steering are solid, but the core method (diff-in-means refusal direction + projection steering) directly extends Arditi et al. and Zou et al. to VLM abstention, making it incremental. Key weaknesses: no significance testing or CIs; the cross-model transfer of a refusal direction estimated on Qwen3-VL hidden states (Section 6.1) is unexplained given differing hidden dimensions; Table 2 shows incorrect answers on POPE rising from 0.03 to 0.33 under suppression, which strains the 'hallucination increases remain comparatively modest' claim; the phenomenon is induced only via an explicit safety prompt on benign VQA, limiting generalization to organically aligned refusal or genuinely unsafe queries. Reproducibility is partial: open models/datasets, prompts and keyword lists in Appendix 9.1, but no code release, no seeds, and unspecified decoding hyperparameters.

primary_link.title: When Safety Overrides Vision: Exploring Dynamics between Vision Influence and Safety Alignment in Vision-Language Models

papers.summary: Aligned vision-language models (VLMs) are designed to balance grounded visual reasoning with safe generation behavior. However, we observe a striking phenomenon: under safety-constrained instruction, models frequently abstain from answering questions that remain correctly answerable under default instruction despite receiving identical image-question inputs. This raises a fundamental question: does safety alignment suppress perceptual grounding itself, or does visual evidence remain internally a
papers.summary_zh: 已對齊的視覺語言模型(VLM)理應在視覺推理與安全生成間取得平衡,但作者觀察到一個顯著現象:在安全約束指令下,模型常對預設指令下明明可答的問題選擇拒答。核心問題是:安全對齊是否壓制了感知本身,抑或視覺證據仍內部保留、只是生成被導向拒絕?研究以 Qwen3-VL-8B、LLaVA-v1.6 與 Phi-3-Vision 為對象,在 VQA-v2、GQA、POPE 三個基準上進行配對實驗,僅改變指令而固定圖片、問題、模型參數與解碼設定。三項發現一致:拒答生成在整個解碼過程仍受視覺證據影響,排除感知失效的解釋;隱藏狀態軌跡在安全指令下於後期層轉向拒絕方向,但其幾何組織因架構而異,從清晰可分到高度糾纏;透過針對拒絕方向的隱藏狀態干預,抑制該方向能可靠恢復有根據的回答,後期層影響最強,且無需再訓練或修改視覺輸入。此研究揭示對齊 VLM 一個先前未被充分探索的失敗模式:模型可能「看見卻不說」,安全對齊可在感知證據內部完好的情況下覆寫其表達,對安全敏感應用的行為控制與評估方式具重要啟示。
papers.title: When Safety Overrides Vision: Exploring Dynamics between Vision Influence and Safety Alignment in Vision-Language Models
papers.title_zh: 當安全覆寫視覺:視覺語言模型中視覺影響與安全對齊的動態關係

links.title: Improving Natural-Language Combinatorial-Optimization Accuracy in Resource-Constrained Language Models via Formal Abstractions

evidence: Abstract: SDDL reaches 55.3% and 28.3% feasibility, 'up from direct-generation baselines of 23.7% and 1.3% and solver-code baselines of 21.7% and 7.0%, with a 0.0% median optimality gap among feasible schedules'.

Sec 4.2: 'The pipeline renders a schedule as a structured listing of integer start times, checked directly against the source instance rather than the solver's reported status'; verifier 'shares no code with the DSL parser, transpiler, or CP-SAT' (App B.4).
Table 7 (App B.4): exact two-sided McNemar discordant counts for all within-model contrasts with 'all remain significant after Holm correction (p_adj < 10^-6)'.

Sec 4.1: 'conflict, not_at, and the discrete archetype are specified and compiler-verified but left unexercised' — only makespan penalize, before, no_overlap, and cumulative/nonrenewable resources are evaluated.

Limitations: 'generalization to combinatorial domains beyond scheduling remains empirically untested'; 'We do not evaluate SDDL on frontier-scale models'; 'each instance is evaluated as a single draw'.
Sec 2.5 and citation: evaluation subset comes from SCHEDBench (Sharma and Sharma, 2026), the authors' own benchmark, with instances drawn from Taillard/DMU/LA/PSPLIB sources (Table 3).

App B.3: pinned Python 3.11.2 and OR-Tools 9.15.6755, sandbox configuration, and full prompts in Figs 4-5; Sec 4 states 'We use publicly released benchmark instances, evaluation harness, and verifiers', but no explicit repository URL for the SDDL compiler is provided.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM methodology paper: a scheduling-specific DSL (SDDL) with deterministic CP-SAT compilation lets small LLMs formalize natural-language scheduling, directly matching the LLM, reasoning/planning, and solver-delegation (tool use) preferences, though it is niche in domain and has no Japanese-language relevance. Rigor is comparatively strong: matched conceptual scope between SOLVER and SDDL prompts, an independent verifier sharing no code with the compiler, Wilson CIs, exact McNemar tests with Holm correction, pinned software, and a hand-coded failure taxonomy. Novelty is incremental within the established neuro-symbolic line (Logic-LM, NL4Opt, OptiMUS, ConstraintLLM, Logic.py), differentiated mainly by closed scheduling primitives and compiler adequacy arguments. Evidence is solid but bounded: 300 instances on a benchmark authored by the same authors, only 2 of 7 primitives exercised, SDDL never applied to frontier models so the 'matches frontier models' claim is cross-condition, and single-run-per-instance sampling. Generalizability is intentionally narrow (scheduling families only, generalization untested per the authors). Reproducibility is supported by pinned versions, full prompts, and released harness/verifiers, though no explicit repository URL for the SDDL compiler appears in the text.

primary_link.title: Improving Natural-Language Combinatorial-Optimization Accuracy in Resource-Constrained Language Models via Formal Abstractions

papers.summary: Combinatorial scheduling poses a significant challenge for language models, requiring them to identify feasible solutions within exponentially large search spaces while satisfying complex constraints. This challenge is especially pronounced in resource-constrained settings, where larger language models are impractical and selection is limited to smaller models which often fail to preserve feasibility when scheduling directly from natural language. To address these limitations, we introduce SDDL,
papers.summary_zh: 小型語言模型直接從自然語言解排程問題,常因約束遺漏而產出不可行的解。本文提出 SDDL(排程領域定義語言),一個神經符號框架:模型僅需將問題轉寫為七種排程原生原語(task、resource、before、no_overlap、conflict、not_at、penalize),確定性編譯器再將程式 lowers 成 CP-SAT 求解器模型,把易錯的建模決策從模型手中收回。SDDL 以封閉詞彙、解析期拒絕與逐語句的 adequacy 證明最小化失敗面,並由獨立驗證器直接對照原始實例檢驗輸出排程。在 300 個 SCHEDBench 實例(JSSP、單模式與多模式 RCPSP)上,qwen3.5-27b 搭配 SDDL 的可行率達 55.3%,遠高於直接生成的 23.7% 與通用求解器程式碼的 21.7%;devstral-small-2-24b 更從 1.3% 升至 28.3%,且可行排程的中位最佳性差距為 0.0%,逼近 GPT-5.5 直接生成(57.0%)與 Claude Opus 4.6 求解器輔助(56.7%)等前沿配置。限制包括未測試前沿規模模型、僅涵蓋排程家族、採單次零樣本貪婪解碼評估,且模型參數門檻約 20B 以上。此工作顯示受限的正式化介面能讓資源受限模型比肩大型前沿模型。
papers.title: Improving Natural-Language Combinatorial-Optimization Accuracy in Resource-Constrained Language Models via Formal Abstractions
papers.title_zh: 透過形式抽象提升資源受限語言模型的自然語言組合最佳化準確度

links.title: Learned, Then Lost: A Measured Single-Example Counterfactual in Pre-training

evidence: Abstract & Section 4: passage effect of +0.0389/+0.0437 nats at step 249, 8 of 8 seeds, p<10^-4; not detected at final step (p=0.25, 0.71) with MDEs 0.0249/0.0792.
Section 5, Tables 5 & 7: pre-registered fluent-fabricated minus fluent-attested barrier contrast +0.00680, t(7)=+0.70, p=0.509, against MDE 0.032 (observed/MDE = 0.21).
Section 6, Table 8: injected-vs-twin Euclidean distance 235.03 vs seed-to-seed 532.88 (44.1%) while barrier is 0.1479 vs 4.9303 (3.0%), with gauge-inflation caveat making 44.1% a lower bound.

Section 8 (Limitations): single stimulus pair, attestation and truth confounded (Jimmie Nicol 4 training occurrences vs Gizmo Harrington 0, Table 3), one model size/corpus/injection step/passage length.

Appendix C, Table 13: SHA-256 digests of step-199 weights identical across four conditions per seed and across two machines; Appendix D, Table 16: barrier recomputation on different hardware agrees to ~1.4e-8.
Appendix E, Table 17: primary outcome, contrast, metric rule, and correction policy fixed 2026-08-03/08 at commits 2ef812b/42a7d35/1ea243b, dated before the 32 runs from commit d52a2b8.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A small-scale but methodologically exemplary measurement study: 32 GPT-2 124M pre-training runs with bit-identical twins differing in one injected 194-token row, testing whether corpus attestation of a single example changes final weight-space structure. Topic relevance to the preference profile is moderate: it is genuinely about language-model pre-training and data attribution (influence functions, Grosse et al. 2023 framing, CKA probing, Training & Optimization), but contains no LLM capability, prompting, agent, or alignment methodology, and GPT-2 at 124M is far from the LLM regime. Novelty is solid: an actual measured single-example counterfactual with gradient-matched stimuli and a geometric-vs-functional readout dissociation is a fresh combination beyond Butterfly (weight perturbation) and Chang et al. (recall readout), though it extends known linear-mode-connectivity results. Rigor is outstanding: pre-registered single confirmatory contrast with dated commits before runs (Table 17), MDE reporting (0.032 barrier units), SHA-256-verified twin determinism across two machines (Table 13), gradient matching at 0.14% (Table 2), paired tests with 8/8 seed agreement for the memorization effect, and Holm-corrected exploratory analyses. Evidence strongly supports the modest claims made (learned-then-decayed passage effect at step 249; nulls bounded by MDEs; 44.1% Euclidean vs 3.0% barrier dissociation with honest gauge caveats), but the paper itself concedes one stimulus pair, attestation/truth confound, one model size/corpus/injection step, so generalizability is explicitly narrow. Reproducibility is near-exemplary: public code/pre-registration repo, full hyperparameters, hardware cross-check to 1e-8 (Table 16).

primary_link.title: Learned, Then Lost: A Measured Single-Example Counterfactual in Pre-training

papers.summary: A single training example's contribution to a finished model is normally estimated rather than measured, because measuring it takes two expensive full pre-training runs that differ in one row of one batch. We ran that counterfactual 24 times at a small scale. We trained 32 GPT-2 models at 124M parameters from scratch on OpenWebText, over four conditions and eight seeds. At step 200 of 9,536, at peak learning rate, we replaced one row of a 256-row batch with a fixed context injection carrying a 1
papers.summary_zh: 單一訓練樣本對最終模型的貢獻通常只能以影響函數等方法估計,因為直接測量需要兩次僅差一列批次的完整預訓練。作者在小型規模實際執行此反事實:訓練 32 個 124M 參數的 GPT-2 模型,四種條件各八個種子,在 9,536 步中的第 200 步(峰值學習率)將 256 列批次中的一列替換為含 194 個詞元段落的上下文,條件包括語料中有據主題的流暢散文、以全批梯度差異匹配至 0.14% 的虛構主題版本,以及隨機字元,並保留未注入的孿生模型為基準。結果顯示:注入的段落自單次曝光即被學習——五十步後看過段落的模型對該段落的預測比未看過者好 0.039 與 0.044 nats,八個種子全部一致(p<10^-4),但到最終步驟差異已不可偵測。預註冊的主要對比——插值損失障壁上的流暢虛構減流暢有據——為 +0.0068(p=0.509),低於最小可偵測效應 0.032。同時,歐氏距離位移達種子間距離的 44.1%,而障壁僅 3.0%,兩種操作化相距約 15 倍,顯示注入使模型在盆地內移動而非跨盆地。此研究警示以權重位移作為影響代理的陷阱,並凸顯測量時點與量尺選擇對資料歸因的關鍵影響。
papers.title: Learned, Then Lost: A Measured Single-Example Counterfactual in Pre-training
papers.title_zh: 學而後失:預訓練中單一樣本反事實的實測

links.title: OdinEval: A Reproducible Benchmark for LLM-Based Program Repair in the Odin Programming Language

evidence: Abstract: 'Kimi-K3 records the highest Resolved score at 66.7%, while Qwen3.8-Max has the highest Repro score at 96.4%' on 168 filtered instances
Experimental Results, Table 2: six models, Resolved range 45.8%-66.7%, Apply near-saturated at >=99.4% for five models; ranking shift between Repro and Resolved reported
Models and Controls: 'GPT-5.6-sol, GPT-5.6-terra-max, GLM-5.2, MiniMax-M3, Qwen3.8-Max, and Kimi-K3' under one shared prompt, scope, validator; decoding parameters deferred to artifact
Semantic Curation: 'No aggregate agreement value will be reported until it is computed from the frozen curation records' - inter-annotator agreement not actually reported
Dataset Release: 'The release will freeze both the dataset and the means to audit it' - reproducibility artifacts promised in future tense
Localization Conditions: lexical vs oracle conditions defined, but 'The six-model comparison in Table 2 fixes the supplied source scope', so no localization ablation results are shown
Overall Model Comparison: 'Kimi-K3 exceeds GLM-5.2 in Resolved by 8.9 percentage points' with no confidence intervals or statistical tests
Threats to Validity: 'The 168 filtered public issues may not represent all Odin development, and six models do not establish a universal ranking'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong topical fit: an LLM-based repository-level program-repair benchmark (six models incl. GPT-5.6 variants, Kimi-K3, Qwen3.8-Max on 168 Odin instances) matches LLM (2.5) and Code & Programming (2.0) preferences, plus evaluation focus. Novelty is moderate: SWE-bench-style methodology instantiated for a new language, pipeline explicitly adapted from ArkEval, with refinements (Test Writing Skill, same-model review) rather than new methods. Rigor is solid on protocol design (two-state admission rule, frozen controls, failure taxonomy) but weakened by unreported curator agreement, localization conditions described yet absent from Table 2, and no significance analysis for the 8.9-point Resolved gap. Evidence rests on one concrete 6x168 table without CIs; several construction and release claims are future tense. Generalizability is bounded to one niche language and one source scope. Reproducibility design is excellent (containers, manifests, checksums, validators) though the release is promised, not yet demonstrated.

primary_link.title: OdinEval: A Reproducible Benchmark for LLM-Based Program Repair in the Odin Programming Language

papers.summary: Repository-level repair benchmarks still center on a few mainstream languages, leaving systems languages such as Odin largely untested. We present OdinEval, a reproducible benchmark built from documented defects in public Odin repositories. Each instance binds an issue to base and fix commits, a gold patch, an issue-specific regression test, a historical toolchain, and execution records. Admission requires the test to fail on the base revision and pass after the gold fix. When no usable develope
papers.summary_zh: 儲存庫層級程式修復基準長期集中在 Java 與 Python 等主流語言,系統語言如 Odin 幾乎未被檢驗。本文提出 OdinEval,一個以公開 Odin 儲存庫中已記載缺陷建構的可重現基準。每個實例繫結 issue、基底與修復 commit、gold patch、issue 專屬迴歸測試、歷史工具鏈與執行紀錄;准入條件是同一驗證器下,測試在基底修訂失敗、在 gold 修復後通過。當缺乏可用的開發者測試時,基準以版本化的 Test Writing Skill 迭代生成黑箱測試,經三個隔離的同模型審查者一致核准並進行雙狀態執行驗證,明確區分行為失敗與基礎設施失敗。在 168 個過濾實例上以統一協定評估六個模型:Kimi-K3 的 Resolved 最高(66.7%),Qwen3.8-Max 的 Repro 最高(96.4%),GLM-5.2 以 57.7% 居次;指標選擇會改變排名——Resolved 涵蓋 20.8 個百分點,顯示 Repro 不能等同完整修復,單一指標會誤導結論。釋出套件包含凍結資料、容器、驗證器與審計清單。限制在於 168 個公開 issue 未必代表所有 Odin 開發工作,六個模型不足以建立普遍排名,且單次嘗試、僅回傳 patch 的協定排除了互動式修復情境。
papers.title: OdinEval: A Reproducible Benchmark for LLM-Based Program Repair in the Odin Programming Language
papers.title_zh: OdinEval:Odin 程式語言中 LLM 程式修復的可重現基準

links.title: Linguistic Holonomy and Statistical Watermarks: Inner Geometry of Meaning-Preserving Transformations

evidence: Section 5.1, Theorem 5.1: proof of intact-window identity E[z_att]=(|I|/T')E[z_0] under random-oracle and mean-field Bernoulli(gamma_w) hypotheses; Section 5.3 admits it is an upper bound when mean-field fails and covers only length-preserving substitutions.

Section 5.2, Proposition 5.3(iii): arithmetic-progression edits with step k<=h+1 give I=emptyset and exactly zero residual, i.e. adversary retaining 1-1/(h+1) of tokens annihilates the signal without knowing the key.

Section 6.2: synthetic exact-detector tests, mean absolute deviation vs rho^{h+1} of 0.0021-0.0023 across h=0..3 and 0.0011 for the exponential scheme; Table 3 largest discrepancy 0.008 with periodic pattern at rho=0.5 predicted and observed zero.

Section 6.3, Table 6: preregistered regression meets criterion in 2 of 3 schemes (p_eta=1.7e-3 green-list, 4.0e-9 unigram, 0.74 exponential); passage-clustered SEs move green-list to p=3.5e-2, and the text states evidence is 'decisive... good... and inconclusive' respectively.

Section 6.3: correlation between delta and eta is +0.85 to +0.91 pooled and +0.80 to +0.89 within passage; paper concedes the corpus 'does not exercise' the independence of Prop 4.2(iv) and that eta is not shown causal.
Section 7 limitations: small 0.5B generator, one attack family (round-trip MT, not learned paraphrasers), one embedder, lossy scalar eta.

Section 6.4: public repository with named scripts and run-stamped manifests, detector self-calibration (null z mean ~0, SD ~1, KS distance 0.056-0.070), and a regeneration audit finding 87/90 identical completions with 3 process-dependent divergences honestly documented.
Section 3, Proposition 3.1: four-line proof via real normal form that M=I_n-(R+R^T)/2 is PSD with spectrum {1-cos theta_k (mult 2)} and signature (2p,0,n-2p), superseded by the angle spectrum.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM safety/evaluation paper: analyzes robustness of context-seeded LLM watermarks (green-list, unigram, exponential) under meaning-preserving paraphrase/translation attacks, with a geometric (parallel-transport/holonomy) overlay. Core mathematical contributions are correct but elementary: Prop 3.1 shows a prior signature invariant degenerates to rank; Theorem 5.1 gives an exact intact-window identity E[z_att]=(|I|/T')E[z_0] under random-oracle plus mean-field assumptions, and Prop 5.3 shows an adversary knowing h can zero the signal while keeping 1-1/(h+1) of tokens. The closed-form rho^{h+1} decay explaining the empirical trend of Kirchenbauer et al. is a genuine, crisp contribution, though the direction was empirically known. The holonomy machinery is classical differential geometry applied somewhat decoratively; the headline path-dependence claim is under-determined by the corpus (delta-eta correlation 0.85-0.91, only 30 clusters, one embedder, one attack family, causality explicitly not established). Verification of the theorem itself is strong: machine-precision geometry checks (Sec 6.1), exact-detector synthetic tests with deviations ~0.002-0.008 (Sec 6.2), and real-text Table 5 within 0.01-0.07. Statistical hygiene is unusually good: preregistered test with Bonferroni correction, clustered SEs, Simpson's paradox and suppression artifacts reported honestly. Reproducibility section is exemplary (public repo, manifests with hashes, calibration, regeneration audit). Relevance is solid but not top-tier: no reasoning, agents, or Japanese-NLP content; watermarking/detection fits LLM+AI-safety+evaluation buckets.

primary_link.title: Linguistic Holonomy and Statistical Watermarks: Inner Geometry of Meaning-Preserving Transformations

papers.summary: Statistical watermarks for language models live in the freedom of the signifier: they choose among tokens that are nearly equivalent in meaning, and they are therefore eroded by exactly those transformations which move the form of a text while leaving its content in place. The literature measures such transformations by their endpoint, through the semantic similarity between the original and the rewritten text. We show that the endpoint is the wrong statistic. Adapting the formalism of linguisti
papers.summary_zh: 統計浮水印活在符徵的自由裡:它選擇語義近乎等價的詞元,因此恰會被保義變形侵蝕。文獻慣以端點(原文本與改寫文本的語義相似度)衡量攻擊強度,本文證明這是錯誤的統計量。沿語言迴圈的正式架構,作者證明三件事:原提議的 Sylvester 簽不變量必然半正定而退化為秩;迴圈旋轉其實是嵌入空間單位球上的平行移動,使 Wilson 迴圈類比成為定理;不變量可正則分解為端點部分與固定初態的和樂,而語義赤字對後者全然盲目,兩者在數學上互相獨立。在偵測器一側,作者證明精確恆等式:攻擊後的殘餘統計量正比於種子視窗完整無損的計分位置數,獨立編輯下導出 ρ^(h+1) 衰減律;更關鍵的是,在相同保留率下,殘餘訊號可為原值之一半、四分之一或恰為零,取決於編輯落點——知道內容寬度 h 的對手可在保留 1−1/(h+1) 詞元的同時消滅訊號,且無需知道金鑰。實驗以自製金鑰的精確偵測器與真實往返機器翻譯鏈驗證,預註冊迴歸在三個方案中的兩個確認和樂能量的負向偏係數。限制包括僅處理保長替換、平均場假設在真實文本下是上界,以及使用小型生成器與單一嵌入器。
papers.title: Linguistic Holonomy and Statistical Watermarks: Inner Geometry of Meaning-Preserving Transformations
papers.title_zh: 語言和樂與統計浮水印:保義變換的內在幾何

links.title: Grading the Graders: Verification Autonomy Levels (L0-L5) for LLM Reasoning

evidence: Abstract (p.1): VAL classifies any verification scheme by 'where does the verification spec come from, and what does the verdict guarantee?', with L5 'shown to be impossible in the unrestricted case'.

Sec. 3.3: deterministic seven-rule decision procedure implemented in val_standard.py (11 self-tests); claims 'three independent blind raters reach kappa ~ 0.8 on 48-54 schemes under the refined protocol'.

Sec. 7 Limitation 5 (p.17): 'VAL itself is unvalidated as a measurement... we have not tested inter-rater reliability of the decision procedure at scale' - contradicts the Sec. 3.3 kappa ~ 0.8 stress-test claim.
Sec. 5.1 (p.13): 'the full architecture scored 16/15/13 across three runs, while a raw-LLM baseline scored 20/20 in all three' - clean negative result on a 20-problem test set.

Sec. 5.5 and caveat (p.15-16): HumanEval 164/164 pass@1 at temperature 0.2 in bare condition; authors state the P3 experiment 'was inconclusive... a failed experiment design, not evidence for the framework'.

Sec. 7 Limitations 1-2, 6, 8 (p.17-18): 11/17 papers assessed at abstract level; single model family (deepseek-chat) and fictional medical cases; 42/42 calibration author-designed; error-reportability 'asserted but not quantified'.
Sec. 4 (p.11): authors concede the correctness/completeness distinction is 'known in verification theory' and VAL's contribution is making it 'executable', not claiming novelty for the distinction.
Sec. 7 Limitation 7 (p.18): survey omits calibration/uncertainty, red-teaming, RAG citation, and reward-model verification; 'VAL's completeness ladder is inapplicable to them'.
Appendix A-C (p.20-21): runnable classifier outputs, 17-paper classification table, and per-chapter experiment archives (RESULTS.md, REPORT.md, p3_scan.) released in a GitHub repository.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope conceptual paper on LLM verification: a six-level epistemic taxonomy (VAL, L0-L5) for grading verification schemes by spec source and guarantee, applied to LLM reasoning, agents, safety monitoring, and code generation. Topic alignment with high-weight preferences (LLMs, reasoning, agents, safety, evaluation) is strong. Novelty is moderate: the anchor-axis framing and five-axis disambiguation across 17 papers is a genuine contribution, but the authors concede the correctness/completeness distinction is 'known in verification theory' (Sec. 4) and the L5-impossibility argument leans on Rice's theorem and classical results (Sec. 4.5). Rigor is mixed: the deterministic decision procedure, versioned audit trail (Sec. 2.6), and honest negative results (math architecture 16/15/13 vs 20/20 baseline, Sec. 5.1) are commendable, but empirical studies are tiny (20 math problems, ~10 fictional medical cases), single-model (deepseek-chat, Sec. 7 L2), with admitted ceiling effects (Sec. 7 L6) and an internal inconsistency: Sec. 3.3 reports blind-rater kappa ~0.8 on 48-54 schemes while Sec. 7 L5 states inter-rater reliability is unvalidated. Evidence strength is limited because central claims are definitional, the 42/42 calibration and #105 adjudication were author-designed (Sec. 7 L6), error-reportability value is asserted but not quantified (Sec. 7 L8), and 11 of 17 surveyed papers were only abstract-level assessed (Sec. 7 L1). Generalizability is partial: four domains exercised, but the survey excludes mainstream anchor-less verification families (Sec. 7 L7). Reproducibility is good: runnable classifier with 11 self-tests (Appendix A), released code, data archives, and frozen protocol (Sec. 3.3).

primary_link.title: Grading the Graders: Verification Autonomy Levels (L0-L5) for LLM Reasoning

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly paired with verifiers (step checkers, self-consistency filters, tool-based fact checkers, formal proof assistants) that claim to detect the model's errors. Yet the verification literature uses the word "level" to mean at least five different things: verification granularity, concept abstraction, risk tier, system-stack layer, and the epistemic source of the ground truth. We propose Verification Autonomy Levels (VAL), a meta-standard that classifies a
papers.summary_zh: LLM 驗證文獻中「層級」一詞至少混用了五種意涵:驗證粒度、概念抽象、風險處置、系統堆疊與認識論錨定。本文提出驗證自主層級(VAL),沿單一軸——驗證規格來自何處、判決保證什麼——將任何驗證方案分為 L0(模型自我宣告)至 L5(普遍完備性,在無限制情況下被證明不可能)。核心概念是完備性盲點:替換式與抽樣式驗證只能確認已提出的候選成立,無法證明沒有候選被遺漏;完備性僅對可形式化屬性可達,開放世界驗證(事實查核、診斷、法律分析)的上限是 L2 錨定正確性。作者釐清 17 篇代表性文獻的混淆,並以符號數學、行為監控、醫療診斷與程式生成四個案例實證,誠實報告負面結果:對訓練分布內的強問題,驗證架構不提升準確率,但帶來錯誤可報告性與完備性感知,例如 L3 解集合驗證器能抓到 L2 替換檢查看不見的漏根。框架附確定性決策程序與可執行分類器。對部署者而言,VAL 是驗證宣稱的採購檢查清單:先問規格來源,並知道 L2 判決只是正確性探針而非完備性保證,同時需明註 ODD 與棄權行為。
papers.title: Grading the Graders: Verification Autonomy Levels (L0-L5) for LLM Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 為評分者評分:LLM 推理的驗證自主層級(L0–L5)

links.title: ORBITER: Conflict-Aware Decision-Making for Agentic Last-Mile Delivery

evidence: Abstract: 'ORBITER outperforms existing state-of-the-art baselines by up to 9.2% on average' for a conflict-aware agentic next-order decision framework.
Experiments > Baselines and Evaluation: 'thirteen baselines from four categories' (heuristic, ML, deep learning, LLM-based) with ACC@1, ACC@3, MRR on four LaDe-P city subsets.

Main Results, Table 2: ORBITER ACC@1 0.535/0.515/0.590/0.550 (Shanghai/Jilin/Chongqing/Yantai) vs strongest baselines MRGRP 0.505, XGBoost 0.485, MRGRP 0.550, DRL4Route 0.525; relative gains average ~6.0%, inconsistent with the claimed 9.2% average, and MRR gains (~3.0% computed) differ from the claimed 4.9%.

Main Results, Table 2: MRGRP ACC@3 0.830 (Shanghai) and DRL4Route ACC@3 0.845 (Yantai) exceed ORBITER's 0.820/0.840, so the paper's 'highest ACC@1 and MRR in every city' claim (Main Results) is metric-specific.

Ablation Studies (Figure 3 and text): removing proposers lowers mean ACC@1 by 37.98% while 'w/o LLM' lowers it by 6.14%, indicating most performance comes from proposer fusion rather than LLM reasoning.
Sensitivity to the backbone LLM (Figure 4 and text): DeepSeek-V4-Flash best, Qwen3.5-Flash trails by 1.4% mean ACC@1, GPT-4o-mini by 3.4%, Qwen3-8B by 5.0%.
Methodology > Decision Point Generation > Leakage control: candidate-order permutation from deterministic seeds and chronological day-level train/test split to prevent leakage.
Case Study (Figures 5-6): Shanghai decision point where counterfactual route check overturns a 6:2:1 proposer majority, illustrating the auditable evidence record.

Conclusion and Experiments sections: no code, prompt, or artifact release statement is provided despite reliance on specific tool implementations and backbone APIs (Table 2 footnote: all LLM baselines use DeepSeek-V4-Flash).
llm_evaluation.rationale: An agentic LLM framework (ReAct-style loop, task-specific tools, structured disagreement report, independent critic) applied to next-order decision making in last-mile delivery, giving a strong match to the LLM/agents/reasoning preferences even though the domain is logistics. The role-flip of using the LLM as an arbiter of heterogeneous proposer disagreements rather than as a direct predictor is a moderately novel contribution. Evaluation is reasonably broad (13 baselines, 4 LaDe-P cities, 5 ablations, 4 backbone LLMs, leakage control), but headline gains are not derivable from the reported table, no significance/variance or tool-call cost analysis is given, ORBITER is not best on ACC@3 in all cities, evidence is limited to one dataset family, and no code or prompt release is stated.

primary_link.title: ORBITER: Conflict-Aware Decision-Making for Agentic Last-Mile Delivery

papers.summary: Last-mile delivery aims to handle dynamically arriving orders with couriers while modeling complex spatial and temporal correlations. Recent learning-based methods model spatiotemporal dependencies among orders to predict courier service sequences, but leave next-order decision making unexplained. Describing the current delivery state in language allows LLMs to reason explicitly about the spatial, temporal, and behavioral cues behind an individual decision. As direct predictors, however, LLMs re
papers.summary_zh: 末端配送需對動態到達的訂單做出下一單決策,但深度學習方法將取捨壓縮進最終路線而無法解釋,LLM 作為直接預測器又對任務呈現敏感、決策不可靠。本文提出 ORBITER,一個衝突感知的代理式框架:先將快遞員服務重構為一連串決策點,保留當下時空狀態與可見訂單,並透過候選排列與按日切分進行洩漏控制;異質提案生成器以啟發式、統計與深度學習模型產生互補排名,結構化分歧報告指出模型間衝突與主要取捨;LLM 代理以任務專屬工具收集證據,在假設驗證迴圈中隨未決衝突演進更新假設狀態,再由獨立評論者審查,最終決策保留前三大替代並記錄支援證據。在 LaDe-P 四個城市子集(上海、重慶、吉林、煙台)上,ORBITER 的 ACC@1 與 MRR 全部居首,較最強基線平均提升 9.2%;消融顯示異質提案者最關鍵(移除後 ACC@1 降 37.98%),而三個 LLM 基線平均僅 32.1%,接近啟發式方法。骨幹模型以 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 最佳,Qwen3.5-Flash 僅落後 1.4%。案例研究展示證據如何推翻多數提案,使模型分歧成為可稽核的裁定訊號。

links.title: Denoising-Aware Inversion: Revealing Privacy Risks in Noise-Protected Text Embeddings

evidence: Section II-B: correction residual decomposes into semantic residual plus (epsilon1-epsilon2) with doubled noise variance; magnitude ~sqrt(2)*sigma*sqrt(d) ≈ 0.39 for 768-d, sigma=0.01, exceeding single-noise displacement ~0.28, motivating the DAE-shielded design.
Section III-A: SURE objective (Eq. 12/14) removes reliance on clean embeddings, with Hutchinson Monte-Carlo divergence estimation shown unbiased with variance bound O(1/K) (Eq. 15-16).

Table II (Section V-A): GTR-base DAEI BLEU 0.4875 vs Noisy Inverter 0.1916 (+0.2959 absolute, 154.4% relative), F1 0.7717, ROUGE-L 0.7788, cosine 0.9254; Table III replicates gains on GTE-base (BLEU 0.3152 vs 0.1249).

Table IV (Section V-B): DAEI beats ZSInvert and Noisy Inverter baseline on all five OOD sets (AG News, Anthropic Toxic Prompts, Python Code, Climate-FEVER, MedMCQA), with AG News weakest at BLEU 0.0791 attributed to longer inputs (~61 tokens).
Table V and Fig. 3 (Section V-C1): Stage 1 DAE cuts MSE to clean embeddings by 29.2% (GTR) / 23.8% (GTE) without clean-target training; mean LID drops from 51.15 (noisy) back to clean level (~47.65).

Section IV-E: hyperparameters specified (sigma=0.01, DAE hidden 1024/depth 3 with spectral normalization and 5 MC probes, LR warmup 10,000 steps, corrector early-stop 1e-3); Abstract and Section IV-A2 provide code (github.com/ChrisWang233/DAEI) and data-source repository.

Section IV-C: ZSInvert is the only prior external noise-setting baseline; threat model in Section II-A assumes black-box embedder, known Gaussian noise family, and sigma known or estimable via repeated calibration queries (relative SE ~0.85% for sigma at n=10, d=768).
llm_evaluation.rationale: A privacy/security paper showing Gaussian-noise-protected text embeddings remain invertible via a SURE-based unsupervised denoiser coupled to Vec2Text-style generation. It matches mid-weight preferences (AI safety/attack-defense, RAG embeddings/vector databases, NLP, evaluation) but has no LLM-specific methodology, capping preference relevance. Novelty is solid: the 'Double Noise Trap' analysis and first no-clean-target denoising-inversion formulation are new combinations of known components (Vec2Text, DAE, SURE, PCGrad), not a new paradigm. Rigor is good: clear threat model, four baselines including the only prior noise-robust method (ZSInvert), two architecturally distinct encoders, five OOD sets, and component/noise-scale ablations; weakened by single-run results without significance testing, base-scale encoders only, 32-token evaluation truncation, and an assumption that the adversary knows the perturbation is Gaussian with estimable sigma. Evidence is consistent across tables (e.g., GTR BLEU 0.1916 to 0.4875 matches the claimed 154% relative gain), but MSE/cosine denoising gains are modest and partly interpretive. Reproducibility is strong with released code, data sources, and detailed hyperparameters.

primary_link.title: Denoising-Aware Inversion: Revealing Privacy Risks in Noise-Protected Text Embeddings

papers.summary: Dense text embeddings are widely used in data mining, retrieval, and downstream machine learning systems due to their compact and semantically rich representations, but recent embedding inversion attacks have shown that they can expose substantial information about the original text, leading to serious privacy leakage risks. A common defense is to release perturbed embeddings by adding Gaussian noise, which is simple yet effective against standard inversion attacks and does not significantly deg
papers.summary_zh: 密集文字嵌入廣泛應用於搜尋、檢索與下游機器學習系統,但嵌入反轉攻擊可還原原始文字,常見防禦是在嵌入加入高斯雜訊。本文探討攻擊者只能觀察雜訊嵌入、無法取得乾淨嵌入時,反轉是否仍然可行。作者分析現有生成式反轉方法(如 Vec2Text)失效的原因,提出「雙重雜訊陷阱」:修正階段比較兩個各自被獨立加噪的嵌入,殘差訊號的雜訊變異數加倍,使校正被雜訊方向誤導。他們提出 DAEI 管線:先以殘差式去噪自編碼器搭配 Stein 無偏風險估計(SURE)進行無監督去噪,無需乾淨嵌入即可訓練;再以去噪嵌入訓練生成式反轉器,進行 SURE 與交叉熵聯合微調,並以 DAE 防護修正介面。在 GTR-base 與 GTE-base 上,DAEI 相較直接在雜訊嵌入訓練的 Vec2Text 基線,BLEU 相對提升約 154%,F1 與 ROUGE-L 提升 32–60%,於五個領域外資料集保持優勢,且對 σ=0.005 至 0.018 的雜訊尺度變動穩健;LID 分析亦顯示去噪可將嵌入拉回乾淨流形。限制在於假設攻擊者已知或可估計雜訊標準差,σ=0.02 時效能下降,但過大雜訊亦會損害下游效用。此研究挑戰「加高斯雜訊即足以保護嵌入隱私」的假設,凸顯防禦須考量具去噪能力的適應性攻擊者。

links.title: AppEval: A Unified Benchmark for LLM-Based Mobile Application Repair in ArkTS, Swift, and Kotlin

evidence: Abstract: 'five agents achieve Pass@1 between 22.00% and 90.50%, a 68.50-percentage-point spread under the same dynamic oracle' on the audited Android partition of 200 tasks from 24 repositories.

Table 2 (Section 5.1): Android 200 accepted / 24 repositories audited, while iOS (160) and HarmonyOS (180) rows are marked 'sim' — 'synthetic layout placeholders', so cross-platform numbers are not empirical.

Section 2.2: formal acceptance condition requiring build, install, launch, execution, and assertion failure A(S_bug,q) on the defective state and pass P(S_fix,q) on the fixed state, with infrastructure errors retained as a distinct outcome.
Section 7.1: 'does not contain a complete, separately audited localization-output matrix. We therefore defer Hit@k and Recall@k claims' — RQ1 is unanswered in this version.

Table 4 (Section 7.2): all five configurations report 0 infrastructure errors across 200 tasks each; '549 of 1,000 model-task evaluations pass, giving a 54.90% micro-average'; Fleiss' kappa = -0.024 indicating near-chance task-level overlap.

Section 10 (External validity): 'current audited statistics are dominated by Android and by sample-project build roots', and Section 8.2: 'this manuscript does not claim that all public-release gates have been satisfied'.
Section 6.2: each model receives one sample per task with at most two evaluator retries of the same patch; denominator policy fixed before evaluation.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong topical fit: a repository-level LLM-agent benchmark for mobile code repair (Agents & Tool Use, Code & Programming, LLM evaluation). The two-state dynamic acceptance requiring a genuine assertion failure on the defective state and a pass on the fixed state over the build-install-launch-test boundary is a genuine methodological contribution separating infrastructure failures from model failures. However, evidence quality limits the score: only the Android partition (200 tasks, 24 repositories) is audited; iOS and HarmonyOS numbers are explicitly synthetic placeholders (Table 2, Table 5), RQ1 localization results are deferred with no Hit@k/Recall@k reported (Section 7.1), and failure-mode analysis is planned not executed (Section 7.4). The extremely high top score (Qwen3.7-Max 90.50% Pass@1) and zero unresolved infrastructure errors across all 1,000 evaluations (Table 4) are plausible only on a distribution of small controlled mutations and warrant scrutiny; the near-zero Fleiss' kappa (-0.024) is honestly reported but weakly interpretable. Cross-platform generalization is explicitly disclaimed (Abstract, Section 10), and public-release gates are not confirmed (Section 8.2), capping evidence, generalizability, and reproducibility.

primary_link.title: AppEval: A Unified Benchmark for LLM-Based Mobile Application Repair in ArkTS, Swift, and Kotlin

papers.summary: Repository-level LLM agents are typically evaluated on projects whose tests run on the build host. It remains unclear whether their repairs survive the mobile build-install-launch-test boundary, where a missing SDK, offline device, or pre-assertion crash can be mistaken for a program failure. We present AppEval, a benchmark and native-toolchain evaluation framework for mobile application repair across HarmonyOS/ArkTS, iOS/Swift, and Android/Kotlin. Each task separates a hidden behavior test from
papers.summary_zh: 儲存庫層級的 LLM 修復代理多在建置主機上以測試評估,但行動應用程式的修補須經建置、安裝、啟動與測試執行才可觀察,SDK 缺失、裝置離線或斷言前當機等基礎設施問題可能被誤判為程式失敗。本文提出 AppEval 基準與原生工具鏈評估框架,涵蓋 HarmonyOS/ArkTS、iOS/Swift 與 Android/Kotlin 三平台。每個任務將隱藏的行為測試與參考生產修復分離,並採用雙狀態動態驗收:有缺陷版本必須在已安裝應用上真正觸發斷言失敗,套用修復後同一目標測試必須通過,基礎設施失敗則獨立記錄且不得計入。共通模式將此合約映射至各平台的建置系統、執行環境與測試執行器。經稽核的 Android 分區含來自 24 個可獨立建置儲存庫的 200 項已安裝應用測試任務;五個代理在相同的動態驗收標準下 Pass@1 介於 22.00% 至 90.50%,差距達 68.50 個百分點,且 Fleiss' κ 為 −0.024,顯示各系統對可解問題幾乎無共識。作者明言 iOS 與 HarmonyOS 的數值仍為合成佔位,須完成稽核後方能推論跨平台泛化,定位與分層失敗分析亦待補全。此研究凸顯執行時期感知的驗收協定,對公平比較與有意義的修復評估不可或缺。

links.title: Learning What to Fail On: Failure-Mode Contextual Bandits for Adversarial Data Curation

evidence: Abstract: reports RoBERTa-base gains from 88.48% to 92.60% on SNLI, 75.04% to 80.95% on ANLI, 54.67% to 71.99% on MultiNLI without human annotation.

Section 4 (Target NLI Model / Generation LLM / Validation LLMs): generator is LLaMA-4-Scout-17B-16E-Instruct; unanimous validation ensemble of Gemma-3-27B-IT, Phi-4, Qwen3-32B; ~30K candidates per retrieval strategy with 6637 BGE and 5991 BM25 survivors.
Appendix B.4 Table 5: curator ablation on SNLI — Full 92.60%, Random policy 89.70%, Heuristic Entropy 90.45%, Frozen policy 91.20%, No clustering 90.85%, Oracle 93.40%.
Appendix B.13 Table 10: accuracy degrades from 92.60% to 91.62% under reward noise sigma=0.2 and to 92.17% at 90th-percentile threshold, supporting stability claims.
Appendix B.7 Table 8: three-judge unanimous filtering retains 6,438 examples at 92.13% vs single judge 16,147 at 91.02%.
Section 3.2 Eq. 25-26 and Figure 5: original-to-adversarial mixing ratio lambda_mix in {0,1,1/2,1/3,1/4} with 1/4 chosen to mitigate forgetting.

Appendix B.11 Reproducibility Measures: seeds, Optuna search space, and 40 trials specified, but 'complete training and optimization scripts will be released upon publication' — no current code/data link.

Section 4 (Datasets) and Table 2: FEVER transfer is reported against GEAR/KGAT/WgtSum/BEVERS, but no evidence-retrieval pipeline or label-noise handling for FEVER is described in the paper, weakening cross-pipeline comparability.

Table 1: T5-Small/Large/XXL rows are largely empty ('-') with a stray unlabeled value column (e.g., 33.00/45.72/57.87 for ANLI), an editorial rigor defect; no error bars or seed variance are reported anywhere in Section 4 or appendices.

Appendix B.1-B.2: theoretical results (Lemma A.1, Propositions A.2-A.3) are essentially linearity-of-expectation bounds conditional on strong assumptions (E_Ft[g_s] <= 0, bounded policy approximation error), acknowledged as an 'interpretation'.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope NLP methodology paper that heavily engages LLM preferences: LLM-based adversarial generation (LLaMA-4-Scout), hybrid RAG few-shot retrieval (BGE M3 + BM25 with tuned alpha=0.83), an LLM judge ensemble (Gemma-3, Phi-4, Qwen3-32B), and a REINFORCE-style contextual-bandit curator over clustered failure modes. Novelty is moderate: the bandit-over-failure-modes formulation and validation-based reward (robustness minus forgetting minus cost, Section 3) is a genuine increment over the authors' prior VAULT/RAG work and RL data-selection baselines, but components are standard. Rigor is decent (many ablations, oracle bound 93.40 vs 92.60, judge-size and reward-noise sensitivity in B.4/B.13), yet no multi-seed variance or significance tests are reported, credit assignment gives one reward to all selected modes, theory relies on strong unverified gradient assumptions (Appendix B.1), and Table 1 has formatting anomalies (empty T5 rows, stray unlabeled values). Evidence is broad (SNLI/ANLI/MultiNLI, 5 backbones in Table 4, FEVER transfer in Table 2) but the FEVER setup omits any evidence-retrieval description while comparing against full-pipeline systems (GEAR, KGAT), and 'consistently outperforming prior adversarial methods' is not backed by numeric comparisons to cited methods like Iyyer et al. or Minervini & Riedel. Generalizability is shown across scales and one transfer task, though generator/verifier-scale ablations are explicitly deferred to future work (B.3). Reproducibility is partially supported (Optuna search space, seeds, prompts in B.15, few-shot examples in B.14) but code is only promised ('will be released upon publication', B.11), the clustering algorithm and failure-mode encoder are unspecified, and judge prompts are absent.

primary_link.title: Learning What to Fail On: Failure-Mode Contextual Bandits for Adversarial Data Curation

Rather than selecting synthetic examples with a fixed reward threshold, our method formulates adversarial data curation as a failure-mode contextual bandit problem. Candidate examples are generated with retrieval-augmented prompting, filtered by the current target model, automatically validated by an LLM judge ensemble, and clustered into recurring failure modes. A s
papers.summary_zh: 自然語言理解模型面對對抗或領域外樣本常顯脆弱,而現有對抗資料生成管線多採靜態過濾、固定獎勵門檻或一次性驗證,無法隨目標模型演進學習該優先取樣哪些失敗。本文將對抗性資料策展形式化為「失敗模式情境式多臂老虎機」問題:以 BGE M3 與 BM25 混合檢索建構標籤平衡的 few-shot 脈絡,驅動 LLM 生成候選假設;僅保留使目標模型分類錯誤者,再由 Gemma-3-27B-IT、Phi-4 與 Qwen3-32B 三位評審一致同意方可通過驗證;驗證後的失敗經嵌入並分群為重複出現的失敗模式,隨機策略在對抗預算下選擇取樣哪些模式進行再訓練,獎勵依驗證集上的穩健性增益、遺忘與資料成本計算,並附理論分析說明失敗模式取樣可降低捷徑對齊的梯度貢獻,且分布漂移有界。實驗顯示 RoBERTa-base 在 SNLI 由 88.48% 提升至 92.60%,ANLI 由 75.04% 至 80.95%,MultiNLI 由 54.67% 至 71.99%,並可遷移至 FEVER,RoBERTa-large 達 79.86% FEVER 分數與 82.45% 準確率,全程不需人工標註。限制包括生成與驗證元件的貢獻尚未解耦,生成器與驗證器規模的影響亦待系統探究。此框架提供免人工、可擴充的模型穩健性提升途徑。

Section 4.2: mechanistic diagnostics on the 67M run show strictly higher momentum-gradient cosine, lower prediction error, and better input-covariance conditioning (condition number, effective rank, top-1 variance fraction) under DeltaAdamW, matching the predicted mechanism.

Appendix O & T: Muon tuned under its own muP rule with the largest per-dimension Optuna budget (38 full-trial equivalents) still sits above DeltaAdamW (0.120±0.008 nats at 67M, 0.109±0.003 at 370M); sweep budgets, interior-optimum boundary audit, and Optuna SQLite DB release are documented.

Appendix F.3 honest scope: per-direction spectral-radius reduction holds only in the underdamped regime; 'a determinant decrease at fixed trace can in principle increase rho' - candid theoretical limitation.
Section 5 Limitations: scale capped at 1B (single seed), non-fused wall-clock implementation, no interleaved-modality runs, and DeltaMuon/DeltaShampoo/DeltaSOAP compositions left as future work.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A core optimization-methodology contribution (replacing EMA momentum with a delta-rule update treating gradient factors as key-value pairs) validated on LLM pretraining up to 1B. Strong match to Training & Optimization and Scaling & Efficiency preferences, moderate to LLM relevance since the contribution is optimizer-level rather than LLM methodology. Novelty is genuinely good: the paper credibly claims first application of the delta rule to an optimizer momentum buffer, distinguishing itself from Muon/Shampoo/SOAP and concurrent preconditioning work. Rigor is high: fixed-point (Thm 3.4), memory-transport (Lemma 3.7), tracking (Thm 3.10), and muP width-invariance (Thm Q.1) results with proofs, plus unusually candid assumption scoping (Appendix H) and an honest overdamped-regime caveat (Appendix F.3). Evidence is strong: 3-seed 67M/370M results with matched-loss windows fixed a priori, tuned Muon reference with the largest per-dimension budget, measured FLOP/wall-clock overhead, mechanistic diagnostics, eta ablation, and CIFAR-10 cross-family checks; weaknesses are the single-seed 1B run, loss-only evaluation, and non-fused wall-clock implementation. Generalizability is good (drop-in, cross-optimizer/architecture/modality) but capped at 1B with compositions deferred. Reproducibility is high given full algorithm spec, FLOP accounting, seeds, tuning protocol, boundary audit, and stated code/Optuna-DB release.

primary_link.title: DeltaMomentum: A Key-Value based Anisotropic Momentum Update via Delta Rule

papers.summary: Most modern optimizers form their momentum as an exponential moving average (EMA) of past gradients, forgetting every direction at one fixed rate. However, the inputs a deep network sees during training can be highly anisotropic, with a few directions queried frequently while most are seen rarely. Recent methods address this anisotropy by wrapping extra processing around this buffer, leaving the momentum update itself unchanged. We propose DeltaMomentum, which builds direction-awareness into the
papers.summary_zh: 現代最佳化器的動量多為過往梯度的指數移動平均,以單一固定速率遺忘所有方向;然而深度網路訓練時的輸入高度非等向,少數方向頻繁出現、多數方向極少被激發,固定速率在兩種情境皆非理想。本文提出 DeltaMomentum,將方向感知寫入動量更新規則本身:觀察到線性層梯度可分解為輸入(扮演鍵)與輸出端誤差(扮演值)的秩一外積,據此以經典 delta 法則更新動量緩衝,使每個方向的遺忘速率由其出現頻率決定;常被查詢的方向快速刷新,罕見方向則保留類似 EMA 的長期記憶。作者證明其為有效的動量梯度估計、隱含輸入側曲率校正而不需矩陣反運算,且在固定與漂移的最佳解下清除過時方向皆快於 EMA,並具 μP 相容性,額外運算僅佔 gated-MLP 區塊線性成本的 22.2%–25.0%,且無持久記憶體負擔。在 FineWeb-Edu 語言模型預訓練上,DeltaAdamW 於 67M 達到 AdamW 相同驗證損失最多可省 46.39±4.32% 步數,370M 省下 22.12±0.80%,增益延伸至 1B 的 Chinchilla 最佳預算;CIFAR-10 上的 SGD、ResNet-18 與 ViT-Tiny 亦見一致改善。不過,同協定調校的 Muon 基線在兩個語言模型規模均高於 DeltaAdamW,實驗僅至 1B 參數,且採未融合核心實作。此工作重新審視動量更新此一少有變動的元件,並可即插即用於各種最佳化器。
papers.title: DeltaMomentum: A Key-Value based Anisotropic Momentum Update via Delta Rule
papers.title_zh: DeltaMomentum:以 Delta 法則為基礎的鍵值式非等向動量更新

links.title: MLREF: Efficient Module Reuse for Reward Design in Reinforcement Learning via Large Language Models

evidence: Abstract: 'Experiments on 17 tasks show that MLREF outperforms strong baselines by 25.2% in locomotion and 6.6% in manipulation, with more stable optimization dynamics.'
§4.1: 'Inspired by the prior work Ma et al. (2024), MLREF models a reward function as a linear combination of reward modules' — indicates the core reward structure builds on EUREKA, bounding novelty.

§5.1: 'we run each task for 3 independent complete pipeline executions and return the reward function from the best execution' — best-of-3 pipeline selection applies to MLREF only, an evaluation asymmetry vs. baselines following original configs.
Table 2: MLREF underperforms baselines on Anymal (-0.0073 ± 0.0019 vs. -0.0057) and Shadow Hand (11.75 ± 9.69 vs. 17.11), showing per-task gains are mixed despite aggregate claims.
§5.3/Table 3: ablations cover only Ant, Block Stack, and Bottle Cap; the GPT-4o backbone variant achieves 40.9% of full performance, revealing strong sensitivity to the LLM backbone.
§5.5 Discussion: authors acknowledge modest absolute performance on sparse-reward tasks (e.g., Block Stack), single-LLM evaluation, and no open-source model testing.

Appendix B (Table 4) and Appendix D: full hyperparameter listings and complete LLM prompt templates are provided, supporting reproducibility, though no code or artifact release is claimed anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-methodology paper (LLM-driven, agentic reward-code evolution with chain-of-thought reflection, module credit assignment, and rollback) evaluated on RL benchmarks, so it is in scope rather than a pure robotics/biology/vision application. Topical fit is strong: LLM, agents/tool-use, reasoning/CoT, code generation, RL, and prompting preferences all apply. Novelty is moderate: the paper itself states it is 'Inspired by the prior work Ma et al. (2024)' (§4.1), building on EUREKA's linear-combination reward structure; the deltas are a persistent named module pool, correlation-based per-module credit, UCB selection, and rollback merge — a solid systems contribution but incremental over EUREKA/R*/RF-Agent/FORGE. Rigor concerns: only two baselines (EUREKA, RF-Agent), ablations restricted to three tasks (§5.3, Table 3), no significance testing, and an asymmetry favoring MLREF — 'we run each task for 3 independent complete pipeline executions and return the reward function from the best execution' (§5.1), a best-of-3 selection baselines do not receive. Per-task results are mixed (MLREF loses on Anymal -0.0073 and Shadow Hand 11.75±9.69 in Table 2), and the headline 25.2% rests on normalized locomotion averages. Evidence is supported by tables, ablations, and full evolution curves (Appendix C), but the single LLM backbone (DeepSeek-V4-Flash) is a large confound given the GPT-4o ablation drops performance to 40.9%. Generalizability is limited to simulated Isaac Gym/Bi-DexHands tasks with one API LLM; limitations are acknowledged (§5.5). Reproducibility benefits from a complete hyperparameter table (Appendix B, Table 4) and full prompt templates (Appendix D), but no code release is stated.

primary_link.title: MLREF: Efficient Module Reuse for Reward Design in Reinforcement Learning via Large Language Models

papers.summary: Reward function design remains a bottleneck in reinforcement learning. While large language models (LLMs) have enabled automated reward generation, existing methods generate and revise reward functions as monolithic programs, making it difficult to reliably preserve and reuse effective components discovered in earlier iterations, leading to unstable performance across iterations. To address this, we propose Module Level Reward Evolution Framework (MLREF). At the core of MLREF is a module pool, a
papers.summary_zh: 強化學習的表現高度依賴獎勵函數，但獎勵設計長期是瓶頸。現有以 LLM 自動生成獎勵的方法（如 EUREKA、RF-Agent）多以整個函數為單位反覆改寫，難以保存與重用先前迭代發現的有效元件，導致最佳化過程不穩定。本文提出模組層級獎勵演化框架 MLREF，核心是持久的「模組池」：獎勵函數只是從池中取模組做線性組合的暫時實例，池本身才是最佳化對象，會跨迭代累積成功模組、修正表現不佳者並重用已驗證元件。框架整合三項機制：以任務分析與歷史回饋為基礎的反思式改良、結合 LLM 評分與訓練相關性的混合式權重指派，以及附回復（rollback）機制的合併策略，在失敗時回到先前的池狀態。在 Isaac Gym 與 Bi-DexHands 共 17 個任務上，MLREF 較最強基線於移動類任務平均提升 25.2%、操作類任務提升 6.6%；消融實驗與演化曲線顯示其最佳化軌跡明顯更穩定，反思機制貢獻最大。作者指出在 Block Stack 這類稀疏獎勵任務上絕對表現仍有限，且僅以單一 LLM 評估，多模型協作為未來方向。此研究顯示，把模組視為可持續管理的一級物件，能讓 LLM 驅動的獎勵演化更穩定、更有效率。
papers.title: MLREF: Efficient Module Reuse for Reward Design in Reinforcement Learning via Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: MLREF：以大型語言模型實現強化學習獎勵設計的高效模組重用

llm_evaluation.rationale: A multimodal-RAG paper (MLLM-based retriever for KB-VQA) that sits in scope via Multimodal AI, RAG/Knowledge, and LLM/MLLM backbone preferences, though the core task is vision-centric image-to-image retrieval, capping topic fit. Novelty is moderate: MLLM-as-embedder (E5-V, GME, MM-Ret) and MLLM-as-judge for embedding learning (UniME-v2, cited) already exist; the claimed first is narrow (first MLLM retriever specifically for KB-VQA), and the contributions are a competent recombination of soft-label distillation, hard-negative mining, and MLLM scoring. Rigor is solid: three benchmarks, four downstream pipelines with only the retriever swapped (Table 1), and thorough ablations (SD vs inverted weights Table 4, discriminator choice Table 5, negatives Table 6, gamma Table 7), plus a 20k-pair AUC analysis (0.91 vs 0.79). primary_link.title: Beyond Visual Similarity: Entity-Aligned Retrieval for Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering

papers.summary: Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering (KB-VQA) relies on retrieving external information to answer queries involving long-tail entities. However, existing retrieval pipelines predominantly employ CLIP-style dual encoders, which prioritize surface-level visual similarity over entity-level semantic alignment. This paradigm often fails when semantically identical concepts exhibit large visual variations or when distinct entities appear visually similar. To address this, we propose KBMR, the fir
papers.summary_zh: 知識型視覺問答（KB-VQA）需從 Wikipedia 規模的知識庫檢索外部證據，但現有系統幾乎都以 CLIP 風格的雙編碼器作為第一階段檢索器，偏好表層視覺相似性；當同一實體因視角與時代呈現巨大外觀差異，或不同實體外觀相近時，常檢索到語意不符的證據。本文提出 KBMR，為首個以多模態大型語言模型（MLLM）為基礎的嵌入檢索器：以特定提示將圖像編碼進保留概念身分的語意空間，取最後一個 token 的隱藏狀態作為檢索向量。針對大規模檢索的監督雜訊，作者引入 MLLM 語意判別器，對每組查詢—候選對輸出連續的實體一致性權重，據此採樣難負樣本並作為軟標籤，再以連續語意蒸餾（對稱 KL 散度）將檢索器的相似度分布對齊判別器導出的語意先驗。在 E-VQA、InfoSeek 與 OK-VQA 上，KBMR 的檢索 Recall@1 最高提升 14.7%，端對端 VQA 準確率最高提升 9.4%，並創下 OK-VQA 79.3 的新水準；消融實驗證實軟監督與判別器權重皆不可或缺。限制包括訓練依賴另一個 MLLM 判別器，且負樣本數與銳度係數需調校。此研究說明 KB-VQA 檢索應顯式建模實體層級語意，而非僅依賴視覺相似，從檢索器層級突破 CLIP 範式的瓶頸。
papers.title: Beyond Visual Similarity: Entity-Aligned Retrieval for Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering
papers.title_zh: 超越視覺相似性：支援知識型視覺問答的實體對齊檢索

links.title: FlashAttention for Scalable Vector Architectures

evidence: Abstract: 22x-42x prefill speedup over scalar FlashAttention at 512-bit VL in gem5, 8x-11x in decode, and additional 2x-2.5x scaling to 64 lanes and 4096-bit VL.

Section 6.1: Banana Pi BPI-F3 confirms 12x-14x over ggml-scalar; FlashAttention-V FP16 matches ggml-vec-fp16 at N=512, averages 1.2x-1.5x at N in {64,128,256}, and yields about 7% lower throughput on Pythia-410M at N=512.

Section 6.1 end-to-end: only 4% prefill improvement over the ggml vectorized baseline for Qwen2.5_Q4_K_M (3.52 T/s) with decode comparable, attributed to FlashAttention being ~50% of prefill but ~10% of decode per layer.

Section 5.1: gem5 24.0.0.1 MinorCPU with opLat scaled by VL/PhysicalWidth (Vitruvius+-informed, 512 bits/cycle reference); out-of-order RiscvO3CPU could not complete simulations due to memory exhaustion.
Section 5.2 Baselines: ggml-scalar, ggml-vec-fp32, ggml-vec-fp16; Titopoulos et al.'s RVV FlashAttention has a tensor layout incompatible with llama.cpp, precluding direct comparison.
Section 6.2 footnote 5: ggml-vec-fp16 could not be simulated in gem5 (LMUL=8 unsupported for widening instructions), so FP16 vectorized baseline is absent from gem5 comparisons.
Section 7: Q8_0 microbenchmark at 2048-bit VL shows vslideup packing =28% of cycles, masked reduction =32%, vector MAC =40%; Arm SVE svld1 packing still incurs ~20% overhead.
Section 8: core optimizations give 5% improvement when applied to the tiled GEMM-based FlashAttention implementation in llama.cpp on Banana Pi BPI-F3.

Section 5.2: llama.cpp commits 5fc7cb2... and d0061be..., EPI LLVM Clang 21.0.0 with -O3 -rv64gcv_zvfh (RVV) and GCC 15.2.1 with -march=armv8.2-a+sve2 (SVE) specified; no explicit statement of code release for FlashAttention-V itself.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A computer-architecture systems paper optimizing FlashAttention for long-vector CPUs (RVV/SVE), evaluated through LLM inference (TinyLlama, Llama 3.2, Qwen2.5, Pythia-410M). It matches several preferences (LLM, Transformer Architecture, Scaling & Efficiency, Inference & Serving) but contributes kernel/hardware optimization rather than language-model methodology; it is not in the out-of-scope categories. Novelty is a genuine niche contribution: prior CPU FlashAttention implementations are restricted to VL<=D (llama.cpp, Titopoulos et al., MEATTEN), and inter-head packing for VL>D plus the Q8_0 long-vector bottleneck analysis are new, though built from standard vectorization techniques (loop reordering, unrolling, blocking). Rigor is solid: gem5 with a VL-proportional latency model informed by Vitruvius+, real Banana Pi BPI-F3 hardware, QEMU correctness checks on SVE, three baselines, four models, parameter tuning, and candid disclosure of limitations (FP16 vectorized baseline un simulatable due to LMUL=8, incompatible prior-work baseline, O3 CPU memory exhaustion, LMUL>=4 simulation gap). Evidence is credible but leans on simulation upper bounds; the headline 22x-42x is against a weak scalar baseline, while comparisons to ggml-vec on real hardware are 1.2x-1.5x at short sequences and end-to-end gains are modest (4% prefill), with an honest Pythia regression reported. Techniques are architecture-agnostic and validated on a second ISA for correctness plus a 5% gain on the GEMM-based path, but gains saturate in decode and are CPU-vector-specific. Reproducibility is supported by llama.cpp commit hashes, compiler versions/flags, and simulator configs, but no explicit artifact or code release is stated.

primary_link.title: FlashAttention for Scalable Vector Architectures

papers.summary: Inference with transformer models on CPUs is increasingly important, especially for Small Language Models (SLMs), where vector architectures are emerging as a promising execution substrate. The attention module is a major bottleneck due to high memory bandwidth requirements; FlashAttention mitigates this by fusing operations to improve data locality and reduce intermediate memory traffic. In this paper, we present FlashAttention-V, a blocked FlashAttention for scalable vector architectures that
papers.summary_zh: 在 CPU 上執行 Transformer 推理日益重要，尤其是 1–10B 參數的小型語言模型（SLM）在邊緣裝置的部署，而具備向量擴充的處理器（RISC-V RVV、Arm SVE）是重要平台。然而現有 FlashAttention 實作皆將向量長度（VL）綁定於注意力頭維度 D（通常 64 或 128），VL 超過 D 時 SIMD 資源便嚴重閒置。本文提出 FlashAttention-V，利用各注意力頭彼此獨立的特性，透過跨頭迴圈重排、迴圈展開與「跨頭打包」將多個頭的資料填入同一向量暫存器，使 VL 可超過 D，並原生支援 MHA 與 GQA。作者將其整合進 llama.cpp 的 ggml 框架，於 gem5 模擬與 Banana Pi BPI-F3 實機上評估 TinyLlama、Llama 3.2、Qwen2.5 與 Pythia-410M。結果顯示 512-bit VL 下 prefill 相較純量版 FlashAttention 達 22×–42× 加速，擴展至 64 lanes、4096-bit VL 再獲 2×–2.5×；decode 因單 token 且受記憶體頻寬限制，加速為 8×–11×，對 VL 與 lane 數的敏感度低。研究並指出 Q8_0 量化線性層因權重與 scale 交錯的記憶體布局，打包與遮罩歸約在 2048-bit VL 時耗去約 60% 週期，是長向量擴展的根本障礙。此工作為長向量硬體上的注意力與量化層最佳化提供具體指引。
papers.title: FlashAttention for Scalable Vector Architectures
papers.title_zh: 適用於可擴展向量架構的 FlashAttention

links.title: Self-prompting and cross-model consensus enable reproducible data extraction from scientific literature with large language models

evidence: Abstract (Page 1): four escalating workflows - expert prompts, LLM-authored prompts, autonomous deep-research agents, and LLM-generated datasets - with cross-checking and human-in-the-loop oversight.

Results 'Expert curated prompt vs frontier-models' (Page 6): GPT-5.5 best at 95.7% of expected values; top-three models 92.6 +/- 2.7% vs 86.4 +/- 3.1% for the other four; numerical K and Kd extracted correctly in 99.0% and 99.8% of cases vs 80.7% for troponin preparation (Page 7).
Page 7 consistency analysis: 76.4% of parameters correct in all five runs, 19.2% flipped; Kimi K2.6 ranged 78.4-95.2% across runs; authors recommend a minimum of five runs with majority reporting.

Page 10 'LLM self-authored prompts and the master prompt': aggregation improved rubric scores (e.g., GPT-5.5 82.9% to 88.2%) but master prompts reduced extraction accuracy for every model (GPT-5.5 -5.3 pp; Gemini 3.1 Pro -32.5 pp); rubric score weakly/non-significantly predicted accuracy (Spearman r=0.36, P=0.43, Supporting Fig. S2).

Page 12 'Deep Research agents': best agent (Opus 4.8) recovered only 53.7% +/- 14.7 of the 19 ground-truth references; Qwen3.7-Plus hallucinated 45% (27/60) and GLM-5.2 29% (20/69) of unique citations, while five agents produced none.

Page 16 consensus calibration: unanimous 5-0 runs matched reviewer consensus 93.2% vs 65.0% (4-1) and 55.2% (3-2); Page 17: cross-model majority voting reached 93.3% agreement at five runs vs 89.2% for five same-model runs.

Methods (Pages 18-19): all models accessed via browser with model tiers/configuration listed, and explicit notes that model behavior and compute allocation changed during the study; Data Availability (Page 20): GitHub repository with all prompts, raw and curated data, and a tutorial.

Limitations evident from Methods (Page 19): small evaluation corpora (18 articles/39 conditions; 8 articles for prompt testing; 10 hand-selected organoid articles) and only two PhD-level reviewers, whose own agreement was 79.1% (Page 14).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Empirical LLM-methodology study (not a capped pure-domain paper): four escalating workflows for scientific data extraction using frontier LLMs via browser interfaces, spanning expert-prompt extraction, LLM self-authored master prompts, deep-research agent evaluation, and a transfer dataset-building task. Strongly aligned with LLM, prompting, and agent preferences and moderately with evaluation/RAG-knowledge themes. Rigor is solid for an applied evaluation: 7 models x 5 runs, corrected ground truth (LLMs exposed errors in the original reference dataset), 38-component prompt rubric with human validation, manual citation verification, and consensus-vs-accuracy calibration. But corpora are small (18/8/10 articles), access is via non-deterministic proprietary browser products with documented mid-study behavior changes, and only two human reviewers anchor the organoid benchmark. Novelty is moderate: self-prompting, consensus ensembles, and deep-research benchmarks all exist (cited APE/OPRO, ICE, DeepResearch Bench); the useful new findings are that prompt-rubric quality does not predict extraction accuracy (Spearman r=0.36, n.s.), single runs mislead, and consensus split strength (93.2%/65.0%/55.2% for 5-0/4-1/3-2) plus cross-model voting (93.3%) outperform same-model repetition (89.2%). Prompts, raw/curated data, and a tutorial are released on GitHub, aiding reproducibility, though browser-model drift prevents exact replication.

Here, we investigate the performance of frontier, browser-based large language models (LLMs) to extract highly contextualized information. We demonstrate four escalating workflows, 1) given an expert curated prompt and research articles, most frontier LLMs perform well at data extraction, however can struggle with interpreting scientific context and nuance, 2) given simple instructions, LLM
papers.summary_zh: 從非結構化研究論文中萃取具脈絡的資料既費時又易出錯，LLM 輸出品質又受提示設計、存取介面與模型差異影響，缺乏通用準則。本文透過瀏覽器介面測試七個前沿 LLM（GPT-5.5、Opus 4.7、Gemini 3.1 Pro 等），設計四個自主性遞增的工作流程：(1) 給定專家撰寫的提示與固定論文集，多數前沿模型萃取表現接近人類，GPT-5.5 達 95.7%，親和力常數準確率近 99%，且多次執行可找出原始基準資料本身的錯誤；(2) 讓 LLM 自行撰寫提示並聚合為 master prompt，表現幾近專家提示但略遜；(3) 要求 Deep Research 代理自行找文獻並萃取參數，落差最大：最佳系統平均僅找回 53.7% 的基準參考文獻，部分模型出現大量幻覺引用；(4) 以已發表的類器官報告指引生成新資料集，LLM 與人類評審一致率約 81–93%，跨五模型多數決可達 93.3%，模型間分歧能有效標記需人工覆核的個案。作者強調單次執行可能誤導對模型能力的評估，建議至少重複五次採多數決。結論是專家界定證據標準、模型執行重複萃取、研究者處理爭議個案的可稽核分工，才是擴大科學資料策展的務實路徑，人類把關仍不可省略。
papers.title: Self-prompting and cross-model consensus enable reproducible data extraction from scientific literature with large language models
papers.title_zh: 自我提示與跨模型共識讓大型語言模型可重現地萃取科學文獻資料

links.title: Structure, Association, and Decision Value: Representation-Based Difficulty Estimation for Adaptive Inference in African-Language NLI

evidence: Abstract/§4/Table 3: AfriXNLI English shares 1,047/1,050 pairs verbatim with XNLI; mDeBERTa scores 1.000 on English dev vs 0.890 test, XLM-R-large 0.998 vs 1.000, supporting split-specific contamination diagnosis.
§5/Table 4: parameter count does not order capability — mDeBERTa 0.545 vs XLM-R-large 0.523 aggregate, cluster bootstrap CI [−0.035,+0.083], per-language differences span −0.145 to +0.220 (Table 9).

§6/Table 5: angular dispersion η²=0.583/0.484/0.542 vs effective rank η²=0.075/0.133/0.151 across task-tuned, African-adapted, and generic encoders; pooled correlation for L8 angular dispersion inflated 4.9× over within-language (Table 6).
§7.3/Table 7: effective rank ρ=−0.127 with Δprob (Holm p=5.8e−32) but ρ=−0.027 with Δcorrect (p=0.28); cheap-model confidence shows the reverse pattern; targets correlate at only 0.655.
§8/Table 8: no practical routing method exceeds always-expensive inference (0.545 vs 0.577 at 60% budget) while the oracle reaches 0.688, an ~14-point headroom gap.
§10 Limitations: single task (NLI), one model pair over 11 of 15 languages, marginal-gain targets from a single frozen checkpoint pair without seed averaging, three similar-depth encoders only.
Reproducibility section: code, configurations, cached outputs and results ledger at github.com/qeinstein/adaptive-computation tag paper-v1; all analyses re-run from caches in minutes without a GPU.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Careful negative-result methodology study on adaptive inference in African-language NLI using frozen encoder checkpoints, not LLMs. Topic fit is moderate: solid matches on NLP, adaptive inference/serving, efficiency, evaluation validity/contamination, and representation analysis, but zero presence in the highest-weight preference areas (LLMs, agents, reasoning, code, Japanese NLP). Rigor is unusually high: Holm-corrected within-language Fisher-z meta-analysis, cluster bootstrap over languages, permutation nulls, leave-one-language-out routing, explicit separation of established vs. inferred claims, and candid registration of post-hoc analyses including the authors' own target-misalignment error. Evidence is strong for contamination (verbatim matching plus dev-test gap fingerprint) and language-confounding (η² replicated across three spaces), weaker for routing (single MiniLM→mDeBERTa ladder, 11 languages, targets built from one frozen pair, no seed averaging). Generalizability is deliberately constrained to NLI and three similar-depth encoders. Reproducibility is strong: code, cached outputs, and a results ledger at a fixed tag, re-runnable without GPU. A genuinely useful negative result, but limited preference alignment caps the overall score.

primary_link.title: Structure, Association, and Decision Value: Representation-Based Difficulty Estimation for Adaptive Inference in African-Language NLI

papers.summary: We ask whether internal representation statistics can provide useful example-level difficulty signals for adaptive inference in multilingual African NLP, and find that they cannot in this setting. Studying natural language inference across 15 African languages with frozen off-the-shelf checkpoints, we report four results. First, AfriXNLI's English configuration shares 1,047 of its 1,050 examples verbatim with XNLI evaluation data, and one widely used NLI checkpoint scores 1.000 on that test spli
papers.summary_zh: 本文探討模型內部表徵統計量能否在多語非洲語言NLP中提供範例層級的難度訊號以支援自適應推論,結論是否定的。研究以十五種非洲語言的自然語言推論(NLI)為對象,採用凍結的現成檢查點,分四階段檢驗。第一,評估效度:AfriXNLI英文設定有1,047/1,050筆範例與XNLI逐字重複,某檢查點在該英文測試集得滿分,與XNLI測試集汙染一致,故其英文、法文與史瓦希里語設定不能作為乾淨評估。第二,參數量無法排序能力:較大檢查點在七種語言較佳、八種較差,整體差異不顯著。第三,在三種多語表徵空間中,角度離散度的變異主要由語言身分主導,有效秩則否,故跨語言合併的相關分析會將前者誇大近五倍並掩蓋後者。第四,存活下來的關聯具目標特定性:有效秩預測升級帶來的機率增益,卻無法預測是否改變預測;便宜模型的信心值則呈相反模式,兩種「計算效益」操作化定義僅相關0.655。在受測模型、訊號與運算預算下,沒有任何訊號使自適應路由優於一律使用昂貴模型,但oracle在六成運算量下高出十一個準確率百分點,顯示分配問題本身可學習。核心方法論啟示:表徵統計量可以高度結構化且統計顯著,卻與另一種計算效益定義無關,因此不宜直接作為決策變數。
papers.title: Structure, Association, and Decision Value: Representation-Based Difficulty Estimation for Adaptive Inference in African-Language NLI
