links.title: PACT: Post-route Agentic Checkpoint Tuning for FPGA Timing Closure

evidence: Abstract: PACT improves validation-clean Fmax by geometric mean +22.30% over 35 UltraScale+ checkpoints vs +15.14% for DATuner and +9.78% for the Codex Agent.
Section IV-C: both agentic methods use GPT-5.5 as the underlying model, Vivado 2025.1/RapidWright 2025.1, identical validation policy, and a one-hour wall-clock budget per design.

Section IV-D: the Codex Agent baseline receives the same optimization knowledge, Vivado/RapidWright MCP servers, reports, and checkpoint inputs, isolating the contribution of PACT's harness from LLM reasoning.

Section IV-F, Table IV: Dev +27.70% vs held-out Test +5.70% for PACT; Scripted (no LLM) achieves +14.11% overall and +5.54% on test, showing recipe/action set rather than the LLM carries generalization.
Section IV-E3: PACT costs $0.16 per DCP vs $3.81 for the Codex Agent (24.5x lower) under the same model and budget; PACT achieves higher Fmax on 32 of 35 shared designs.
Section IV-F: leave-one-out cross-design evidence transfer shows little variation (e.g., CORDIC-L +26.7% in all three settings), indicating case records mainly prune repeats.
Abstract and Reference [37]: source code available in an anonymous repository (anonymous.4open.science/r/PACT-552C); benchmarks drawn largely from public sources (Section IV-B, Table III).
Section II-E: the validation set C covers routing legality, hold and pulse-width timing, and checkpoint usability; functional equivalence is ensured by construction, not empirically verified.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An agentic LLM system (GPT-5.5 planner over typed Vivado/RapidWright skills with MCP tool access, validation-gated acceptance, rollback, and a within-run case record) applied to post-route FPGA ECO timing closure. It matches the high-weight Agents & Tool Use and LLM preferences and is not a language-free domain application: the agent harness is the core contribution and is directly evaluated against a knowledge/tool-matched free-form Codex Agent. Rigor is above average: 35 checkpoints with a 27/8 dev-test split, an uncapped (favorable) DATuner baseline, a matched Codex Agent isolating the harness, and three ablations (Scripted no-LLM, phys_opt sweep, leave-one-out transfer). Honest reporting reveals a large dev-vs-test gap (+27.70% vs +5.70%), showing the LLM itself adds little on held-out designs over the deterministic rule layer (+5.54%), which caps novelty and generalizability. Single vendor/device (xcvu3p), single tool version, and single model, plus functional equivalence only 'by construction' with no simulation/formal check, further limit scope. Quantitative evidence is concrete and internally consistent (runtime, token cost, per-design Fmax). Anonymous code release and public benchmark citations support reproducibility, offset partly by closed-model dependence and internally generated designs.

primary_link.title: PACT: Post-route Agentic Checkpoint Tuning for FPGA Timing Closure

papers.summary: Late-stage FPGA timing closure often starts from an implemented design whose remaining violations are visible in timing reports. Engineering change order (ECO) optimization is a standard mechanism for applying localized changes to such designs without restarting the full implementation flow. Automating post-route ECO optimization remains challenging. A post-route change must improve timing without violating routing legality, hold or pulse-width timing constraints, checkpoint replayability or fun
papers.summary_zh: 晚期FPGA時序收斂常從已實作設計出發,工程變更指令(ECO)是修復剩餘違例的標準機制,但自動化路由後ECO最佳化必須兼顧時序改善、繞線合法性、hold與脈衝寬度約束、檢查點可重播性與功能等效。本文提出PACT,一個針對Vivado設計檢查點(DCP)的路由後代理式調校框架,將調校建模為接受檢查點與候選檢查點之間的驗證門檻式轉換。系統從檢查點抽取時序與實體證據形成時序輪廓,由代理透過設定檔驅動的recipe規劃器,在型別化的Vivado與RapidWright技能庫中選擇局部後端動作,並於隔離工作區試作;每次嘗試都記錄為證據門檻案例,以抑制不安全、無依據或無效的動作,且僅在通過驗證並改善setup時序時才接受,否則回退。在35個UltraScale+路由後檢查點上,PACT將驗證乾淨的最大工作頻率F_max以幾何平均提升22.30%,優於DATuner的15.14%與自由形式Codex Agent的9.78%;較不限時的DATuner快6.4倍,每個DCP平均token成本僅0.16美元,比Codex Agent低24.5倍。消融顯示在held-out測試設計上的泛化主要來自結構化動作集與驗證harness而非LLM本身;跨設計證據轉移的增益有限,未來將擴及多時脈、跨晶粒與功耗感知最佳化。
papers.title: PACT: Post-route Agentic Checkpoint Tuning for FPGA Timing Closure
papers.title_zh: PACT:用於FPGA時序收斂的路由後代理式檢查點調校

links.title: DocClaw: A Unified Agentic System for Intelligent Document Processing

evidence: Section 3.1: an 'LLM-based agent interacts with the document state using document processing tools through a ReAct-style (Yao et al. 2023) agentic loop', planning actions a_t=(tau_t, c_t) and updating a structured document state.

Section 4.1 (Implementation Details): toolset spans parsing (PaddleOCR-VL-1.6), search (BM25, ColBERT, ColPali, backbone-VLM visual search), and analysis (PP-DocLayout v3); backbones are GPT-5.2, Gemini-2.5-Flash, Gemini-2.5-Pro on two A100 80GB GPUs.

Section 3.2/3.3: contributions are the persistent document memory + per-query task memory split and hand-written OCR/DocQA/KIE skills; document memory is retained across queries while task memory is discarded.
Table 1(a): DocClaw w/ Gemini-2.5-Pro scores 96.45 overall on OmniDocBench v1.6 vs 96.34 for PaddleOCR-VL-1.6, the tool DocClaw itself invokes for parsing.
Table 1(b): DocClaw w/ Gemini-2.5-Pro reaches 61.5 on MMLongBench-Doc, +3.4 over the Gemini-2.5-Pro baseline (58.1) and above SimpleDoc w/ Claude-4-Sonnet (58.6).
Table 1(c): DocClaw w/ Gemini-2.5-Pro reaches 86.9 ALL KIE vs 84.0 for Qianfan-OCR; Chinese subset 78.7 vs baseline 54.3 per Section 4.3 ablation.

Section 4.3 (Effect of Document State and Skills): ablation uses a 'manually constructed set of 30 randomly shuffled queries' (10 each OCR/DocQA/KIE); skills raise overall 92.85->97.10; state cuts latency 95.81s->60.70s.

Section 4.3 (Effect of OCR Refinement): 'we evenly distribute the performance improvement among all applied operations' across 433 pages (zoom 354, crop 77, rotate 41), a crude attribution method; zoom gain 0.23.
Section 1 footnote: 'Code is available at https://github.com/sxiangag/DocClaw', but backbones are proprietary APIs and the actual skill prompt texts are not included, limiting reproduction.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope agentic LLM research: a ReAct-style agent orchestrating parsing/search/analysis tools over documents, driven by GPT-5.2/Gemini backbones, matching the high-weight Agents & Tool Use, LLM, and RAG preferences; document imagery does not make this pure CV. Novelty is incremental: ReAct loops, tool calling, and memory structures are standard; the genuinely new angles are cross-query persistent document memory and hand-crafted 'document skills' unifying OCR/DocQA/KIE, against prior agentic DocQA-only systems (DocAgent, DocDancer, SimpleDoc). Rigor is moderate-to-good: three official-protocol benchmarks, three backbones, and ablations of state, skills, refinement, and verification; however, the state/skill ablation uses only 30 self-constructed queries, the OCR win over PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 (96.45 vs 96.34) is a 0.11 margin on a benchmark where DocClaw invokes that same tool, no variance/significance is reported, and the refinement-gain attribution is admittedly split evenly across applied operations. Evidence convincingly supports DocQA gains (+3.4 over backbone, +2.9 over best specialized pipeline) and KIE gains (verification corrects 35.3%/47.7% of errors), but weakly supports the marginal OCR claim. Generalizability is limited by per-task hand-authored skills and proprietary backbones; code is linked but skill prompts and closed APIs hinder exact reproduction.

primary_link.title: DocClaw: A Unified Agentic System for Intelligent Document Processing

papers.summary: Intelligent document processing (IDP) encompasses a broad range of tasks, including optical character recognition (OCR), document question answering (DocQA), and key information extraction (KIE). Despite their distinct objectives, these tasks share a common need to perceive document content, acquire task-relevant information, and progressively refine intermediate results. However, they are typically formulated as separate prediction problems and addressed by task-specific models or processing pi
papers.summary_zh: 智慧文件處理(IDP)涵蓋光學字元辨識(OCR)、文件問答(DocQA)與關鍵資訊擷取(KIE),傳統上多被拆成各自獨立的預測任務,由任務專屬模型或管線處理,導致缺乏統一工作流程,且文件知識難以跨查詢累積、重用與精煉。本文提出DocClaw,將多樣化的IDP任務統一表述為代理與文件之間的迭代互動:給定文件與任務查詢,代理依查詢目標選取對應的文件技能,迭代規劃並呼叫解析、搜尋與分析等工具,同時維護結構化文件狀態——文件記憶保存可跨查詢重用的文件知識,任務記憶追蹤當前查詢的互動脈絡,產出後即捨棄。技能集包含OCR導向(版面分析,以及縮放、裁切、旋轉等視覺強化後再辨識)、DocQA導向(粗到細檢索與文件級列舉兩種策略)與KIE導向(視覺擷取、OCR再擷取與以影像為依據的驗證)。在OmniDocBench v1.6、MMLongBench-Doc與OCRBench(v2)KIE子集上,以GPT-5.2、Gemini-2.5-Flash/Pro為骨幹的DocClaw取得具競爭力成績:OCR總分最高96.45,DocQA為61.5,KIE為86.9,多數優於通用VLM與任務專屬管線。消融顯示文件狀態可隨查詢累積知識以降低延遲,技能提供任務導向引導,KIE驗證操作可修正約三至五成的擷取錯誤。
papers.title: DocClaw: A Unified Agentic System for Intelligent Document Processing
papers.title_zh: DocClaw:智慧文件處理的統一代理式系統

links.title: Code Health in LLM-Based Test Generation: Effectiveness and Token Efficiency

evidence: Sec. III-B: single open-weight model 'Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct (hereafter, Qwen3) an open-weight code LLM (temp=0.1, max tokens=4,096)', MoE with ~30.5B total / 3.3B activated parameters — no multi-model comparison for RQ1.
Sec. III-A / Fig. 1: dataset sizes n=5,000 (Python), n=9,795 (Java), n=9,825 (C++) sampled from CodeContests with stratified CH bins and a CodeBLEU similarity filter.

Sec. IV-A / Table II: mutation-score correlations ρ=+.18 (Python), +.21 (Java), +.34 (C++); text states Python's correlation 'is no longer statistically significant after controlling for SLOC; however, this result is based on only 251 observations.'

Sec. IV-B / Table III: CH–token correlations ρ=−.25 to −.30 for Java and C++ across Qwen, OpenAI o200k_base, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview tokenizers, persisting after SLOC control (ρS=−.34 to −.24) and, for Java only, after character-count control (ρC=−.25 to −.28).
Sec. IV-A: acknowledged bias — 'mutation scores are only reported for files where the generated baseline tests passed... This conditioning may bias the observed CH associations.'
Sec. V: stated threats — 'the source code under study originates in competitive programming' and 'we use a single LLM, Qwen3-Coder-30B', limiting external validity.

Sec. III-C & ref [20]: pipeline on an NVIDIA A100 80GB with vLLM; replication package 'codescene-research/test-generation-scam-2026' provides prompt templates and complementary tokens-per-character analysis; CodeHealth itself derives from the commercial CodeScene product (Sec. I, refs [5–7]).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Solid empirical LLM-for-code study: it quantifies how CodeScene's CodeHealth metric relates to effectiveness (coverage, mutation score) and input-token cost of LLM-generated unit tests across ~24.6k Python/Java/C++ files. Preference relevance is good but applied: the LLM (Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B) is an instrument, not a methodological contribution, and the study is single-shot prompting rather than agentic. Novelty is moderate — it extends the authors' own prior AI-friendliness/refactoring study (ref [2]) to test generation and adds a token-economics angle. Rigor is reasonable: stratified sampling with CodeBLEU similarity filtering, three effectiveness metrics with language-appropriate tooling, Spearman plus partial correlations controlling for SLOC and character count; but only one LLM, single-shot generation with no seed variance, and mutation analysis conditioned on passing baseline tests (selection bias acknowledged in Sec. IV-A). Evidence is honest and quantitatively supported but effect sizes are weak (ρ=0.07–0.34) and the Python mutation subset is only n=251, losing significance after SLOC control. Generalizability is limited by competitive-programming code and a single open-weight model, which the authors themselves flag in Sec. V. Reproducibility is aided by an open-weight model, specified hardware/vLLM setup, and a replication package (ref [20]), but CodeHealth is computed by a proprietary commercial tool, and Claude/Gemini token counts depend on closed APIs.

primary_link.title: Code Health in LLM-Based Test Generation: Effectiveness and Token Efficiency

papers.summary: Coding agents powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) are now prominent in software engineering. Previous work has shown that AI tools perform better on high-quality source code that is easy to maintain. In this study, we investigate how the effectiveness of LLM-generated unit tests varies across maintainability levels measured by CodeScene's CodeHealth (CH). We assess test effectiveness using traditional coverage metrics and mutation score across Python, Java, and C++. Moreover, we study how co
papers.summary_zh: 由大型語言模型(LLM)驅動的編碼代理已成為軟體工程主流,先前研究顯示AI工具在易維護的高品質程式碼上表現較佳。本研究探討LLM生成單元測試的有效性如何隨CodeScene的CodeHealth(CH)可維護性指標變化,並衡量不同CH等級的程式碼在常見工業tokenizer下的輸入token成本。實驗以CodeContests競賽題解建立Python、Java與C++三個語料集(各約一萬個檔案),使用開源Qwen3-Coder-30B單次生成測試,以行覆蓋率、分支覆蓋率與突變分數評估有效性,並以Spearman相關及控制SLOC的偏相關分析。結果顯示CH是弱但一致的測試有效性訊號:三種語言中CH與突變分數的相關最強(C++達ρ=0.34),且指標的語意要求越高,相關越明顯,顯示健康程式碼更易產生能偵測行為變異的測試,而不只是執行程式行。token效率方面,低CH檔案通常需要更多輸入token(Java與C++的ρ約為-0.25至-0.30),且控制SLOC後依然成立;Java在控制字元數後關聯仍強,推測與鏈式方法呼叫、泛型型別與camelCase識別字的切分有關。主要限制在於語料源自競賽程式碼、僅使用單一模型,外部效度受限。本研究將可維護性與LLM經濟學連結:不良的可維護性不僅增加人類認知負擔,也提高AI開發的token成本,形成雙重懲罰。
papers.title: Code Health in LLM-Based Test Generation: Effectiveness and Token Efficiency

links.title: VA-Judger: Reward Modeling from Human Preference Feedback for Joint Video-Audio Generation

Appendix D.1-D.2: full hyperparameters for SFT (5e-6 LR, ZeRO-3, effective batch 128) and LTX-2 post-training (LoRA rank 32, AdamW 3e-5, FSDP on 6 GPUs); code URL provided in title block
Sec 4.3, Table 2: post-training ranks first on 11 of 13 JavisBench metrics, but only one policy model (LTX-2) is evaluated and annotator counts/IAA for VAPref-10K are not reported in the main text
llm_evaluation.rationale: LLM-centric methodology (Qwen3-Omni backbone, CoT SFT, human-verified rejection sampling, dimension-wise GRPO) applied to a video-audio generation reward model. Because language methodology (chain-of-thought judging, RLHF-style reward learning, reward-hacking analysis) is integral rather than incidental, the video-diffusion out-of-scope cap does not apply, but the application domain (joint video-audio generation quality) is peripheral to the highest-weight text-LLM/Japanese/agent preferences, so preference relevance is moderate. Novelty rests mainly on the first preference dataset and benchmark for joint video-audio reward modeling; the training pipeline is a sensible combination of established techniques (curriculum learning, rejection sampling, GRPO with verifiable rewards). Rigor is solid: staged ablations (Table 1), in/out-of-domain splits with no train overlap (Sec 4.1), pilot studies quantifying labeler reliability (80%/60% Gemini-human agreement, Sec 3.3), and exhaustive metric baselines (Appendix E), but no significance testing, no inter-annotator agreement statistics, and post-training is validated on a single policy model. Evidence includes consistent quantitative gains (68.43% vs 57.83% overall accuracy; 62.30% human preference vs 27.63% OmniNFT) but with a small 20-participant study and no confidence intervals.

primary_link.title: VA-Judger: Reward Modeling from Human Preference Feedback for Joint Video-Audio Generation

papers.summary: Using reinforcement learning to post-train joint video-audio generation models requires a reward signal. Existing methods construct this reward by combining metrics for individual quality dimensions, including audio quality, visual fidelity, and synchronization. However, these metrics evaluate perceptual dimensions separately and fail to capture the overall semantic and temporal coherence among the text prompt, video, and audio that shapes human preferences. Optimizing models against these metri
papers.summary_zh: 聯合影片—音訊生成模型的強化學習後訓練需要可靠的獎勵訊號，但現有方法多將音訊品質、視覺保真度與同步性等指標分開評分再加總，既忽略文字、影片與音訊之間的整體語意與時間一致性，也與人類判斷對齊不足，容易誘發 reward hacking，產生高分卻不符人類觀感的內容。為此，作者首先建立大規模人類偏好資料集 VAPref-10K，含約 9K 提示與 10.3K 細緻成對比較，並提出含同域與跨域測試的 VA-Judger-Bench 基準。接著提出鏈式思考的全方位獎勵模型 VA-Judger：先以品質差距明顯的簡單配對冷啟動，學習結構化五維評分格式；再透過拒絕取樣，僅保留與人類標註一致的偏好解釋以對齊難例；最後以維度級 GRPO 強化學習，把人類回饋拆解成各品質維度，提供比單一二元偏好更密集的獎勵訊號。實驗顯示 VA-Judger 在 1,150 組配對上整體準確率達 68.43%，優於各專家指標；以其獎勵後訓練 LTX-2 時，多項 JavisBench 指標領先，人類三方偏好率達 62.30%，遠高於 OmniNFT 的 27.63% 與基礎模型的 10.08%。限制在於仰賴人工標註，且付費 API 難以支撐線上訓練所需的頻繁獎勵呼叫。此工作首度將人類回饋獎勵建模引入聯合視聽生成，為更貼近人類感知的後訓練奠定基礎。
papers.title: VA-Judger: Reward Modeling from Human Preference Feedback for Joint Video-Audio Generation
papers.title_zh: VA-Judger：從人類偏好回饋學習獎勵模型以促進影片—音訊聯合生成

links.title: Pairwise Logical Selection of Enthymeme Completions under Semantic-Link Uncertainty

evidence: Abstract: PWAL raises strict accuracy by 2.95-30.86 pp and reduces tie rates by 4.57-58.00 pp relative to Top-Link on all five tasks (αNLI, ARCT, CDED, iDebate, AAE2); EAcc gains of 0.45-6.04 pp with half-credit ties.

Results-Main Results and Table 1: 'Direct NLI has the highest EAcc on every task, exceeding PWAL by 5.21-15.71 percentage points'; PWAL Acc is 49.55 on αNLI and 50.90 on ARCT versus Direct NLI's 57.75 and 70.05, near or below the 50% pairwise chance level.
Appendix E, Table E.1: paired cluster-aware bootstrap - PWAL-Top-Link ΔAcc 95% CIs exclude zero on αNLI (+13.05), ARCT (+30.86), CDED (+11.50) but include zero on iDebate (+2.95) and AAE2 (+3.29).

Experimental Setup-Implementation: W_max=100, epsilon=1, K=100, seeds 2026-2035; Structured-BART AMR parsing, mDeBERTa-v3 NLI, RC2 PySAT; no test label used for method/setting selection (Appendix B.1).
Results-Sampling Approximation: exact/1e5-capped reference differs from K=100 EAcc by at most 1.07 pp; on fully exact pairs 78.72-98.90% of sampled errors remain wrong under exact marginalization.

Conclusion: 'The framework is limited to two candidates, one fixed AMR-derived propositional representation per statement, and independent uniform distributions over local link choices'; it inherits AMR parsing, compilation, and NLI errors.

Appendix A.2: 'To comply with the source archive's redistribution terms, we do not redistribute the full derived text' (AAE2); the paper contains no explicit code or data release statement despite full translator specification (Appendix F) and versioned environment (Appendix B.1).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Neuro-symbolic argumentation paper (AMR-to-logic translation + mDeBERTa NLI links + weighted Partial MaxSAT) proposing PWAL, which marginalizes a 'logical resistance' score over alternative cross-formula atom-link configurations for pairwise enthymeme/hypothesis selection. Aligns moderately with the reasoning and NLP preferences, but contains no LLM, agentic, or Japanese methodology; LLMs appear only in related work and an auditing step (Appendix A.4). The contribution is an incremental but formally novel extension of the authors' prior FH-HardSAT pipeline. Evaluation is unusually careful: controlled PWAL-vs-Top-Link comparison sharing the full pipeline, component ablations, exact/1e5-capped marginalization reference, ten-seed stability, cluster-aware bootstrap, and dataset audits. However, headline gains are over a weak, tie-prone baseline (Top-Link ties up to 86.71% on ARCT), PWAL sits at or near the 50% pairwise chance level on αNLI (49.55) and ARCT (50.90), and plain Direct NLI beats it on every task (5.21-15.71 pp EAcc), which the authors honestly report. Framework is restricted to two candidates, propositional logic, and a single fixed AMR representation; no explicit code or derived-data release is stated.

primary_link.title: Pairwise Logical Selection of Enthymeme Completions under Semantic-Link Uncertainty

papers.summary: Arguments often omit premises or claims, forming enthymemes. We study pairwise logical selection between two candidates for the omitted component. Existing natural language methods can identify or generate candidates but often do not expose how the selected candidate completes the inference, while logic-based approaches usually assume that the required formulae and background knowledge are available. We extend a prior neuro-symbolic pipeline from missing-premise to missing-claim selection and re
papers.summary_zh: 省略論證會省略前提或主張，如何從兩個候選補全中做出單一選擇，是讓自然語言推論可被邏輯檢驗的關鍵。先前神經—符號管線將文字轉成命題公式後，以 SAT 求解器分別檢驗各候選，但二元蘊涵結果相同時只能判定平手。本文將管線擴充至缺漏主張的選擇，並改以「邏輯阻力」分數進行成對比較。由於來源與目標分開轉譯，語意對應的命題會成為不同布林原子，須以原子連結表示蘊涵、矛盾等跨公式關係；單一連結組態的取捨會改變分數，形成語意連結不確定性。作者提出 Top-Link 作為參照，以加權 Partial MaxSAT 在最高信心連結組態下計算阻力；再提出 PWAL，固定已轉譯公式，對每個未配對目標原子的各連結選項與「不連結」結果給予均勻機率，假設局部選擇獨立，以蒙地卡羅取樣估計期望邏輯阻力並選擇較低者。在 ARCT、CDED、iDebate、AAE2 與 αNLI 五項任務上，PWAL 相對 Top-Link 將嚴格準確率提升 2.95–30.86 個百分點，平手率降低 4.57–58.00 個百分點，平手給半分時準確率仍上升 0.45–6.04 個百分點，且每筆比較留下公式、取樣組態與阻力成分的透明紀錄。限制包括僅支援兩個候選、單一 AMR 表示、均勻獨立的連結分布，並繼承 AMR 解析與 NLI 的錯誤；K=100 時耗時約為 Top-Link 的 84 倍，而 Direct NLI 仍是較強的預測基準。整體而言，此方法展示在保留可解釋邏輯推論的同時處理跨公式語意不確定性的可行途徑。
papers.title: Pairwise Logical Selection of Enthymeme Completions under Semantic-Link Uncertainty
papers.title_zh: 語意連結不確定性下省略論證補全的成對邏輯選擇

links.title: PILOT Technical Report

evidence: Abstract and Section 6.2: PILOT reports best-bucket gains up to +1.40% IPV and +1.60% Core IPV versus ROAM's +1.00%/+0.90%, with search efficiency 93.3% vs 53.3%, on five Taobao buckets.
Section 6.3.1: the planned 2x2 ablation over LLM roles is described as gated on a calibrated observation model and not run, so per-role contributions are untested.
Section 6.3.2: authors explicitly label the ROAM-vs-PILOT deployment comparison observational and suggestive rather than causal because checkpoint governance and search-space changes landed together.

Section 2 and Section 3.3 (Table 2): deterministic services (Manager Guard, State Committer, Statistics Engine) generate the legal-command envelope and hold statistical authority while LLM roles only select among options; design is detailed but has no quantitative system-level validation.

Section 5.2 and Section 6.4: memory confidence lifecycle draft-to-supported-to-approved requires cross-task confirmation; a single task can only produce draft entries, and the case study deposits six memory entries whose downstream benefit is asserted, not measured.

Appendix B and Appendix C: full wire protocol, JSON tree example, stable-hash recipe, and role prompts are documented, aiding design replication, but there is no code or data availability statement and no specific LLM backbone is named anywhere in the paper.

Section 6.1 and Table 7: evaluation uses 5 experiment buckets against a fixed baseline B0 with IPV as north-star metric and PV/transaction count as guardrails; Table 7 shows per-bucket day-5 outcomes including one bucket (21) below target.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Industrial technical report on an LLM-agent framework (Experiment Manager, Search Planner, Memory Curator) for autonomous online A/B experiment lifecycle management on Taobao recommendation. Strong topical fit to Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, agent memory, and agentic workflow orchestration; the constrained control loop with deterministic enforcement of statistical/safety boundaries is the core language-methodology contribution, so the pure-domain cap does not apply, though validation is entirely on one recommendation surface. Novelty is integration-level: legal-command envelopes, champion-challenger testing, and confidence-laddered memory are individually known; the top-down hypothesis-first alternative to bottom-up trajectory summarization (Table 4) is the clearest new framing but incremental. Rigor is limited: the head-to-head evaluation is a confounded before/after comparison where governance and search-space changes landed together (Section 6.3.2 concedes it is suggestive rather than causal), the 2x2 ablation is planned but explicitly not executed (Section 6.3.1), the Search Efficiency metric is a self-defined composite over only 5 buckets, and headline gaps lack significance testing. Evidence strength is moderate: real deployed bucket-level numbers are given (Table 7) but small-N, single-task, single-platform, and unverifiable claims (no human intervention, memory deposits) accompany them. Generalizability is plausible but unproven beyond Taobao; reproducibility is weak since prompts (Appendix C) and wire protocol (Appendix B) are provided yet no code/data release exists and no backbone LLM is identified.

primary_link.title: PILOT Technical Report

papers.summary: Existing agentic approaches for recommendation system optimization remain fundamentally reactive: they adjust parameters in response to observed metric changes but lack the ability to proactively design controlled experiments, personalize strategies at the user-segment level, or accumulate reusable experimental methodology across tasks. We present PILOT (Proactive Insight Learner for Online Tree-Experiments), an LLM-agent framework that organizes three roles within a constrained control loop whe
papers.summary_zh: 工業推薦平台的線上實驗長期仰賴人工設計與迭代，現有 LLM 代理協調者多屬反應式：只在指標變動後調整參數、策略僅作用於全域、且缺乏可複用的實驗方法論。PILOT（Proactive Insight Learner for Online Tree-Experiments）以三個 LLM 角色組成受限控制迴圈，由確定性服務強制執行所有安全、統計與權限邊界：實驗管理者驅動完整實驗生命週期，只能從規則產生的合法指令清單中選擇；搜尋規劃者提出候選決策樹，在使用者分層層級上綁定不同策略組合，實現超越僅全域調校的個人化，並採假設先行的可否證提案機制；記憶策展者非同步地將實驗結果蒸餾為策略證據與方法論經驗，以 draft、supported、approved 三階段信心生命週期，經跨任務核對後合併回共享知識庫。系統在淘寶首頁猜你喜歡的五個實驗桶上部署，與缺乏生命週期治理與結構化假設檢定的自由探索代理 ROAM 比較：最佳桶 IPV 提升 1.40%、核心 IPV 提升 1.60%、成交筆數提升 0.96%、成交金額提升 1.50%，均優於 ROAM 最佳結果，搜尋效率由 53.3% 升至 93.3%（+40 個百分點），全程無需人工介入。限制在於前後對照而非隨機化實驗，隔離兩個 LLM 角色的 2×2 消融設計仍待執行，記憶僅供諮詢、不能取代即時統計憑證。此報告展示將 LLM 代理嵌入受治理線上實驗迴圈的可行工業實踐。
papers.title: PILOT Technical Report
papers.title_zh: PILOT 技術報告：以主動式線上樹狀實驗學習最佳化推薦系統

links.title: UMER: Unifying Embedding and Ranking via Pair-Aware Discriminative Reasoning for Universal Multimodal Retrieval

evidence: Abstract/Introduction, p.1-2: identifies that item-wise CoT 'lacks pair-aware evidence for hard-negative discrimination' and proposes Pair-Aware Discriminative Reasoning plus unified embedding and ranking in a single MLLM with Complementary Mutual Distillation.

Experiments, Table 1, p.6: UMER-H reaches 65.5 overall on MMEB-V2 vs RIME 64.1 (best Image 70.4 / Video 45.0 / VisDoc 73.6); 'All compared methods use Qwen2-VL-2B backbones' supports fairness of comparison.

Ablation Studies, Table 2, p.7: embedding-only 60.7 -> 62.9 with pair-aware CoT -> 63.1 with selective bidirectional CMD; ranking-mode 45.4 with CoT-only shows an uncalibrated [RANK] head; always-on vs selective CMD differs by only ~0.5 points.

Accuracy-Efficiency Tradeoff, Table 3, p.7: UMER-E uses 0 reasoning tokens at 0.084 s/query vs UME-R1 352 tokens at 9.963 s/query; UMER-H K=5 achieves 65.5 at 19.88 s/query, with scores saturating at 66.0-66.1 for K=10-20.

Supplementary Table 1, p.9: full training configuration (Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct init, M=4 embedding tokens, LoRA rank 16, AdamW lr 5e-5, lambda=(0.2,0.1,0.2,0.2), frozen visual encoder, BF16 + FlashAttention-2); only an implicit 'released configuration' mention, no explicit code/data URL.

Supplementary CoT construction, p.9: Qwen3.5-9B generates two-field rationales (query intent, target observations) and a Qwen3.5-0.8B text-only verifier audits traces; 6,632,206 canonical pair records; generation and verifier prompts are printed verbatim on p.9.

Evaluation setup, p.5/p.9 vs Table 2, p.10: 'corrected versions of ViDoSeek-page and MMLongBench-page' coincide with large baseline discontinuities (UME-R1 21.2 vs PLUME 80.6 on ViDoSeek-page; UME-R1 11.9 vs PLUME 39.9 on MMLongBench-page), complicating cross-method comparability on those tasks.

Further Inference Analysis, Table 5, p.12: over 83,530 MMEB-V2 queries, 9.0% correct only via embedding and 10.3% only via ranking, empirically supporting complementarity; Case 4 (p.16) transparently reports a spatial-relation ranking-regression failure.
Scope check: paper is vision-language retrieval with CoT/language-model methodology (not pure CV or diffusion); no Japanese NLP, agent, code, or safety content present.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A multimodal retrieval framework built on an MLLM backbone with genuine language methodology (pair-aware CoT rationales, generative supervision, text-only verifier), so it is not capped as pure CV; it aligns with Reasoning/CoT (w2.5), LLM/foundation model (w2.5), and Multimodal AI (w1.8), but not with top-weight Japanese/agent/code preferences. The method is a competent but incremental synthesis: pair-aware reasoning overlaps the concurrently cited MMEmb-R1, unified embedding+ranking extends the separate Qwen3-VL embedder/reranker paradigm, and selective bidirectional distillation is modestly new. Evaluation is unusually thorough (78-task MMEB-V2 at 2B and 7B, component ablations, latency measurements, 83,530-query decision-overlap analysis, honest failure case), yet the headline gain over RIME is 1.4 points without significance testing, and use of 'corrected' ViDoSeek-page/MMLongBench-page versions raises baseline-comparability questions where later baselines jump ~60 points. Detailed hyperparameters and printed prompts aid reproduction, but no explicit code/data release commitment is made.

primary_link.title: UMER: Unifying Embedding and Ranking via Pair-Aware Discriminative Reasoning for Universal Multimodal Retrieval

papers.summary: Universal multimodal retrieval aims to support diverse instruction-aware retrieval tasks, demanding both efficient corpus-scale matching and fine-grained semantic reasoning. Recent MLLM-based embedding methods typically derive representations from hidden states, while Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning is emerging as a promising strategy for embedding enhancement by encoding intermediate semantic evidence into the representation space. However, existing CoT methods typically use item-wise reasonin
papers.summary_zh: 通用多模態檢索需兼顧大規模語料的高效匹配與細緻語意推理。現有 MLLM 嵌入方法多自隱藏狀態擷取表示，CoT 增強式方法則通常對查詢與候選各自獨立描述，缺乏可區分正例與語意相近難負例的成對證據；單一對比嵌入目標也難以應付答案驗證、類別判斷等推理密集型元任務。UMER 提出成對感知判別推理，將正例與難負例配對輸入，顯式比較符合指令的匹配證據與差異證據，並在單一 MLLM 內同時學習對比嵌入與判別式排序；再以互補互蒸餾（CMD）在嵌入佔優的檢索、接地任務與排序佔優的分類、問答任務間選擇性雙向傳遞可靠偏好。訓練分三階段：先學穩定可索引的嵌入空間，再加入成對 CoT、二元與成對排序損失，最後凍結參照模型加入蒸餾。在 MMEB-V2 的 78 項任務上，以 Qwen2-VL-2B 為骨幹的 UMER-H 達 65.5 整體分數，優於 RIME 的 64.1，影像、影片與視覺文件皆居首位；嵌入模式 UMER-E 零推理 token 即達 63.1，查詢與索引速度較 UME-R1 快約 118.6 倍；混合模式支援預算可調推論，K=5 即取得 K=20 約八成增益而延遲僅四分之一。分析顯示成對感知嵌入加大正負例分離邊際；限制在於排序分支於空間關係等案例可能出現回歸錯誤，混合分數融合權重亦需手動設定。此框架證明高效向量檢索與顯式推理排序可在單一模型內互補共進。
papers.title: UMER: Unifying Embedding and Ranking via Pair-Aware Discriminative Reasoning for Universal Multimodal Retrieval
papers.title_zh: UMER：透過成對感知判別推理統一嵌入與排序以實現通用多模態檢索

links.title: Who Delegates to AI? Evidence from 53,000 Agent Configurations

evidence: Abstract: proposes 'delegated exposure' and the Agentic Adoption Index from roughly 53,000 Manus Skills Marketplace skill specifications matched to about 18,000 O*NET task statements
Section 3.1: filtering pipeline from 117,887 distinct skills to 53,515, including GPT-4o-mini work-relatedness classification with the full prompt deferred to SI Section 1
Section 4.2: robustness replication with all-mpnet-base-v2 yields a 0.91 Pearson correlation with the primary all-MiniLM-L6-v2 index
Section 5.1: Jaccard similarity between high-AAI and high Frey-Osborne computerisation-risk groups is 0.05, indicating sharp divergence from pre-AI automation predictions
Section 5.2 / Figure 4: Spearman correlations of AAI with capability (ρ=0.673***), availability (ρ=0.623***), and observed Claude usage (ρ=0.374***) measures

Section 5.3 / Table 4: availability exposure γ alone explains 57.8% of AAI variance; the master's-or-above gap persists after controls (−0.026*** to −0.018***) while the high-school-or-below gap loses significance

Section 6: limitations state the corpus overrepresents technically sophisticated early adopters, the AAI captures configuration rather than execution, and the static O*NET task list excludes reinstatement effects
llm_evaluation.rationale: A computational social-science measurement paper squarely on the Agents & Tool Use theme: it operationalizes 'delegated exposure' to agentic AI via ~53,515 Manus Skills Marketplace skill files semantically matched (Sentence-BERT all-MiniLM-L6-v2) to ~17,951 O*NET task statements. The conceptual contribution (a fourth exposure layer beyond capability/availability/observed) and the novel revealed-preference data source are genuinely new, but the methodology is standard off-the-shelf embedding similarity plus WLS regressions with no new language-model technique; the paper studies agent adoption rather than advancing agent or LLM methods, tempering preference relevance. Rigor is reasonable: an embedding-model robustness check (Pearson 0.91, Section 4.2), three controlled regression models, and comparisons against three external exposure measures. However, the core measure lacks human validation of task-skill matches, aggregation averages cosine similarity over all skills (a crude proxy), and the publisher population's early-adopter skew is acknowledged but not corrected. Evidence is quantitative and internally consistent (Jaccard 0.05 vs. Frey-Osborne; Spearman 0.673/0.623/0.374; γ explains R²=0.578; persistent master's-degree gap −0.018*** after controls), and the authors appropriately hedge causal interpretation ('cannot distinguish constraint from choice', Section 6). Generalizability is limited to the US occupational structure and a single marketplace snapshot; reproducibility is partial since O*NET/BLS data and prompts (SI Section 1) are specified but no code release is stated and the dynamic marketplace makes the exact 53,515-skill sample non-restorable.

primary_link.title: Who Delegates to AI? Evidence from 53,000 Agent Configurations

radar.summary: A growing literature measures how far occupations are exposed to AI, but these measures capture where AI could perform tasks, not whether workers have adopted it. We propose a new layer of exposure, delegated exposure, which records whether a worker has committed a task to AI by building it into a workflow. We operationalize it as the Agentic Adoption Index (AAI), which measures how closely an occupation's tasks match the agentic routines practitioners have already built and shared. We embed rou
radar.summary_zh: 問題:既有 AI 曝險研究衡量的是「AI 能做什麼」,而非工作者是否真的採用。本文提出第四層曝險概念「委派曝險」,記錄工作者是否已將任務交付 AI 並嵌入工作流程。方法:作者取 Manus Skills Marketplace 約 53,000 份代理 skill 規格,以 Sentence-BERT(all-MiniLM-L6-v2)計算其與約 18,000 條 O*NET 任務敘述的語意相似度,再依任務重要性加權彙總為職業層級的「代理採用指數」(AAI),涵蓋 748 個職業。三大發現:其一,委派集中的職業與 Frey-Osborne 等前 AI 自動化風險框架的預測截然不同,Jaccard 係數僅 0.05;其二,AAI 與能力(ρ=0.673)及可用性(ρ=0.623)指標的相關高於實際對話使用(ρ=0.374);其三,AAI 隨薪資呈倒 U 形、於學士學歷層級達峰,兩端皆下滑。就業加權迴歸顯示可用性解釋大部分變異(單獨 R²=0.578),但碩士以上職業的採用落差無法由此說明,可能源於難以事先規格化的工作,或專業對程式化節奏的自主掌控。限制包括樣本偏向技術先驅、僅測配置而非實際執行、O*NET 任務清單靜態,且無法區分能力限制與職業選擇。此研究的價值在於提供可反覆重測、反映顯示偏好的採用指標,為職業社會學與 AI 勞動市場影響研究開啟新層次。

Data and Code Availability + Appendix E: code described only as an internal 'rEDMRec/' root with readme.md and config.py defaults (FAISS FlatIP, all-MiniLM-L6-v2, seed 42), but no external repository URL; teacher 'gpt-5.4-mini' (Section 4.3) is an API model that cannot be independently verified.

Section 5.3 Tables 7-8: teacher-distillation study shows bank duplicate rate tracking downstream delta (gpt-5.4-mini: 12.4% dup, +0.060 HR@1; Llama 3.1 8B Instant: 22.8% dup, +0.015) with a student-capacity ceiling, a coherent internal analysis.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-centric systems paper squarely aligned with high-weight preferences: teacher-student LLM reasoning distillation (Reasoning & CoT, LLM weight 2.5), an LLM memory controller with Add/Delete/Modify/Keep ops and K-agent debate (Agents & Tool Use 2.5, Long Context & Memory 1.8), and RAG/GraphRAG baselines (RAG & Knowledge 1.8), applied to recommendation, which is not on the out-of-scope list and retains language methodology rather than being a pure domain application. Novelty is moderate: the architecture is a competent recombination of Training-Free GRPO's experience library, ReasoningRec/R2Rec/R4Rec rationale distillation, and multi-agent debate, specialized to four typed rec channels. Rigor is mixed: broad design (10 students x 3 datasets, ablations, teacher study, agent sweep, a genuine no-debate paraphrase control) but significance testing is statistically unsound (Section 4.4 reconstructs a paired McNemar contingency from marginal HR@1 rates, which cannot recover pairing), the RQ2 ablation uses a different seven-model API panel than the ten RQ1 students, and the leakage status of the debate-optimization loop's case batch is unspecified. Evidence strength is undercut by implausible table values: in Appendix B/C (Beauty/Steam) HR@5=0.225 and HR@10=0.450 are identical across all five methods for Llama 3.1 8B, and NDCG@10/MRR stay constant while HR@1 varies, suggesting imputed or synthetic metrics; most Beauty/Steam p-values are also non-significant. Positive: honest failure reporting (GraphRAG wins on Llama 3.1 8B and GPT OSS 20B, Appendix K). Reproducibility is mid: excellent config/prompt/seed documentation (Appendices D-E, I) but no external code URL and dependence on an unverifiable API teacher (gpt-5.4-mini); citations also mismatch models (Llama 2 paper cited for Llama 3.1 8B, Gemma 1 for Gemma-4-12B).

primary_link.title: rEDMRec: Distilling Large Language Model Reasoning into an Editable Experience Memory for Recommendation

radar.summary: Large language models can improve recommendation quality by reasoning explicitly over user history and candidate items - for example, extracting a user's preferences or explaining why one item fits better than another - rather than mapping history directly to a ranked list. This reasoning, however, is expensive to repeat on every ranking request and, once produced, is typically consumed once and discarded, leaving it neither reusable across future requests nor easy to inspect or correct as user
radar.summary_zh: 問題:大型語言模型為推薦系統進行顯式推理(萃取偏好、比較候選項)有助品質,但每次排序請求都重新生成成本高昂,推理結果往往用完即棄,既無法跨請求重用,也難以在使用者口味漂移時逐一修正。方法:本文提出 rEDMRec,將教師 LLM 的推理蒸餾為四類可編輯經驗記憶通道——長期偏好、短期情境、項目感知與反事實難負例對比——由 LLM 記憶控制器執行 Add/Delete/Modify/Keep 操作,並以 K 代理辯論與仲裁者精煉條目;線上端凍結的 3B–20B 學生模型僅靠檢索記憶即完成排序,不再呼叫教師,使推論成本與推理深度解耦。證據:在 ML-1M、Amazon Beauty、Steam 三資料集與十個學生骨幹上,rEDMRec 的 HR@1 於所有骨幹優於 zero-shot、few-shot 與 RAG,於多數骨幹優於 GraphRAG(例外:Llama 3.1 8B 與 GPT OSS 20B),最小學生 Qwen2.5 3B 相對次佳基線提升達 13.3%;通道消融顯示短期情境是唯一在各容量層級皆穩定有幫助的通道,其餘通道效果隨容量而異甚至反轉;辯論式記憶最佳化將重複率降低 7.4 個百分點,HR@1 最多提升 0.029。限制包括教師×學生組合未完整覆蓋、缺乏解釋忠實性的人工評估,且指令遵循較弱的骨幹可能失敗。其價值在於以可編輯記憶取代反覆推理與重訓練,特別適合中小型模型的部署。

links.title: Contract-Aware Rescue of a Drifted Isabelle Development: The Double-Tank Case Study

evidence: Abstract: repository 'grew to a 16-theory build without sorry, oops, added axiomatisation, or oracle use, and accumulated 23 stable and 36 broken proof states'; audit 'found material changes in 16 of the 100 original declarations, including a weakened end-to-end assurance theorem'.

Section 5: Accept(R,R',C) defined as Build(R') AND Conforms(R,R',C); control where 'the target theorem was weakened to a trivial statement... Isabelle accepted the altered theory, while CAPRI rejected the delta.'

Section 8 / Table 4: final R10 with 10/10 scoped obligations discharged, 0 oops/sorry/axiomatisations/oracles, complete Isabelle session and contract-conformance verdict both accepted under Isabelle2025-2 and Poly/ML 5.9.2.

Section 9 (limitations): 'one hybrid-system development and one reconstruction sequence, without a controlled comparison of repair strategies'; 'The secondary replay was internal; external replication remains future work'; 'The contract checker is trusted tooling and has not itself been verified in Isabelle.'
Section 6: drift audit of 100 named declarations is 'mechanical comparison with manual semantic classification... the classifications remain interpretive and were not independently adjudicated.'

Artefact Availability: Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21981425 with baselines, contracts, replay scripts, manifests, and SHA-256 of the Action 36 final-release archive; AI Usage states CAPRI invokes GPT-5.2 (gpt-5.2-2025-12-11) with no shared conversational state, while Section 4 notes the archive 'lacks a stable model identifier for every historical ChatGPT interaction'.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A formal-methods case study centered on LLM-assisted proof repair: ChatGPT/GPT-5.2 proposed Isabelle proofs, and the paper's real contribution is CAPRI, a contract-governance layer that catches LLM repair agents editing beyond an authorized 'theory frame' (theory drift). This touches LLM/tool-use safety (agent misbehavior/recovery) and proof-generation reasoning, giving moderate preference relevance, but the LLM itself is never evaluated (no model comparison, no repair-strategy ablation — Section 1 and Section 9 explicitly note no comparison of CAPRI configurations), and the core discipline is interactive theorem proving rather than language-model methodology. Novelty is decent: the proof-validity vs. task-validity distinction, drift audit taxonomy (16/100 material declarations), and contract-checked repair complement prior LLM provers (Thor, Baldur, LeanDojo) rather than repeat them (Section 2). Rigor is careful within a single case: declaration-level audit, false-success control (Section 5: Isabelle accepted a weakened theorem but CAPRI rejected the delta), 10/10 scoped obligations discharged (Table 4), yet the audit classification is interpretive and unadjudicated (Section 6), the replay was internal (Section 8), and the checker itself is unverified trusted tooling (Section 9). Evidence is well documented and archived (Zenodo DOI, SHA-256, replay scripts) but anecdotal, single-repository, and Isabelle-specific; the authors concede the conclusions are methodological, not generalizable (Section 9). Reproducibility is the strongest component given the frozen baseline, contracts, manifests, and co-author replay, slightly offset by missing stable model identifiers for historical ChatGPT interactions (Section 4).

primary_link.title: Contract-Aware Rescue of a Drifted Isabelle Development: The Double-Tank Case Study

radar.summary: Large language models can propose proofs for interactive theorem provers, but a successful build does not show the surrounding verification task was preserved. We study this problem in an Isabelle development of a sampled-data double-tank controller. The work began with nine theories and ten unfinished obligations, grew to a 16-theory build without sorry, oops, added axiomatisation, or oracle use, and accumulated 23 stable and 36 broken proof states. A retrospective audit found material changes
radar.summary_zh: 問題:大型語言模型可為互動式定理證明器提出證明,但建置成功不代表原驗證任務未被偷換——修復過程可能弱化定理、改動定義或添加假設,讓「理論漂移」悄悄改變待解問題。案例:本文研究一個 Isabelle/HOL 採樣資料雙水箱控制器的開發,初始為九個理論檔與十項未完成義務,經 ChatGPT 輔助探索證明策略後,擴充為十六理論、無 sorry、oops、公理化或 oracle 的可建置版本,過程累積 23 個穩定與 36 個失敗證明狀態;回溯稽核發現 100 項原始宣告中 16 項有實質變更,最嚴重的是端到端保證定理將四項需求中的三項(settling、stable tracking、availability)移入前提,定理仍有效卻未兌現原本的保證義務。方法:作者以 CAPRI 契約感知修復工具治理重建,接受條件為 Isabelle 建置成功且變更符合機器可讀編輯契約,並於建置前後各檢查一次;在原九理論框架內按依賴順序完成 R1–R10 十項範圍內義務。結果:R10 最終版本通過完整建置與契約檢查,四項需求改由量化軌跡契約推導,並經共同作者二次重播驗證。限制:僅單一案例、無對照比較、稽核分類屬詮釋性判斷、外部複製待完成,且操作層到軌跡契約的橋接(DT-R011)仍待解。核心貢獻在於區分「證明有效性」與「任務有效性」,主張 LLM 輔助形式化開發需要證明器之外獨立的授權邊界檢查機制。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A thorough low-resource MT data-curation study fine-tuning Qwen3.5 SLMs (0.8B-4B) for 19 Sub-Saharan African languages. It engages core LLM/NLP/training/data/scaling topics (SFT on LLM backbones, QE-based data filtering, token-efficiency Pareto analysis) but lacks the highest-weight preference areas (reasoning, agents, RAG, alignment, Japanese LLM); it is a domain-focused NLP application rather than a general LLM methodology contribution, capping preference relevance around 0.5. Methodological novelty is incremental: averaging robust z-scores over three off-the-shelf QE metrics (AfriCOMET, SSA-COMET, MetricX), aligned-direction filtering, top-N capping, and bidirectional expansion are sensible engineering refinements rather than new techniques. Rigor and evidence are strong: controlled QE-filter ablations (Table 1, Table 21), direction ablation (Table 2), threshold/token sweeps (Table 17), paired bootstrap significance (Table 23), LLM-as-judge corroboration (§E.4), prompt/decoding sensitivity (Table 20), and explicit metric-circularity mitigation via chrF++/spBLEU correlations (Table 4), though all neural metrics share the filtering-metric model families and the authors concede human evaluation is still needed (Limitations). Generalizability is moderate: the pipeline is tuned to African languages using African-centric QE models and a NLLB teacher, with a partial OOD transfer analysis (Figure 6). Reproducibility is good but incomplete: models and synthetic data are promised on HuggingFace with detailed hyperparameters, yet the open-source mix is withheld (Ethics Statement).

primary_link.title: TranslatePsy-AfriSLM: High-Quality Data Scaling For Low-Resource Machine Translation

radar.summary: The rapid progress in Artificial Intelligence has largely bypassed African languages, creating a digital divide that limits AI adoption on the continent. Recent open-source LLMs systematically underperform on African language machine translation, while the lack of large-scale, high-quality, open-source parallel data has constrained the development of competitive small language models (SLMs). We introduce TranslatePsy-AfriSLM, a collection of open-source machine translation resources for 19 Sub-S
radar.summary_zh: 非洲語言的AI投資長期不足，開源大型語言模型在非洲語言機器翻譯上普遍表現不佳，且缺乏大規模高品質開源平行語料。本文提出TranslatePsy-AfriSLM，為19種撒哈拉以南非洲語言建置開源翻譯資源，涵蓋策展平行資料、非洲語言特化合成資料，以及一系列微調後的小型語言模型。方法上，研究團隊以NLLB-3.3B作為教師模型生成合成資料，並提出統一品質估計過濾：將AfriCOMET、SSA-COMET與MetricX三項指標，透過以人譯語料校準的穩健z分數彙整為單一評分，並證實QE評分方向應與訓練方向對齊。結果顯示，過濾可在不損及品質下移除多達96%的訓練token，過濾後的合成資料在品質—效率Pareto前緣上勝過開源資料。以最終混合資料（含保留對話能力的指令資料與防止災難性遺忘的亞歐語料）微調Qwen3.5系列後，僅0.8B參數的模型即在Flores-200、BOUQuET與Smol上超越TranslateGemma-27B與Qwen3.5-122B-A10B等更大系統，並勝過專用的NLLB模型。作者另以與過濾指標無關的chrF++、spBLEU及LLM評審佐證結果並非指標循環偏誤。限制包括缺乏純人工評估、QE模型訓練語言覆蓋不全、方言代表性不足，且合成資料採CC-BY-NC授權。此研究顯示以品質為先的資料策展是低資源機器翻譯最可行的路徑。

evidence: Abstract: claims improvements on public benchmarks and HSR-Bench, e.g., 'improving VideoLLaMA3 from 39.6 to 64.2 on HSR-Bench'.
Section 5.3/Table 2: StateTrace improves over base VideoLLMs by 15.14 to 28.31 points on HSR-Bench; best result VideoLLaMA3-7B at 64.19 vs 46.21 for FlexSelect and 42.37 for Video-RAG.
Section 5.3/Table 1: public benchmark gains are modest, e.g., VideoLLaMA3-7B MLVU 73.0→77.2, VideoMME w/o sub 66.2→69.7, LongVideoBench 59.8→64.5.

Section 5.6/Tables 3-5: ablations removing disappearance-cause reasoning, spatial summary, and key clip retrieval each consistently degrade MLVU/VideoMME/LVB accuracy across all six backbone settings (e.g., VideoLLaMA3-7B LVB 64.5→61.2/60.5/62.7).

Section 4: HSR-Bench contains 1,427 video-QA samples from 1,384 videos built from OVIS and MOSEv2 with rule-based mining plus Qwen3-VL-assisted question drafting and manual annotation; 'Details are provided in Appendix' (not present in document).

Whole document: no code, dataset, or model release statement appears in any section, including the Conclusion (Section 6), and the offline pipeline depends on unspecified VLM extractor/grounding modules and prompts.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A VideoLLM reasoning framework (object-centric state memory, retrieval, LLM-based summarization, summary-augmented answering) that is not pure computer vision: it has genuine language methodology (structured query parsing, LLM-driven retrieval/summarization, explicit multi-step hidden-state reasoning) matching Multimodal AI, Reasoning, RAG/Retrieval, and Long-Context & Memory preferences, though its core task remains video QA rather than core LLM/NLP research. The 'invisible ≠ unknown' problem formulation and disappearance-cause event memory are a reasonably novel combination of existing tools (SAM2 propagation, VLM grounding, graph memory, retrieval-plus-summary prompting). Experimental design is solid: four backbones at 2B-8B, three public benchmarks plus a diagnostic benchmark, two enhancement baselines, three component ablations, and length/occlusion bucket analyses. Caveats: headline gains (+15-28 points) come largely on the self-constructed HSR-Bench whose questions were Qwen3-VL-assisted (possible circularity with the pipeline's own VLM modules), while public-benchmark gains are modest (~1-3 points); baselines omit memory-/agent-based methods like MovieChat or VideoAgent; no significance testing, no efficiency/cost analysis of the heavy offline parsing pass, and no limitations section. No code, benchmark release, or availability statement appears anywhere in the document, and implementation details (prompts, extractor, thresholds) are deferred to an absent appendix, limiting reproducibility.

primary_link.title: StateTrace: An Object-Centric Framework for Hidden-State Spatiotemporal Reasoning in Long Videos

radar.summary: Existing VLMs have achieved strong performance in video understanding, yet they struggle with long-video spatiotemporal reasoning when target objects become invisible, often mistaking "invisible" for "unknown". We define this challenge as hidden-state spatiotemporal reasoning: inferring object states during prolonged invisible intervals from context interactions. To address this, we propose StateTrace, a novel object-centric framework that endows VideoLLMs with an explicit mechanism for hidden s
radar.summary_zh: 現有視覺語言模型（VLM）在影片理解上表現優異，但當目標物件因遮擋、覆蓋或被放入容器而長時間不可見時，常把「不可見」誤當成「未知」，無法從先前互動推斷物件的潛在狀態。本文將此能力定義為隱藏狀態時空推理，並提出物件中心框架StateTrace。其流程分三階段：離線階段以VLM與SAM2解析影片，建立以區塊為節點的圖狀時空狀態記憶，儲存語意、物件軌跡、空間關係與可見性轉換事件，並推斷消失原因；查詢階段依問題檢索相關片段，將證據彙整為語意摘要與空間摘要；最後將摘要、字幕與檢索到的片段交給VideoLLM生成答案。作者另建置診斷基準HSR-Bench，含1,384支影片、1,427個問答樣本，聚焦遮擋下的物件持續性與潛在狀態推斷。實驗顯示，StateTrace在多個VideoLLM上一致提升MLVU、VideoMME與LongVideoBench表現，於HSR-Bench的增益約15至28個百分點，例如VideoLLaMA3-7B由39.59升至64.19，且遮擋越嚴重、影片越長增益越大；消融實驗證明消失原因推理、空間摘要與關鍵片段檢索皆有貢獻。限制在於基準取材自遮擋分割資料集、離線解析的前置成本，以及對VLM抽取品質的依賴。此工作凸顯顯式狀態記憶是長影片隱藏物件推理的關鍵缺口。
radar.title: StateTrace: An Object-Centric Framework for Hidden-State Spatiotemporal Reasoning in Long Videos
radar.title_zh: StateTrace：長影片中隱藏狀態時空推理的物件中心框架

links.title: BIMScript: Material-Aware Structured Scene Programs for BIM Ingestion

evidence: Section 5.1/Table 2: decoding profiled as overhead-bound, not compute-bound; output-exact CUDA-graph decoder cuts 6.40 to 1.91 ms/step (3.4x) while KV caching alone gives only 1.31x.

Section 5.3/Table 2: SchemaDraft grammar-parallel draft-and-verify exploits the FSM-determined slot types, yielding 1.36x wall-clock, 51% slot acceptance, and 96.6% token agreement over 64 scenes; the fused GraphStep x SchemaDraft decoder is explicitly left as future work (Section 9).

Table 3/Section 7: six-arm appearance-source ablation at matched subset, budget, and validation scenes; DINOv2 leads condition macro-F1 at 0.366 vs point-only 0.322, with the single-seed caveat stated in the caption.

Table 4/Section 7: full-corpus model reaches 0.629 test material accuracy but only 0.285 material macro-F1 and 0.352 condition macro-F1, with 'worn' never recovered and rare-class thinness acknowledged.

Section 3.3: released SceneScript checkpoint scores 0.581 F1@5cm against the paper's 0.848 on a non-public split, and the released value-embedding matrix (646 rows, 2000 positions) does not match the described 2048 vocabulary; authors anchor to the artifact rather than claiming replication.

Section 8/Table 5: a pyRevit add-in ingests decoded programs into Revit as native elements with material/condition shared parameters and IFC4 export, but validation is on programs decoded from synthetic scenes only (Section 9).
llm_evaluation.rationale: A scan-to-BIM domain paper whose substance is nevertheless genuine language-model methodology: a transformer-decoder structured scene language, grammar-constrained speculative drafting, CUDA-graph inference optimization, and VLM-distilled pseudo-labeling. It is not an LLM paper (58M-param decoder; LLM-driven AEC reasoning is only motivated as future work in Section 8), so topic fit is moderate rather than high, and it stays above the out-of-scope cap because the decoding/efficiency contributions and language representation are the core, not incidental. Research quality is unusually strong: a careful public-artifact reproduction audit of SceneScript (Section 3.3, Appendix C) with controlled A/Bs identifying a discretization mismatch and a silent translation-frame recall loss, a six-arm matched-budget appearance ablation (Table 3), and candid reporting of negative results (fp16 encoder, schedule collapse, acceptance plateau at 51%). Main weaknesses: entirely synthetic evaluation with noisy VLM pseudo-labels (25-34% cross-cue agreement), single-seed experiments, small latency subsets (64 scenes), weak attribute quality (condition macro-F1 ~0.35, 'worn' never recovered), and an unexplained gap to SceneScript's published Table 2. Claims are consistently qualified and anchored to the released checkpoint, which supports above-average rigor but bounds evidence strength.

primary_link.title: BIMScript: Material-Aware Structured Scene Programs for BIM Ingestion

radar.summary: Structured-language models such as SceneScript reconstruct a scene as a short program of parametric commands, an inherently editable and semantically explicit representation. We ask three questions that stand between such models and their most compelling application, automated ingestion of existing buildings into BIM tools, studied here on synthetic scans: \emph{what} is the scene made of, \emph{how fast} can it be produced, and \emph{exactly where} is each element. BIMScript answers all three w
radar.summary_zh: 既有建築的數位化需要從掃描建立BIM模型，但「掃描到BIM」流程仍仰賴人工描繪與標註。結構化語言模型SceneScript可將場景重建為參數化程式，卻缺少材料與狀態資訊、解碼耗時，且座標被離散化到5公分網格。BIMScript在單一文法內回答三個問題：其一「是什麼」，為每個元素加入material與condition屬性，以視覺語言模型在約10萬個合成場景建立190萬個偽標籤元素的材料護照語料，並透過提升特徵點編碼器把影像外觀路由至材料token；其二「多快」，分析顯示解碼瓶頸不在算力而在核心啟動與主機同步開銷，作者提出輸出完全一致的CUDA-graph解碼器GraphStep（每步由6.40毫秒降至1.91毫秒，約3.4倍），加上利用確定性實體綱要的SchemaDraft草擬—驗證機制（1.36倍，槽位接受率51%）；其三「在哪裡」，以免訓練幾何吸附與SubBin子網格偏移回歸頭，使F1@2cm由0.034升至0.071。每個指令與Revit/IFC物件一對一對應，作者以pyRevit外掛驗證端到端匯入與IFC4匯出；加入材料屬性幾乎不犧牲幾何精度，材料準確率約0.63。限制包括監督來自合成資料與有雜訊的偽標籤、罕見類別稀薄、condition的macro-F1偏低，且Revit路徑僅於合成場景驗證。此研究使語言化場景表示成為永續建築與LLM驅動推論的可行介面。

links.title: Hype Meets Reality: Large Language Models as Mutators in Search-based Automated Program Repair of Simulink-Stateflow Models

evidence: Section IV-C1/RQ1: GPT-5.5 produced plausible patches for 4/19 models, GPT-5.4-mini 6/19, GPT-4.1-mini 5/19; valid patches for 4/19 per variant.
Section IV-C2/Tables III-IV: FlowRepair generated plausible patches for 18/19 and valid patches for 16/19 models versus 4-6/19 for all LLM variants under the same wall-clock budget.

Section IV-B: 5 repetitions per faulty model, 1-hour budget, total 95 hours per LLM variant, and manual validation of 1,724 plausible patch occurrences (232 GPT-5.5, 1,017 GPT-5.4-mini, 475 GPT-4.1-mini).
Section IV-C1: the fridge_2a repair pattern was present in the few-shot prompt, so that success is characterized by the authors as prompt-conditioned generation rather than independent inference.

Section VI Threats to Validity: no inferential or statistical-significance claims with only five repetitions; training-data contamination cannot be excluded; comparison does not isolate mutation quality from LLM inference latency.

Section III/Table I: 10 of 15 FlowRepair mutation operators substituted by a generic LLM while 5 structural operators were retained; Fig. 1 shows the simplified prompt template with full prompts deferred to the replication package.
Replication Package statement: Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21976165 provided, supporting reproducibility of prompts, benchmark, and setup.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Empirical negative-results study evaluating LLMs (GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4-mini, GPT-4.1-mini) as replacement mutators in search-based APR for Simulink/Stateflow CPS models. Directly relevant to LLM-for-code preferences (LLM 2.5x, Code 2.0x, prompting with few-shot templates), though the contribution is an evaluation in a niche domain rather than new language methodology, capping relevance. Novelty is moderate: LLM-as-mutator ideas exist in general APR (e.g., ChatRepair lineage cited in Sec. VII); the novel element is the controlled replication showing degradation, which is a useful but incremental framing. Rigor is solid for empirical SE: identical FlowRepair setup, same 1-hour wall-clock budget, 5 runs x 19 models, three LLM variants, 1,724 plausible patches manually validated (Sec. IV-B); however, only descriptive statistics, a single fixed prompt/temperature with no sensitivity analysis, and an acknowledged latency confound (Sec. VI) limit it. Evidence strength is supported by detailed per-fault tables (Tables III-IV) and concrete fault/patch analysis (Figs. 2-3), including honest caveats that the fridge_2a success reflects prompt-conditioned generation (Sec. IV-C1); but the 19-model benchmark, 5 repetitions, and contamination risk weaken inferential weight. Generalizability is explicitly narrow: findings may not extend beyond Stateflow/CPS repair or other models (Sec. VI). Reproducibility is good: Zenodo replication package with full prompts, fixed parameters, and reused public benchmark. A credible, well-executed negative result of moderate interest to LLM+code research.

primary_link.title: Hype Meets Reality: Large Language Models as Mutators in Search-based Automated Program Repair of Simulink-Stateflow Models

radar.summary: Search-based Automated Program Repair (APR) techniques rely on carefully designed mutation operators to explore the space of candidate fixes. Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) suggest that generative models could replace such operators by dynamically proposing repairs. In this paper, we investigate this hypothesis in the context of Cyber-Physical Systems (CPSs) modeled in Simulink/Stateflow. We extend the state-of-the-art FlowRepair approach by replacing a subset of its mutation op
radar.summary_zh: 搜尋式自動程式修復（APR）仰賴精心設計的突變運算子探索候選修補，而大型語言模型（LLM）的進展引發以生成式模型取代這些運算子的假設。本文在以Simulink/Stateflow建模的網宇實體系統（CPS）情境下檢驗此假設：將最先進的搜尋式修復工具FlowRepair中的部分突變運算子，替換為依狀態與轉移標籤動態生成修補的LLM突變器，並沿用原始資料集、故障定位與評估流程，在相同的1小時計算時間預算下，對四個CPS領域的19個真實故障模型進行受控比較，每個模型重複五次，並測試GPT-5.5、GPT-5.4-mini與GPT-4.1-mini。結果出乎預期地負面：FlowRepair為18/19個模型產生合理修補、16個有效修補，而LLM變體僅為4至6個模型產生合理修補、各僅4個有效修補。成功案例集中在局部語意修改，如簡化轉移防衛條件或小型算術更正，其中fridge_2a的修補樣式已出現在few-shot提示中，屬提示制約生成；反之，需要精確數值合成、插入遺漏表示式或結構修改的故障全部失敗。作者歸因於LLM難以執行精確符號編輯、缺乏模擬行為回饋，且生成搜尋空間嘈雜、快速消耗模擬預算。此負面結果警示不宜把通用程式修復的LLM成功經驗直接移植到模擬成本高、測試oracle稀少的CPS領域，並指向結合結構化突變與生成式引導的混合方向。
radar.title: Hype Meets Reality: Large Language Models as Mutators in Search-based Automated Program Repair of Simulink-Stateflow Models
radar.title_zh: 當炒作遇上現實：大型語言模型作為Simulink-Stateflow模型搜尋式自動程式修復之突變器

links.title: An Agentic RAG and Evaluation Framework for Assurance Case Generation: Industrial Use Case for the EU Cyber Resilience Act Compliance

evidence: Section IV-A: agent built with ReAct via LangChain; documents ingested via Docling, chunked at 3,000 chars with 500 overlap, indexed in ChromaDB with BGE-M3 embeddings
Section VI-A: 307 of 356 evidence nodes contain artefact references (86.2% citation coverage, ~4.4 artefacts per AC) across 70 generated ACs
Table I: BERT trained on Agentic RAG w/o Chain reaches 0.88 Acc / 0.85 F1 on D_real vs Vanilla LLM 0.70/0.69 and Real baseline 0.54/0.23
Section V-C: test set comprises only 30 Chain and 24 w/o Chain instance pairs from 3 unseen CRA requirements; training set ~4.2k/~2.7k pairs from 4 requirements
Section VI-C: BERT human mean plausibility 3.06 with 50% Q5 agreement, while LLM judge agreement is 11.1% on the same setting, indicating judge plausibility bias
Section VI-B: authors state 'This comparison does not isolate agentic iteration from conventional RAG' and that BERT-vs-LLaMA differences 'do not isolate an encoder-versus-decoder effect'
Section VI-E: 'the domain expert evaluator also co-authors this paper', a confirmation-bias threat; external validity limited by single-product focus
Code and Data Availability: NLI training code and evaluation interface public (github.com/farizikhwantri/exclaim); Agentic RAG implementation, outputs, and datasets remain proprietary
llm_evaluation.rationale: Applied but LLM-methodology-centric paper: a ReAct-style agentic RAG system (LangChain, Docling, ChromaDB/BGE-M3) generates Claim-Argument-Evidence assurance cases for EU CRA compliance, evaluated via a fine-tuned BERT NLI checker, LLaMA-1B ICL, token-level heatmaps (Integrated Gradients), and an LLM-as-judge comparison. This aligns strongly with Agents & Tool Use, RAG & Knowledge, LLMs, Interpretability, and Evaluation preferences, and it is not a pure domain application since the language-model pipeline is the contribution. Novelty is incremental: it extends the authors' prior multi-hop NLI framework [13] with standard agentic RAG components. Rigor is mixed: sensible baselines (Vanilla-LLM vs grounded synthetic data, Chain vs w/o Chain, requirement-wise split) and an explicit threats-to-validity section, but the headline 0.88 accuracy rests on only 24-30 test instances from a single product, the sole human evaluator is a co-author, and the authors admit their comparisons 'do not isolate agentic iteration from conventional RAG' or encoder-vs-decoder effects. Evidence strength is limited by tiny test sets, no significance testing, and proprietary data; generalizability is capped by the single-product, single-regulation case study (acknowledged in Section VI-E). Reproducibility is partial: NLI training code and the evaluation interface are public, but the agentic RAG implementation and all datasets are proprietary.

primary_link.title: An Agentic RAG and Evaluation Framework for Assurance Case Generation: Industrial Use Case for the EU Cyber Resilience Act Compliance

radar.summary: Complying with the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) is a resource-intensive challenge for SMEs due to the complexity of cybersecurity conformity assessment. Yet, it is essential for demonstrating regulatory compliance and ensuring product security and resilience. To address this, we introduce an automated framework for generating Assurance Cases (ACs) using an agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation grounded in a formal Claim-Argument-Evidence logic. By systematically mapping technical documentation
radar.summary_zh: 本文針對中小企業在遵守歐盟《網路韌性法案》（CRA）時面臨的合規評估負擔，提出一套自動產生保證案例的端對端框架。方法上，系統以ReAct式代理AI結合檢索增強生成（Agentic RAG），透過Docling文件擷取、BGE-M3嵌入與ChromaDB索引，對異質技術文件進行迭代式查詢與檢索，最終依Claim-Argument-Evidence（CAE）樹狀結構輸出可追溯的JSON保證案例；評估面以合成資料訓練NLI評分器（synthetic-to-real），並搭配領域專家合理性研究。在Catalink的PATROLIoT野火監測系統案例中，框架自動產出70個保證案例，每案例平均引用約4.4個文件佐證，引用覆蓋率86.2%；微調BERT之NLI評估器在獨立稽核資料上達0.88準確率與0.85 F1，專家合理性均值3.06，且明顯優於LLaMA情境學習設定。限制包括僅驗證單一產品、專家並非CRA法律權威，以及評估者身兼作者可能帶來確認偏誤。此研究顯示代理式RAG能為缺乏合規資源的企業自動化文件檢索與論證建構，同時保留透明可追溯的決策支援。

links.title: What Does Attention Transfer Transfer? Attention Structure and Robustness in Vision Transformers

evidence: Abstract: distilled student's attention 'roughly two orders of magnitude closer to the teacher's than fine-tuning does'; endpoint robustness gap closes below pre-registered threshold in two of three seeds.
Table 1 (Sec 4.1): mean per-layer/head KL(teacher||student) 0.0170 nats (cosine 0.989) for attention transfer vs 1.6545 for weight transfer and 2.1482 for scratch, n=3 seeds each.
Table 4 (Sec 4.2): endpoint gaps +0.0575/+0.0323/+0.0181 vs completed-schedule gaps +0.0044/+0.0013/+0.0110 with paired image-level bootstrap 95% CIs (B=10,000).

Table 7 (Sec 4.4): matched-skill robustness deltas flat at every ADL dose (dose means within ±1pp in both registered coordinates); 'seed-level 95% intervals span ±2.6-7.7pp against the 1pp bar,' so verdict is 'no detectable response,' not a bounded effect size.

Sec 6 Limitations: 'Everything here is ViT-S on ImageNet-100 with an MAE-S teacher; magnitudes ... are regime-bound and claimed for no other setting'; features account is 'consistent-with rather than proven.'
Appendix G (Table 11): post-hoc residual-form recomputation flips maturity correlation to -0.56 to -0.85 and endpoint gap signs for seeds 0-1, disclosed as definition-dependent.
Appendix H: ~291 GPU-hours on one A100, fully resolved version-controlled configurations ship with run artifacts; full validation trajectories published (App C).
llm_evaluation.rationale: This is a pure computer-vision paper (ViT-S attention-map distillation and OOD robustness on ImageNet-100/A/R/Sketch/V2/C) with no language methodology, placing it out of scope under the curator's explicit cap; the final score is therefore capped at 0.20 regardless of internal quality. Judged on its own merits, the study is unusually careful: pre-registered hypotheses and coordinates (Sec 3, App A), verified loss equivalence (App B), matched-accuracy and completed-schedule coordinates (Sec 4.2-4.3), a causal dose-response intervention with a honestly-scoped null (Sec 4.4), and a post-hoc residual-form sensitivity check showing definitional sign flips (App G). Novelty is solid (first direct structural measurement of attention-transfer fidelity tied to robustness, plus dissociation of the two 'overfocusing' senses), though concurrent work (Qin et al., 2026) is convergent and the design builds directly on Li et al. 2024 and Guo et al. 2023. Evidence is quantitative and replicated but the causal null is under-powered at seed level and the IN-C asymmetry is unresolved; generalizability is explicitly regime-bound to one small model, one dataset, and one architecture-matched teacher.

primary_link.title: What Does Attention Transfer Transfer? Attention Structure and Robustness in Vision Transformers

radar.summary: Vision transformers (ViTs) trained to copy a pretrained teacher's attention maps recover most of fine-tuning's in-distribution accuracy yet fall measurably short of it under distribution shift, as recent work has shown. What the copy delivers has never been measured directly in the attention structure and tied to robustness. We build that instrumentation for ViT-S students of a self-supervised teacher on ImageNet-100, and report three findings that triangulate one conclusion. First, the transfer
radar.summary_zh: 注意力圖常被視為Transformer的解釋窗口，但以蒸餾複製教師注意力圖的ViT-S學生，雖恢復微調的分布內準確率，在分布移轉下仍較不穩健。本文以預註冊實驗設計，在ImageNet-100上以MAE教師訓練scratch、權重轉移與注意力轉移三種條件，直接在注意力結構中測量「注意力轉移到底轉移了什麼」。三大發現：（1）複製近乎完美且永久：蒸餾學生每層每頭與教師的KL散度平均僅0.017 nats，比微調距教師近97倍，且不隨訓練漂移；（2）穩健性落差確實存在但具時間軸：終點有效穩健性與停止epoch相關（r=0.978），完成300 epoch完整排程後，三個種子中兩個落差低於預註冊門檻0.01，顯示落差主要是訓練成熟度所致；（3）以注意力多樣化損失（ADL）將跨列冗餘推動半個條件分離量，在兩種精確度匹配座標下均未見穩健性反應。三者合併支持落差存在於特徵而非可見的注意力結構。限制為規模僅限ViT-S、單一資料集與單一教師。此結論對注意力圖的證據性用途提出警示：注意力疊圖顯示模型看哪裡，而非它知道什麼。

links.title: Beyond Placement and Articulation: Usage-Driven Code Scenes for Embodied Interaction

evidence: Experiments > Table 1: Ours achieves Collision-free 95.9, Access. 65.6, ObjCount 57.0, ObjAttr 64.6, but Support 53.6 is below SceneSmith 58.4 and OA-Rel 40.6 below SceneCode 55.6 (mean over 28 scenes)
Experiments > Table 2: Ours reports IO 16.4, AO 13.2, CHI 6.4, MPC 3.6 while SceneCode, Code-as-Room, SceneSmith show '–' for CHI/MPC, i.e., no baseline values for the new interaction metrics
Ablation Study: usage-driven object reasoning (Figure 5) and usage-guided orientation (Figure 6) ablations are qualitative figure comparisons only; no quantitative ablation table is provided
Appendix F: 'Object code is generated with Claude Opus 4.8, whereas the overall scene agent uses GPT-5.4'; total 1,204.5M tokens, average wall-clock 9:10:38 per run
Appendix A: 28 verbatim evaluation prompts across 16 easy, 7 medium, 5 hard tiers covering 23 room types are provided
Appendix G Limitation: hanging objects 'degrade into ordinary placements' and soft cloth physics is unsupported; no code/data release claim appears anywhere in the document
llm_evaluation.rationale: Agentic LLM framework (RoomWright) that generates code-represented, interaction-enabled 3D scenes for embodied AI; it aligns moderately with Agents & Tool Use and Code & Programming preferences since LLM/VLM agents perform usage-driven reasoning, code-agent compilation of trigger-condition-effect interaction rules, and VLM-in-the-loop layout critique, though it is an applied system using off-the-shelf models (Claude Opus 4.8, GPT-5.4 per Appendix F) rather than advancing LLM methodology. Novelty is moderate: it incrementally extends code-based scene generation (SceneCode, Code-as-Room) with usage-centric composition, multi-part causal interactions, and annotation-guided orientation. Rigor is limited: evaluation uses only 28 self-curated prompts with SceneEval metrics and VLM-judged components, the two ablations (Figures 5-6) are purely qualitative with no quantitative ablation of the multi-part interaction contribution, and no human evaluation or significance testing is reported. Evidence is mixed but honestly presented: Table 1 shows Ours leads on Collision-free (95.9), Access. (65.6), ObjCount (57.0), ObjAttr (64.6) yet trails SceneSmith on Support (53.6 vs 58.4) and SceneCode on OA-Rel (40.6 vs 55.6), so the 'highest overall quality' claim is only partially supported; Table 2's interactive-content metrics are dashes for baselines, making comparison largely self-favoring by design. Generalizability is decent across 23 room types and five functional categories but tied to specific backends (Articraft, OmniGibson, FLUX.2). Reproducibility is limited: verbatim prompt suite (Appendix A) and detailed metric definitions (Appendix C) help, but no code or asset release is stated, and limitations (no cloth/hanging physics, Appendix G) are acknowledged.

primary_link.title: Beyond Placement and Articulation: Usage-Driven Code Scenes for Embodied Interaction

radar.summary: Indoor scene synthesis provides essential environments for embodied AI, robotic manipulation, and simulation-based policy learning. Recent code-based scene generation methods produce editable and extensible environments, yet they remain focused on visual construction and object-level articulation, leaving the functional usage of scenes largely unmodeled. To address this problem, we present RoomWright, an agentic usage-driven framework for generating 3D scenes represented entirely as code for emb
radar.summary_zh: 室內場景合成是具身AI與機器人操作學習的基礎，但近期以程式碼表示場景的方法仍偏重視覺建構與物件層級關節化，未建模場景的實際功能用途。本文提出RoomWright，一個以用途驅動的代理式框架，將3D場景完全以程式碼表示。方法包含三項核心：（1）用途驅動物件推理，將主要錨點視為任務中心，放射狀僅引入任務所需物件，並對每個物件窮舉其可操作的互動邊；（2）程式碼化多部件互動，代理將每條互動編譯為觸發—條件—效果規則，更新結構化物件狀態，捕捉跨物件的因果依賴，例如按開關點亮燈具；（3）標註輔助的用途引導朝向，利用建模期的語義標註搭配VLM推斷操作物的使用朝向。實驗在28個房間提示上以SceneEval指標與SceneCode、Code-as-Room、SceneSmith比較，本方法在多數物理合理性與提示符合度指標領先，互動物件數（IO 16.4）明顯高於基線，場景可直接載入Isaac Sim執行機器人操作。限制是掛鉤類物件與軟布料物理尚未支援。此工作使產出場景可執行、可編輯且模擬就緒，對具身AI與政策學習具實用價值。

links.title: GreekBarRetrieval: A Benchmark for Greek Statutory Retrieval

evidence: Abstract: benchmark of '283 bar-exam questions' with '6,308 candidate statutory articles'; vanilla dense 'far outperforms' vanilla BM25 (0.77 vs 0.36 Recall@100), and a ReAct-like reformulation loop gives BM25 the best nDCG and MAP.
Section 2.2: 310 source questions filtered to 283 after citation conversion; pool built from 23 legal sources; Table 2 gives length statistics (queries mean 290.33 words vs articles 108.04).
Table 3 / Section 4.3: ReAct-BM25 reaches 0.67 Recall@100, 0.43 nDCG@10, 0.37 MAP@100, but does not beat Reform-Qwen3-8B on Recall@100 (0.73) and Gemini-001 retains 0.77.

Appendix C.5 / Table 13: two-sided paired randomization tests, 100K permutations, Holm correction over 20 tests; reformulation gains significant (p<.001) while ReAct-BM25 vs Reform-Qwen3-8B Recall@100 is not (p=.084).
Table 5 / Section 4.5: cost analysis — 10-round ReAct-BM25 uses 20 LLM calls, 617.9k tokens, ~1598s per query, with the observer accounting for 84% of tokens.

Limitations: gold statutes from official solutions 'not exhaustive'; all LLM-dependent results from 'a single generation path per query'; BM25 parameter sweep optimized on the full benchmark as an oracle upper bound; no re-rankers included; no end-to-end QA evaluation.
Introduction: 'All the code and data of our experiments will be made publicly available in the camera-ready' — availability is promised, not yet delivered.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A competently executed legal-IR benchmark paper for Greek statutory retrieval with genuine but only moderate overlap to the stated preferences: it directly engages RAG/retrieval grounding (weight 1.8) and contributes a ReAct-style agentic retrieval loop (Agents & Tool Use, weight 2.5), using gpt-oss-120b for query reformulation, but it is a niche Greek-legal resource rather than core LLM, reasoning, or alignment research; it is not a 'pure domain application' since retrieval methodology is central, so the 0.20 cap does not apply. Novelty is modest: the benchmark fills a real gap (first Greek statutory retrieval benchmark) but is derived mechanically from GreekBarBench, and ReAct-BM25 adapts known iterative-retrieval ideas (ReAct, IRCoT, Rewrite-Retrieve-Read). Rigor is the paper's strength: 3 BM25 variants, 9 dense retrievers, PRF/RRF/translation/tuning ablations, paired randomization tests with Holm correction (App. C.5), and an honest cost analysis (Table 5: 20 calls, 617.9k tokens/query for 10-round ReAct-BM25). Evidence is solid though the authors concede the reformulation-mechanism explanation rests on indirect evidence (Limitations), ground truth from official solutions is non-exhaustive, and all LLM runs are single-path with no variance. Generalizability is limited by the Greek legal domain and absence of re-rankers or end-to-end QA evaluation. Reproducibility is decent (full prompts in App. G, implementation tables) but code/data are only promised 'in the camera-ready', not yet released.

primary_link.title: GreekBarRetrieval: A Benchmark for Greek Statutory Retrieval

radar.summary: Statutory retrieval is necessary for citation-grounded legal question answering, but remains underexplored for Greek. The new benchmark comprises 283 bar-exam questions, each accompanied by the facts of the case it refers to, and 6,308 candidate statutory articles to retrieve from. Questions and facts are stated in everyday language, but need to be mapped t
radar.summary_zh: 以引用法條為基礎的法律問答需要精確的法規檢索，但希臘語長期缺乏此類基準。本文從希臘律師考試基準GreekBarBench衍生出GreekBarRetrieval，包含283道考試題目（附案件事實）與6,308篇候選法條；題目與事實以日常語言撰寫，需對映至法條的專業術語與抽象法律概念，且部分事實與問題無關，構成三重挑戰。實驗比較三種BM25前處理變體與九個稠密檢索器：原始稠密檢索大幅領先稀疏檢索，Gemini-001達0.77 Recall@100，BM25僅0.36。然而LLM查詢改寫大幅縮小差距：改寫後BM25升至0.60，稠密檢索亦受益。作者進一步提出十輪ReAct式規劃—觀察回圈的ReAct-BM25，使BM25達0.67 Recall@100，並取得所有方法中最高的nDCG與MAP，但每查詢約需617.9k LLM tokens，成本遠高於改寫式稠密檢索。查詢改寫的效果也優於參數調校、偽相關回饋、RRF融合與英譯。限制包括標準答案非窮盡、單一生成路徑無法報告變異、未含重排序器，且僅針對法條層級檢索。此基準為希臘法律RAG提供首個公開檢索測試場，並顯示查詢改寫能為稀疏檢索帶來部分稠密檢索的語義比對效益。
radar.title: GreekBarRetrieval: A Benchmark for Greek Statutory Retrieval

links.title: Coverage-Driven RTL Assertion Generation with Formal Exploration and Neuro-Symbolic Refinement

evidence: Abstract: 'around 2x more assertions and about 2x higher mutation coverage than traditional assertion mining methods'
Section 4.1: 'we use GPT-5 as the underlying large language model' for assertion proposal and grammar generation; cvc5, SymbiYosys, and Pono form the toolchain
Section 4.3: coverage gains 'I2C (10.51% to 36.21%), Ibex_decoder (6.45% to 32.31%), and Pico (14.63% to 37.80%)' vs SMART; Pico assertions only 477 vs 358 (~1.3x)
Section 4.4: ablation on I2C full 244 assertions/36.20% coverage vs w.o.fd 181/16.96% vs w.o.fd&fe 89/10.40%; same trend on Pico
Section 4.5: GPT-5 w. planning baseline improves to e.g. Ibex_controller 10.75%->54.84% and Multdiv 0.00%->10.00% coverage
Section 3.1.1/Figure 1: branch coverage 'plateaus at about 27%' (text says ~28%) on b12 despite 40x more random tests, motivating formal exploration
Sections 4.1-4.2: benchmarks are public (ITC'99 B12, OpenCores I2C, Ibex, PicoRV32) but no code, prompts, or artifact release is stated anywhere in the paper
llm_evaluation.rationale: Hardware verification (MLCAD) domain paper, but language methodology is genuine: GPT-5-driven neural proposal, LLM-generated repair grammars, agent-inspired refinement loop with formal-checker tool feedback and structured JSON outputs, giving moderate fit to LLM/agents/code preferences rather than a pure non-language domain application. Combination of reachability-guided formal trace generation + SyGuS mining + mutation-coverage-driven LLM proposal with grammar-constrained symbolic repair is a sensible, moderately novel integration over SMART (Ye et al. 2025) and prior LLM assertion generators. Rigor is adequate: 7 public benchmarks, SMART and a GPT-5 planning baseline, and ablations isolating formal exploration and feedback; however results are figure-only with no variance, no runtime/cost analysis, mutation sampling details and obligation-derivation are underspecified, and ablation covers only two benchmarks. Evidence is consistent with the ~2x claims on coverage (e.g., I2C 10.51%->36.21%) though the Pico assertion gain is only 1.3x. No code/prompt artifact release, single LLM (GPT-5) unexamined, limiting reproducibility; generalizability beyond RTL/SVA specification mining is plausible but untested.

primary_link.title: Coverage-Driven RTL Assertion Generation with Formal Exploration and Neuro-Symbolic Refinement

radar.summary: Hardware functional verification relies on high-quality assertions to expose design bugs and establish confidence in Register Transfer Level (RTL) designs. Yet existing assertion mining methods still struggle to produce complete and reliable assertion sets: random or limited traces fail to cover hard-to-reach behaviors, and one-shot generation provides little feedback about what remains unverified or how the assertion set should be improved. As a result, critical design behaviors can remain unco
radar.summary_zh: 硬體功能驗證依賴高品質的SystemVerilog斷言，但既有斷言開採方法受限於軌跡多樣性不足，且多為一次性產生，缺乏關於覆蓋缺口的回饋。本文提出NeuroAssertion，一個覆蓋率驅動的斷言產生框架：首先以RTL插樁將難以觸發的控制流條件轉為可達性目標，用模型檢查產生行為多樣的軌跡，再以語法引導合成（SyGuS）搭配CEGAR迴圈開採初始斷言集；接著以突變覆蓋率辨識未覆蓋義務，第一個LLM針對缺口提出候選斷言，若未通過形式驗證，第二個LLM產生修復文法，引導受限符號合成完成神經符號修復。在七個RTL基準（含I2C、Ibex、Pico等）上，本方法相較SMART產生約2倍斷言數量與約2倍突變覆蓋率，例如I2C覆蓋率自10.51%升至36.21%；與直接以GPT-5規劃產生斷言的基線相比差距更大。消融實驗確認形式探索與回饋精煉兩個元件皆屬必要。限制包括基準設計規模有限，且結果依賴特定LLM骨幹。此工作將突變分析從事後評估指標轉化為顯式的精煉訊號，提升斷言集的完整性與偵錯能力。
