links.title: MR-IQA-2: Faithful Image Quality Reflection via Fine-Grained Credit Assignment

evidence: Abstract: proposes decoupled credit assignment for reasoning vs rating and verifiable supervision via an actor-editor-judge framework with a frozen judge comparing original and edited images.
Section 3.3-3.4: reasoning reward R=Δs from Judge-score change; masked token-specific advantages route reasoning/rating/format rewards to their output fields; optimized with GRPO (Eq. 10-13).

Table 1 (Rating performance comparison): MR-IQA-2* average PLCC/SRCC 0.840/0.816, comparable to Zoom-IQA 0.840/0.819 and DeQA 0.838/0.813, described as 'competitive rating performance' rather than SOTA.

Table 2 (Reasoning performance validation): MR-IQA-2 mean quality gain +0.789 (FLUX.2 editor, pretrained judge) vs Q-Insight +0.213 and Qwen3.5-4B baseline -0.137; GPT-5.6 Sol 3AFC preference 81.40% vs 14.41% for Q-Insight.

Section 4.4 / Table 3: rating-only training reaches 0.836/0.815 avg PLCC/SRCC but mean quality gain -0.260; credit-mask E5 gains +1.079 with 23,457 unique solutions vs unmasked +1.442 with single-solution collapse.

Appendix E.9 (Causal Scope): 'Because credit and KL routing change jointly with one seed per setting, this audit is descriptive rather than causal'; Appendix A notes Zoom-IQA could not be reproduced under their protocol.

Section 6 (Limitations): no closed-loop reflection (edited image not fed back to Actor) and computational/parameter redundancy across Actor, Editor, Judge; Appendix C flags editor-proxy attribution risks and semantic-preservation failures.

Section 4.1 / Appendix A: full training details (8x48GB A6000, 5 epochs, N=6 images, K=6 completions, 192-token limit, AdamW settings), per-image editor/judge inference times, and code link in the abstract.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A multimodal-LLM paper on faithful reasoning in blind IQA, trained with GRPO/DAPO and masked token-level credit assignment separating reasoning, rating, and format rewards; the core methodology is language-model reward/credit design (aligning with reasoning, alignment/RL, multimodal preferences) rather than pure CV, so the 0.20 domain cap does not apply, though the IQA-only evaluation tempers relevance. Novelty is solid: using reasoning-conditioned image editing plus a frozen judge as a verifiable reward for reasoning faithfulness is a fresh intervention-based signal, while the masked-GRPO routing is a useful but incremental contribution. Rigor is above average: six benchmarks, cross-editor/judge robustness checks (Table 2), ablations over credit mask, KL scope, backbone, group size, and optimizer (Tables 3-5), plus an unusually honest collapse audit admitting the unmasked variant's higher raw gain reflects single-solution collapse (Appendix D-E). Evidence is moderate: rating results are competitive, not SOTA (0.840/0.816 avg vs Zoom-IQA 0.840/0.819, DeQA 0.838/0.813), and faithfulness is measured by a judge the actor was trained against, with no human faithfulness study (Appendix C discloses this attribution risk); Appendix E.9 admits the key comparison is 'descriptive rather than causal' with one seed. Generalizability is limited to IQA and depends on an editor+judge stack, though the modular actor-editor-judge design is stated to be replaceable. Reproducibility is decent: code link, full hyperparameters, hardware, timing (Section 4.1, Appendix A), and disclosed subsampling.

primary_link.title: MR-IQA-2: Faithful Image Quality Reflection via Fine-Grained Credit Assignment

radar.summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential for image quality assessment (IQA) by improving consistency between quality ratings and their underlying reasoning. However, most approaches supervise reasoning through human-provided ratings and rarely examine whether it faithfully reflects image quality. Rating accuracy alone does not ensure faithful reasoning; a shared reward also obscures supervision sources and may reinforce unfaithful reasoning when a correct rating occur
radar.summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型使盲測影像品質評估（BIQA）更具解釋性，但既有方法多以評分對齊人類標籤來監督推理，若評分偶然正確，可能強化不忠實的推理。本文提出MR-IQA-2，一個actor-editor-judge框架，將「推理—編輯—反思」操作化：actor對輸入影像產生品質推理與評分；凍結的editor依推理對影像進行低層修正；凍結的judge比較原圖與編輯後影像的品質變化，產生可驗證的反思監督訊號。訓練上採用細粒度信用分配，以遮罩式token級更新在GRPO中分離推理與評分的獎勵：judge回饋監督推理欄位，人類評分監督評分欄位。在KonIQ-10k訓練並於六個基準評估，MR-IQA-2維持具競爭力的評分對齊（六資料集平均PLCC/SRCC 0.838/0.812），同時推理引導編輯帶來正向品質增益（+1.079）。消融顯示去除信用遮罩雖原始增益更高（+1.442），卻坍縮為單一解法模板，證實遮罩有助避免解法坍縮。限制包括反思迴圈尚未閉合（編輯結果未回饋actor），以及三模組帶來的運算與參數冗餘。此框架為評估推理忠實性提供以視覺介入為本的途徑，連結盲測評估與參照式驗證。
radar.title: MR-IQA-2: Faithful Image Quality Reflection via Fine-Grained Credit Assignment

links.title: GEAR: Generative Expansion and Real Anchoring for Two-Stage Distillation of Tabular Foundation Models

evidence: Abstract: two-stage MLPs beat supervised MLPs by 1.81-2.00 AUC points (binary) and 1.19-1.35 (multiclass), and real-only distillation by 1.76-2.19 / 2.09-2.40 points

Sec 4.2 Q3/Fig 4: with TabPFN teacher, GEAR beats real-only mixed distillation by 2.61 AUC points on binary (92.6% paired wins) and 2.38 on multiclass (94.2%), exceeding supervised-MLP warm start by 1.46 points
Sec 3 Theorem 1 + Corollary 1: certificate decomposes into M^(-1/2) finite-query term plus B*TV(P_X,Q_X) generator-fidelity floor, matching observed diminishing returns in Sec 4.2
Sec 4.2 Table 2: tree students improve on binary (+0.98 to +1.53) but LightGBM multiclass is negative for all three teachers (e.g., -6.02 for TabPFN), honestly reported as student-dependent

Sec 4.1 Implementation: residual MLP width 512, 4 blocks, dropout 0.2, lambda=0.7, K in {1,...,40}; timing uses A800 GPU for teacher vs CPU for student; no code-availability claim anywhere in the document
Sec 4.3 Fig 5: two-stage beats mixed training with non-degradation rates 4.2-48.7 percentage points higher across all K comparisons
llm_evaluation.rationale: Tabular foundation-model distillation, not an LLM/language paper, but methodologically adjacent via in-context learning, transformer teachers, knowledge distillation, and synthetic data, so it clears the out-of-scope cap though relevance to the LLM-centric preferences is partial. Novelty is moderate: two-stage separation of generated teacher-query expansion from OOF real-data anchoring is a sensible recombination of known ideas (KD, cross-fitting, transfer learning) over existing TFM distillation baselines, with a new but standard M^-1/2 + TV-floor risk certificate. Rigor is strong: formal objectives, five-run averages, Wilcoxon paired tests with p-values, standard errors, and ablations against five warm-start/schedule alternatives and mixed optimization. Evidence is solid but includes modest and mixed effects (LightGBM multiclass all-negative in Table 2; Copula/CTGAN multiclass means negative), and headline latency gains (57-2866x) compare GPU teacher vs CPU student. Generalizability is demonstrated across 2 benchmarks, 3 teachers, 4 generators, and 3 student families, though classification-only and student-dependent. Reproducibility is decent (hyperparameters, versions, supplementary details) but no code release is stated.

primary_link.title: GEAR: Generative Expansion and Real Anchoring for Two-Stage Distillation of Tabular Foundation Models

radar.summary: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) achieve strong performance through in-context learning, but context-dependent inference imposes substantial latency and memory costs, hindering large-scale deployment. We propose GEAR (\emph{Generative Expansion and Real Anchoring}), a modular two-stage framework that distills TFMs into lightweight MLP or tree-based predictors that can be deployed on commodity CPUs. Stage 1 uses synthetic covariates solely as teacher-query locations and trains the student on soft
radar.summary_zh: 表格基礎模型（TFM）如TabPFN、TabICL透過情境學習獲得強大效能，但推論時需以標註表格為情境執行大型模型，延遲與記憶體成本高，阻礙大規模部署。本文提出GEAR，一個模組化兩階段蒸餾框架，將TFM壓縮為可部署於一般CPU的MLP或樹模型。第一階段以合成協變數僅作為教師查詢位置，學生以教師軟標籤模仿，擴大查詢覆蓋範圍；第二階段以真實資料與折外（OOF）教師預測重新錨定，避免自標籤洩漏，並以混合損失結合真實標籤與軟目標。理論上，作者推導風險證書，刻畫生成查詢量與生成器保真度間的權衡，解釋合成擴充的報酬遞減。在TALENT與TabArena上，兩階段MLP在二元任務較監督式MLP提升1.81–2.00 AUC、多類別1.19–1.35點，且優於僅用真實資料的蒸餾；增益亦轉移至LightGBM與XGBoost，三種學生家族平均AUC皆勝過最強非TFM基線CatBoost。相較直接TFM推論，GEAR將中位推論時間縮短57–2866倍、峰值記憶體降低1.9–3.3倍。消融顯示增益非來自更長訓練或暖啟動，分階段最佳化亦較混合訓練穩定。限制為僅針對分類與單一教師。此工作為TFM的高效落地提供實用路徑。
radar.title: GEAR: Generative Expansion and Real Anchoring for Two-Stage Distillation of Tabular Foundation Models

links.title: Assessing Quality of Experience in Natural Language Generation of German Text

evidence: Abstract and Section 1: introduces TextQ-German dataset suite for human-centered QoE evaluation of German ATS and MT with automatic prediction models

Section 3.1.2: crowdsourcing with Semantic Differential scaling; EFA (Maximum Likelihood, PROMAX) yields four factors per task with chi-squared goodness-of-fit (MT p=0.36, ATS p=0.63); dimensions: Precision/Complexity/Grammaticality/Transparency (MT) and Linguistic Logic/Complexity/Clarity/Predictability (ATS)

llm_evaluation.rationale: A solid German-NLP evaluation resource paper introducing TextQ-German, a crowdsourced QoE dataset for summarization and MT output quality, with transformer/feature/hybrid prediction models. Preference relevance is moderate: it is squarely an NLP/human-evaluation/dataset contribution (Red Teaming & Evaluation, NLP, Data & Datasets), and LLMs appear as text generators (GPT-4o, GPT-3.5 Turbo, Llama 3.2, StableLM 2, DeepSeek-R1) with LLM-generated data extensions, but the paper does not advance core high-weight LLM methodology (reasoning, agents, alignment, safety) and is German- rather than Japanese-focused. Novelty is moderate: porting the telecom QoE framework with empirically derived perceptual dimensions to German NLG is fresh, though hybrid linguistic-feature+embedding models echo prior GermEval 2022 text-complexity work. Rigor is above average: careful crowdsourcing with cleaning/attention checks, EFA with reported chi-squared fit (Section 3.1.2), statistical validation of reduced scales (Section 3.1.3), leakage-safe 7-fold CV with per-fold feature selection (Section 4.2), and source-disjoint held-out validation (Section 4.6); however, no significance testing for model comparisons, no comparison to learned metrics (BERTScore/COMET) despite citing them, and small corpora (77-106 items per subset) weaken conclusions. Evidence strength is mixed: consistent quantitative tables support the hybrid-over-transformer claim in most settings, but final validation shows fine-grained MT dimension prediction fails (R^2=-0.3177, Table 22), honestly reported. Generalizability is limited by language/task specificity and small data. Reproducibility is strong with public code/datasets on GitHub/HuggingFace/Kaggle, full prompts (Appendix B) and complete feature lists (Appendix C).

Sec. IV: the Transformer comparison reuses prior Pythia-410M exponents (-0.121, -0.128, -0.10, -0.10 at L=8,16,24,28) from the author's own preprint [1] rather than new matched-condition runs.

llm_evaluation.rationale: A physics-style spectral analysis of trained language-model internals: the author measures the full-block Jacobian time-scale density of states (TDOS) of public Mamba-370M and compares it to prior Pythia-410M measurements, reporting a near-marginal infrared exponent beta_M ~ -0.17 vs beta_Tr ~ -0.1 and the implied K(t) ~ t^-(1+beta) memory kernel. Preference relevance is moderate: it genuinely targets LM architectures (Transformer, Mamba SSM) and is interpretability-adjacent (probing learned dynamics), but offers no language methodology, capability, or benchmark contribution. Novelty is moderate: the three-level decomposition (intrinsic SSM / selective effective / collective block spectra) and the cross-architecture empirical claim are new, but the TDOS framework, the Pythia baseline, and 'Cognitive Field Theory' all come from the author's own self-cited preprints, and the causal block-triangular spectral reduction is standard linear algebra. Rigor is mixed: the fixed cumulative fitting window (10^-4 to 5x10^-2), sequence-length (8-512) and depth scans, R^2 ~ 0.99, and FP64-vs-FP32 validation are careful, and the paper honestly declines a universal-exponent claim despite its title; however there are no error bars on beta, no input-dependence controls for the Mamba spectra, and the Transformer comparison uses unmatched, shorter sequence lengths (L=8-28) from a prior non-peer-reviewed source. Evidence is internally consistent (Table 2 quantitative trends, N_fit growing 58x with stable exponent) but rests on one model scale and one quantitative layer. Generalizability is limited and self-acknowledged. Reproducibility is partial: public checkpoints and detailed math, but no code release and no specification of the input text used. The 'Universality' framing in the title oversells what the text itself carefully limits to a shared near-marginal regime.

evidence: Abstract (Page 1): full specification increases clean-loading output from 72.0% to 97.3% while aggregate three-implementer agreement changes only 83.1% to 83.8%; structured row-level comparison yields 19/42 correct probes in both conditions.

Section VI & Table II (Pages 5-6): benchmark holds implementer panel fixed with mandatory no-specification control; executability 72.0%/87.5%/97.3% across none/partial/full closure arms; k=3 determinacy 83.1→83.8%, k=2 83.2→79.7%.

Section IX-A & Table IV (Page 7): byte-identical rule scores 19% control / 23% trailing paragraph / 42% matrix row / 34% both places; effect carried by one implementer (38→78→47→64%) while the other floors at 3-6%.

Section X & Tables VI-VII (Page 8): median arm-delta spread 14.4 pp (max 32.7 pp) on a 25-unit repeated subsample; returns (+18.7 pp) and rule-pin effects retired, only routine_kind (+17.4 pp vs 12.3 pp spread) and executability survive.

Section XII (Page 9): single fictional 18-document estate, one migration direction, model-era dependence, three repeats only, and total inference cost ≈ $74 with several arms sized by budget rather than power.

Sections VI-D and VII (Pages 5-6): internal 1,802-pair corpus execution-filtered to 981, 75-unit pinned sample, separate 20-unit public PL/SQL behavioral corpus; pilot uses Claude Opus 4.8, GPT-5.5, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, and ora2pg with a naive-port control failing with 78 errors and 0 tables.

Sections IV-V (Pages 4-5): W1-W4 conditions machine-checked (Kahn's algorithm over 18 nodes/19 edges), dependency closures reduce mean task context ~71% (mean closure 4.72 documents = 29.1% of 61,709 tokens), layers recovered at 99.9th percentile from non-authored citation edges; but no explicit public code/artifact release is stated.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-for-software-engineering measurement paper: LLM implementers (GPT-5.5, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, Claude Opus 4.8, plus ora2pg baseline) consume a formal specification under execution-judged evaluation, so it matches Agents & Tool Use, Code & Programming, and LLM evaluation preferences, though it contributes no LLM methodology itself — the LLMs are the measurement instrument and the core object is specification determinacy. Novelty is solid: a formal semantic-block model with machine-checkable well-formedness conditions and a benchmark that isolates the specification (not the model) as treatment via a fixed panel and mandatory no-specification control is a genuine twist on SWE-bench/Spider-style execution evaluation. Rigor is unusually strong and self-critical: pre-registered manipulations (Sections IX-A, IX-F), a coverage denominator exposing the agreement null (IX-B), measured run-to-run variability that retires several of the authors' own effects (Section X, Table VII), and a frank threats-to-validity section (XII). Evidence is mixed: the executability gain (72.0%→97.3%, Table II) is monotone and reproducible, but the central agreement null rests on 75 units, k=2–3 implementers, a 42-probe structured comparison (19/42 in both arms), a 20-unit behavioral corpus, and a 25-unit repeated subsample; the placement effect is carried by one implementer and a single fictional estate. Generalizability is explicitly limited by the authors (one migration direction, fictional estate, model-era dependence). Reproducibility is partial: deterministic PostgreSQL 16/live-Oracle judges, model.-driven context, and reproducible verdicts are described, but no public artifact/code release is stated and much of the corpus is internal and anonymized. Net: a credible, honestly-reported niche benchmark/negative-result paper with moderate LLM relevance.

radar.summary_zh: 規格驅動開發（SDD）日益將規格視為 LLM 開發代理的主要操作產物，但傳統的完整性、一致性與無歧義性指標無法回答關鍵問題：規格實際上決定了什麼？本文提出形式化語意區塊模型 S=(B,≺,ρ,Δ,Q)，以四項機器可檢驗條件（無環性、單一擁有權、約束支配、完備性或歧義停止）定義良構規格，並以模型論的「確定性」概念描述所有符合實作會得到一致解的決策。作者以 Oracle 19c 至 PostgreSQL 16 遷移規格（18 個區塊、19 條依賴邊）實例化，依賴閉包使平均每任務上下文縮減約 71%，並以覆蓋率普查、替代分區比較與非自建邊集重建等計算檢驗支持分層結構。基準測試固定實作面板並強制設置無規格對照組，以 PostgreSQL 16 容器與實際 Oracle 執行差異作為確定性評判。結果顯示：完整規格將乾淨載入率由 72.0% 提升至 97.3%，但跨實作一致度僅由 83.1% 微升至 83.8%；在 75 個執行驗證單元上，沒有任何被規格固定的決策呈現可測量的一致性增益，結構化資料比對兩組皆為 19/42 正確。規則擺放位置的效應（尾段 23% 對矩陣列 42%）大於重複陳述，重複反而降至 34%；重複執行的臂間差異中位數達 14.4 個百分點。結論支持確定性為有效的形式概念，但對受測的現代 LLM 實作者不宜作為獨立實證品質指標；限制包括單一虛構規格案例、特定模型版本與統計檢定力不足。

evidence: Section 2.3 defines four baselines (Joint, Incremental Joint, Ensemble, Naive) with a checklist (Figure 2c) explicitly decomposing forgetting, co-observation, and plasticity.
Appendix C.1 (Figure 6) empirically verifies the ensemble's zero forgetting: chunk train-set accuracy never declines after a chunk is trained.
Appendix C.2 (Figure 7) ablates forward/backward transfer by building the ensemble from LwF/CaSSLe checkpoints, which 'at best barely surpasses the standard baseline' and fails to close the gap.
Appendix F Table 1 (SL-CIFAR100): chunk 4 LP-accuracy Ensemble 70.39±0.04 vs Incremental Joint 74.29±0.31 vs Joint 75.18±0.55, quantifying the co-observation gap.
Section 4.2/Appendix F Tables 2-4: 30% replay (81.27 on IN-100 SL) exceeds the ensemble (80.55) while LwF (79.93) only matches the ensemble, supporting the replay-vs-distillation contextualization.
Appendix E (Figure 8) shows the gap persists for 8- and 12-chunk splits on ImageNet-100.
Section 6.2 discusses LLM continual pre-training (Ibrahim et al. 2024; Ye et al. 2024) and proposes the diagnostic as a starting point, but contains no LLM experiments.
Section 8 (Limitations) concedes PCA capacity control is imperfect, schedules are uniform rather than performance-maximizing, and billion-parameter scale is untested.

Contribution list (Section 1) states code availability at https://github.com/TimmHess/Co-ob; Appendices A-D give hyperparameters, optimizer settings, seeds (3-6 runs with standard error), and build on Avalanche, CaSSLe, and I-JEPA codebases.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A careful continual-learning analysis arguing 'data co-observation' is a third limiting factor beyond catastrophic forgetting and plasticity loss. Topic alignment is modest: the empirical work is entirely on vision benchmarks (CIFAR-100, ImageNet-100, ResNet-18, Barlow Twins, I-JEPA); its only LLM connection is speculative discussion of continual pre-training in Section 6.2, with no language experiments. It does match the 'continual learning'/'training' keywords under Training & Optimization, and it is not a pure CV method paper (the contribution is learning-dynamics methodology), so the out-of-scope cap is not applied. Strengths: a well-designed diagnostic (four baselines in Section 2.3) that separates forgetting (via a perfect-retention ensemble) and plasticity (via incremental joint) from co-observation; PCA capacity control (Section 2.4); empirical zero-forgetting verification (Appendix C.1, Figure 6); transfer ablation with distillation checkpoints (Appendix C.2); consistent quantitative gaps (e.g., Appendix F Table 1: Ensemble 70.39 vs Incremental Joint 74.29 on CIFAR-100 chunk 4; Table 4 I-JEPA: 59.82 vs 62.64); extended 8/12-chunk runs (Appendix E); code release and detailed hyperparameters (Appendix A-D). Weaknesses: novelty is incremental over Lee & Storkey (2023), Ni et al. (2023), and Busch et al. (2025), which already observed related symptoms; the ensemble+PCA baseline is an imperfect proxy for an ideal retention model (acknowledged in Section 8); evidence is vision-only at moderate scale, so generalizability to LLM-scale continual pre-training remains a hypothesis rather than a result.

radar.summary_zh: 持續學習文獻長期以災難性遺忘與可塑性喪失解釋序列訓練與離線聯合訓練的效能落差，隱含假設是完美管理穩定性與可塑性即可追上聯合訓練。本文主張存在第三個因素：資料共同觀察（co-observation）。概念論證指出，在單一資料分割上最佳化時，模型傾向採用局部捷徑特徵，跨分布共享的特徵因而無法被辨識；即使參數被完美保留，模型也難以合成跨分布的依賴關係。方法上採診斷性設計：以持續預訓練搭配線性探針評估，並引入儲存每階段凍結特徵抽取器的集成作為零遺忘基準，經 PCA 控制維度後與增量聯合訓練比較，其殘餘落差即歸因於共同觀察的缺失。實驗在無巨觀分布偏移的資料增量「chunking」情境進行，涵蓋 MNIST 概念驗證，以及 CIFAR-100 與 ImageNet-100 上的監督式（ResNet-18）與自監督式（Barlow Twins、I-JEPA）訓練，並延伸至 8 與 12 個分塊，結果一致顯示集成雖完整保留歷史表徵，仍持續低於增量聯合訓練。透過此框架重新詮釋持續學習機制：記憶重播的成功不僅在於防止遺忘，更在於重新引入共同觀察（30% 緩衝約可縮小一半落差），而知識蒸餾（LwF、CaSSLe）僅能補償遺忘。此發現對持續預訓練大型語言模型具直接啟示。限制包括 PCA 事後降維、統一訓練預算，以及僅於中等規模視覺任務驗證。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A consultancy-style case study using Claude Code as a 'driver' in a human-in-the-loop performance-engineering loop for a Python GPHH scheduling simulator. Topic aligns well with high-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use 2.5, Code & Programming 2.0; Claude/agentic coding agent is central to the framing), but the LLM contribution is operational, not methodological: no metrics on agent proposals/acceptance rate, no comparison against human-only or fully autonomous optimization, and no study of when the agent helps or fails. The four optimizations (interpreter -O flag, static dict caching over NetworkX, incremental resource-feasibility tracking, Numba JIT) are standard performance engineering. Rigor is limited to a single codebase and single benchmark with checksums and no variance/hardware reporting; notably, the per-layer savings (511+273+330+184 = 1,298 s in Fig. 6/Sec. V) arithmetically contradict the stated final runtime of 195 s. Evidence is concrete (runtimes, compute units, cost) but internally inconsistent and unverifiable without logs. Generalizability is asserted, not demonstrated. Code repo availability partially supports reproducibility, though agent prompts, interaction traces, and benchmark instance details are absent.

radar.summary: Python is widely used in scientific research because it enables rapid development and provides rich ecosystems for data analysis, artificial intelligence (AI), and machine learning. However, customized research code can become prohibitively slow as experiments scale. This challenge is particularly acute in discrete-event project-scheduling simulations, where sequential state updates, nested loops, conditional evaluations, and object-oriented structures limit the benefits of compiled numerical an
radar.summary_zh: Python 廣泛用於科學研究，但客製化程式碼在實驗規模擴大時常成為效能瓶頸；離散事件專案排程模擬因涉及序列狀態更新、巢狀迴圈與物件導向結構，尤其難以受益於向量化或 GPU 加速。本文以真實個案展示如何運用 Claude 代理式 AI 進行系統性效能工程：研究團隊的遺傳規劃超啟發式（GPHH）框架用於動態多模式資源受限專案排程（DMRCPSP），模擬內迴圈在演化過程中被數百萬次重複執行，導致紐西蘭 REANNZ 高效能運算叢集年用量約 517 萬運算單位，超出配額近五倍。工作流程採半自動化的人機結對模式：AI 代理擔任「駕駛」，執行基準測試與效能剖析、找出熱點並提出範圍限定的修改；研究者擔任「領航」，獨立驗證 checksum 與執行時間，保留最終提交權。四層最佳化依序為：以 -O 旗標移除除錯與日誌負擔（節省 511 秒）、以預建字典取代 NetworkX 動態圖檢視存取（節省 273 秒）、將資源可行性檢查改為增量狀態追蹤（節省 330 秒）、以 Numba JIT 編譯 earliestStart 數值核心（節省 184 秒）。總執行時間由 1,298 秒降至 195 秒，減少 85%，且排程輸出完全不變，每年節省逾 400 萬核心小時（約紐幣 32 萬元）。此證據驅動的工作流程讓缺乏軟體工程專業的研究者也能安全地進行效能最佳化；限制在於屬單一領域案例，未來可推廣至其他模擬密集的研究軟體。
radar.title: Accelerated Genetic Programming Hyper-Heuristics for Simulation-Based Scheduling via Agentic AI

links.title: SPADE: Self-Play in Adaptive Synthetic Executable Environments

evidence: Abstract: SPADE improves over the strongest fixed-environment baseline by +5.3 on average across eight held-out math, science, code, and reasoning benchmarks; +5.7 on BFCL v4 multi-turn and +13.9 on ACEBench-Agent at 30B-A3B
Table 1: Qwen3-30B-A3B suite average 58.3 (+8.1 over base 50.2) vs Fixed-env RLVE 53.0 and Fixed-env GRPO 51.4, both retrained per backbone for 400 iterations from the same base model

Table 3 / Section 7.1: removing corpus grounding or memory alone drops suite average to 53.5/53.2; removing both ED training and memory falls to 40.5, 9.7 points below base; static GPT-5.5 pool reaches 53.0
Section 7.2 / Table 6: hint-based regret reaches 58.3 average vs 55.9 for EMA-based learning potential, isolating the designer-reward choice

Appendix F.3.1: reference systems in Table 2 were trained/evaluated on their own harnesses with differing BFCL versions, tau2-bench forks, user simulators, and aggregation rules, so cross-row comparison is not apples-to-apples

Appendix E: Theorem E.5 proves every pure Nash equilibrium yields hint-free optimality, but under idealized assumptions E.2 (articulated hints) and E.3 (internalizability) that do not hold in practice
Appendix I.1.2 / Table 8: Vendi/n 0.68 with corpus vs 0.04 without, replicated under TF-IDF/LSA embeddings (0.53/0.58/0.48/0.05)

Section 9 Limitations: environment complexity bounded by base-model scale, human-designed optimizer (GRPO) not self-modified, no formal optimality of the curriculum, fixed-task evaluation rather than open-ended growth
Appendix F.3: training and evaluation code, configuration files for every run, evaluation output JSONs, and figure scripts are released; full hyperparameters in Table 5 and prompts in Appendix F.1

Section 8 / Figure 13: average gain grows with model size (+5.2 at 4B, +5.7 at 8B, +8.1 at 30B-A3B) while Fixed-env GRPO stays near +1.2; Appendix G Figure 16 shows Nemotron-30B gains only on Reasoning-Gym
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM/agent research: a single LLM both designs executable training environments and learns from them via GRPO, directly matching the highest-weight preferences (LLMs, agents & tool use, reasoning, RL, training optimization). Novelty is meaningful but incremental in a crowded self-play/environment-synthesis space: hint-based regret extends PAIRED's minimax regret, corpus grounding extends SPICE, role-conditioned self-play extends SPIRAL; the claim of being the first RL-trained designer producing full multi-turn MDP environments is credible but the delta over EvoEnv, TTCS, and GenEnv is arguable. Rigor is strong: three backbones (4B/8B/30B-A3B), retrained fixed-environment baselines from the same base checkpoints (Table 1), component-controlled ablations (Table 3: w/o corpus 53.5, w/o memory 53.2, w/o ED training+memory 40.5, GPT-5.5 static pool 53.0 vs full 58.3), a reward ablation isolating hint-regret (58.3) from EMA learning potential (55.9) (Section 7.2, Table 6), curriculum-diversity and scaling analyses, a calibrated Vendi diversity metric with dual-embedding replication, and an equilibrium analysis under explicitly stated idealized assumptions (Appendix E). Evidence weaknesses: tool-use comparisons in Table 2 are transcribed from other papers with differing budgets/protocols (acknowledged in Appendix F.3.1), best-checkpoint selection per variant risks optimistic selection, and the cross-family check (Nemotron) evaluates only Reasoning-Gym (Figure 16). Reproducibility is excellent: code, per-run configs, evaluation JSONs, and figure scripts released, with full prompts and hyperparameters (Appendices F.1-F.3).

primary_link.title: SPADE: Self-Play in Adaptive Synthetic Executable Environments

top5.summary: Continuous self-improvement requires an ever-expanding pool of self-generated, diverse, adaptive goals. For language agents, existing training environment pools (hand-curated, statically synthesized, or frozen-verifier) keep the goal distribution fixed as the learner scales. We introduce SPADE (Self-Play in Adaptive Synthetic Executable Environments), a self-play RL framework in which a single LLM plays two roles: an Environment Designer that writes complete, long-horizon training environments a
top5.summary_zh: 本論文指出，隨著高品質人類文字趨於枯竭，具有可驗證獎勵的訓練環境供給已成為代理式AI進步的瓶頸；人工策劃或靜態合成的環境池無法隨學習者能力提升而調整。作者提出SPADE自我對弈強化學習框架：單一LLM扮演兩個角色——環境設計師撰寫具Gym風格reset()/step()介面、含狀態轉移與獎勵函數的完整可執行Python環境並附特權提示；推理代理則在環境中學習行動。環境設計師以「提示式遺憾」為獎勵，即代理有無提示時的回報差距，將環境鎖定於能力前緣且可解的範圍，實作PAIRED式minimax遺憾而無需對抗者。方法另依賴預訓練語料錨定（DCLM、MegaScience、Nemotron程式碼語料）提供新穎性來源，並以環境記憶避免重複已掌握的任務。實驗涵蓋遊戲與工具使用兩種設定，在Qwen3-4B/8B/30B-A3B上訓練：遊戲設定下30B模型於AIME、GPQA-Diamond、LiveCodeBench-v6及Reasoning-Gym等八項留出基準平均較基礎模型提升8.1分，較最強固定環境基線提升5.3分，且優勢隨規模擴大；工具使用設定於BFCL v4多輪提升5.7分、ACEBench-Agent提升13.9分。消融顯示移除環境設計師訓練與記憶會使表現低於基礎模型，移除語料錨定則令環境多樣性崩塌（Vendi分數由0.68降至0.04）。限制包括環境複雜度受限於基礎模型能力、學習規則仍為人工設計的GRPO，且缺乏課程最佳性的形式化證明。此研究將環境設計轉為可學習組件，是邁向開放式持續自我改進的具體一步。
top5.title: SPADE: Self-Play in Adaptive Synthetic Executable Environments
top5.title_zh: SPADE：自適應合成可執行環境中的自我對弈

links.title: SkillGate: Training In-Policy Skill Selection in Long-Horizon Agents

evidence: Abstract: SkillGate lifts a 9B policy from 40.8% to 53.2% trial success on five agentic benchmarks under a 16-candidate slate, vs. identical budget on outcome reward alone (47.0%).

Section 4.1 (Implementation Details): all trained rows start from the same Qwen3.5-9B SFT checkpoint; RL runs 100 steps of on-policy GRPO on 491 training tasks with 8 rollouts per prompt; each configuration is a single run, with task-level bootstrap for uncertainty.

Section 4.6 / Figure 5: offline audit of SkillRL (outcome only)'s 12,800 on-policy trajectories shows skill-naming tokens carry a median 0.14% loss-weight share, diluting ~7x with length, with ~two in five oracle reads receiving negative advantage.

Appendix E: pooled trial-success improvement of +7.9 pp for SkillGate over SkillRL (outcome only) with 95% interval [+2.1,+14.3] excluding zero; pooled task pass@4 interval [-1.4,+15.7] crosses zero and significance is not claimed.
Section 6 (Conclusion): stated limitations—each configuration is a single run, the method needs training tasks whose correct skill is known, and an action-local scheme cannot credit an abstention.
Appendix C (Table 5): on 147 held-out Claw tasks, SkillGate reaches 61.2% pass@1 vs. 57.8% for SkillRL (outcome only), with oracle reads 79.6% and misleading reads 15.0%.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-preference: an LLM-agent RL method (agents/tool-use 2.5, LLM 2.5, RL/training) that trains in-policy skill selection inside GRPO. The core contribution—diagnosing 'selector credit starvation' via an offline audit of a real run's 12,800 trajectories, then partitioning token supports into disjoint outcome and action-local selector credit channels—is a clean, well-motivated refinement of existing turn-level credit-assignment work rather than a conceptual breakthrough. Rigor is solid: controlled comparison against outcome-only RL sharing init/data/steps/hyperparameters, five credit-placement ablations, external-router study, held-out 147-task generalization set, and raw counts (Table 4). Evidence is moderate: +7.9 pp pooled improvement with CI [+2.1,+14.3] excluding zero, but each configuration is a single run, per-benchmark intervals cross zero, pass@4 is not significant, and frontier rows are uncontrolled references. Generalizability is limited by the need for training tasks with a known, verified oracle skill, a fixed read-call interface, and the method's inability to credit abstention (acknowledged in the Conclusion). Reproducibility is aided by released code/models, hyperparameters, and prompt appendix, but several benchmarks (Claw-Eval, SkillsBench, SETA) have unclear public availability.

primary_link.title: SkillGate: Training In-Policy Skill Selection in Long-Horizon Agents

top5.summary: Agent frameworks increasingly package procedural knowledge as skills: instruction files an agent reads on demand, while public libraries now hold thousands of them. Which skill to read has thus become a decision the policy itself makes in the middle of an episode, yet no existing signal trains it. We show that the default remedy, outcome-rewarded RL over the candidate slate, cannot teach it, for a structural reason we identify and name selector credit starvation: under a broadcast, sequence-leve
top5.summary_zh: 代理框架將程序性知識封裝為技能檔案,公共技能庫已達數千筆,任務中途「讀哪個技能」成為策略自身的關鍵決策。本文指出僅靠結果報酬的 RL 教不會此決策,並審計 12,800 條實際訓練軌跡證實「選擇器信用飢餓」:在序列層級的廣播式優勢下,命名技能的少數 token 損失比重極小(中位數 0.14%,隨軌跡變長稀釋約七倍),且後續執行失敗時,正確選擇反被負優勢懲罰,最長軌跡上受罰比例甚至過半;但此決策本身價值達 11.2 個百分點的任務成功率。SkillGate 將單一策略的 token 支援分割為兩個互斥的信用通道:任務通道沿用 GRPO 群組正規化結果優勢,但整段讀取呼叫自遮罩移除;選擇器通道對技能名稱 token 施加動作局部優勢,僅當軌跡只讀一次且讀對 oracle(正確技能)才給正分,並以長度不變的權重重標定,使選擇決策的權重不受軌跡長度影響。在五個代理基準、每題 16 個候選技能的設定下,SkillGate 將 9B 模型整體成功率由 40.8% 提升至 53.2%,超過相同預算下僅用結果報酬的 47.0%,也勝過監督式選擇、偏好學習、外部路由器與 27B 參考模型;誤導技能暴露降低約三分之二,讀取次數反而更少,顯示增益來自選得更準而非讀得更多。限制包括:各設定僅單次訓練、需要已知正確技能的訓練任務、動作局部設計無法給「不讀取」的節制行為信用。本研究顯示,當一條軌跡交錯著性質不同的決策時,分割 token 支援是比重分配單一廣播優勢更便宜且可驗證的替代方案,技能選擇是必須直接訓練的獨立能力,而非模型規模自然湧現的副產品。
top5.title: SkillGate: Training In-Policy Skill Selection in Long-Horizon Agents
top5.title_zh: SkillGate:在長程代理中訓練策略內的技能選擇

links.title: FM-Bench: A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Management with Competing Agents

evidence: §4.1 'Models and harness': roster of 15 flagship LLMs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, xAI, Meta plus open-weight deepseek-v4-pro, kimi-k2.6, qwen3.7-max, glm-5.2, minimax-m3) under a fixed harness with locked model ID, temperature, and prompt, reasoning-on

Table 2 (§4.2): calibration ladder over three seeds — oracle 95.54±4.68, claude-fable-5 90.94±5.20, down to heuristic 17.05, idle −0.90, random −17.21 — separating models from blind scripted baselines

§4.2.1: behavioral decomposition with per-seed Spearman signs (endgame awareness −0.58, credit assignment −0.50, proactive control +0.45) and a compute null (r_s=−0.19, p=0.50, n=15 across a 28M–194M token range)

§3.2 Memory Design: notebook as the only cross-stop agent-written state, making memory curation a measured capability; Appendix 15 quantifies regimes via TF–IDF similarity (0.91 append-only vs 0.20 churn)
§6 Limitations: three seeds bound the solo board, the Arena is one shared seed-7 world with no error bars, construct validity beyond this domain untested, behavioral metrics correlational

§7 Reproducibility: deterministic counter-based RNG, 284-test suite, result files stamped with engine commit/params hash/score version, bit-replayable runs, code at github.com/Analogy-AI/fm-bench, 20-year anchor runs in 76 s single-core

Appendix 14: propositions with proofs for score properties (no fire-to-cap arbitrage, channel monotonicity, fair-price transfer neutrality, diminishing returns), plus a loose ≈145 upper bound showing non-saturation
Appendix 15: failed metrics (warning exposure, youth harvest, tactic reversals) kept in the record with per-seed sign instability documented, and a token-file erratum disclosed
llm_evaluation.rationale: A well-executed LLM-agent benchmark squarely on-preference: tool-use agents (26-tool interface), long-horizon evaluation, agent memory curation, and model comparison across 15 frontier LLMs. Novelty rests on combining a ~340-400-stop horizon with a counter-adaptive, competing-agent Arena on one deterministic engine with mechanism-based (not LLM-judged) scoring; the behavioral decomposition into six measurable capabilities is a genuine contribution beyond outcome leaderboards. Rigor is strong: calibrated anchor ladder (oracle/heuristic/idle/random), proven score properties (Appendix 14), replay-gated metric mining, per-seed correlation signs, and honestly disclosed failed metrics and a token-file erratum. Evidence is extensive but partly limited by n=15 correlational claims, a single-seed Arena with no error bars, and a 6-person human study the authors themselves mark as non-evidentiary for rankings; construct validity beyond football management is explicitly untested, capping generalizability. Reproducibility is excellent (deterministic seeded engine, 284-test suite, stamped result files, bit-replayable logs, public repo).

primary_link.title: FM-Bench: A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Management with Competing Agents

top5.summary: Language model agents now execute bounded tasks reliably. Whether they can sustain effective decision-making over long horizons, where actions have cumulative consequences and the environment responds to their choices, remains largely unmeasured. FM-Bench (Football Management Benchmark) measures this. An LLM agent runs a football club for 20 in-game years through 26 tools and roughly 340 to 400 decision stops. It drafts a squad on the same budget as every rival, trades players, negotiates contra
top5.summary_zh: FM-Bench 探討的問題是：語言模型代理能否在漫長時間尺度上、面對會反應其行為的競爭對手時，持續做出有效的管理決策，而非僅完成有界任務。方法是讓 LLM 代理經營一支足球俱樂部 20 個遊戲年，透過 26 個工具與約 340 至 400 個決策停點進行選秀、球員交易、合約談判、設施與青訓投資、陣容安排，並接受可解僱它的董事會監督；評分由確定性引擎逐季累計，全程不含 LLM 評審或人為評分。評測包含兩種軌道：單人軌道讓 15 個前沿模型對抗凍結的腳本世界；競技場模式則將 15 個模型與腳本錨點置於同一共享世界，屬首次此規模的正面對決。結果顯示所有模型皆能完成全程，而盲測腳本錨點在多數執行中提早出局；claude-fable-5 在兩軌道奪冠，達到特權 oracle 約 95% 的水準；競技場中聯賽冠軍在十個模型間輪替，且規模、價格與供應商皆無法預測排名。行為分解指出終局意識、現金運用與提前續約最關聯分數，token 花費則無關；模型也學不會隱藏的市場價格，筆記記憶呈現只增不刪或整段改寫兩種相反失敗。限制為種子數有限、競技場僅單一世界、行為指標屬相關性而非因果證據。此研究證明基準能有效區分模型的管理能力且尚未飽和，並為人機協作與行為級評測指出未來方向。
top5.title: FM-Bench: A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Management with Competing Agents

links.title: Compress and Forget: bitsandbytes Quantization Amplifies Proactive Interference in LLMs

evidence: Abstract: INT4 reduces accuracy under high interference in every model (81.0% -> 68.3% for Qwen), McNemar p<=2.6e-6; INT8 carries a smaller real penalty in two of three models.
Section 3.3 / Appendix C: paired design with identical trial sequences across precisions, verified zero mismatches across 23,075 unique trials; 69,225 total trials over 5 seeds (Table 9).
Table 2 / Section 4.2: FP16 vs INT4 at key levels (OR 2.58-20.00, p<=2.6e-6), direction consistent in 15/15 seed-comparisons; Mantel-Haenszel pooled OR 1.40, 95% CI [1.23,1.59].
Table 5 / Section 4.4: mixed-effects INT4 x log2(level) interaction beta=-0.046 (p=5.7e-8) for word-type vs +0.053 (p<1e-16) for numeric; robust to random slopes (beta=-0.048, Appendix E).
Section 4.5 / Appendix E: numeric control reverses sign; token-length stratification holds in dominant 3-token stratum (OR 0.92, p=0.021), ruling out tokenization confound.
Section 4.6: same-key intrusions are 99.8-99.9% of errors; intrusion rate rises 21.5% -> 24.6% of trials under INT4 (p=4.8e-7) with comparable recency (13.8 vs 13.2).
Section 4.7 / Table 6 / Appendix F: lm_head ablation shows backbone-driven effect (all p=1.0, lm_head share <=2.5%); honestly documents that default INT4 left lm_head at full precision.
Section 6: limitations acknowledged - bitsandbytes-only (no GPTQ/AWQ/EXL2/HQQ), short prompts, 3.8-7B models only, greedy decoding, no internal-representation test.

Section 4.3 / Table 11 / Appendix E: IES corroborates monotonic FP16>=INT8>=INT4 but dilutes Qwen's cliff (1.8% IES loss); Phi numeric IES shows a -3.98% reversal treated as null; IES pooling convention flagged as unverified.
Abstract / Appendix B: code and tokenizer-verified vocabulary construction released on GitHub; full loading configuration on a single RTX 3090 documented for reproducibility.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM behavioral evaluation: connects post-training quantization (bitsandbytes INT8/NF4) to proactive interference in three instruction-tuned LLMs (Section 3.2). The PTQ x PI intersection is genuinely untested per the related-work survey (Section 2), and the opposite-signed semantic-vs-numeric specificity (Table 5: INT4 x log-level beta=-0.046 word-type vs +0.053 numeric) is a real conceptual contribution beyond aggregate benchmarking. Rigor is unusually strong for a small-scale study: trial-level paired design verified with zero mismatches across 23,075 trials (Section 3.3, Appendix C), McNemar's exact test as primary with Fisher/Mantel-Haenszel cross-checks (Table 2), mixed-effects regression over all levels with random intercepts and a random-slopes robustness check (Table 5, Appendix E), token-length stratification ruling out a tokenization confound (Section 4.5), and an lm_head localization ablation (Table 6, all p=1.0). Mechanistic evidence via same-key intrusion rates (21.5%->24.6%, p=4.8e-7, Section 4.6) directly supports the proposed account. Honesty is high: Phi's non-monotonic k=16 cell is reported (Table 10), IES is shown to dilute Qwen's cliff (Section 4.3), the numeric IES pattern only 'partially corroborates' specificity, and an unverified IES pooling detail is flagged (Appendix E). Main deductions: narrow scope (3 models of 3.8-7B, one quantizer family, greedy decoding, short prompts, no representational-level probing, acknowledged in Section 6), mixed corroboration for specificity via IES (Table 11: Phi numeric INT4 nominally outperforms FP16), and the ablation's pairing not re-verified with the exhaustive check (Section 4.7). Code, configs, seeds, trial budgets, and trial-level results are released (Abstract, Appendices B-C), supporting strong reproducibility on a single consumer GPU.

primary_link.title: Compress and Forget: bitsandbytes Quantization Amplifies Proactive Interference in LLMs

top5.summary: Proactive interference (PI) is a documented failure mode in large language models in which retrieval of a repeatedly overwritten value degrades as prior overwrites accumulate, mirroring a classical phenomenon in human working memory. Post-training quantization (PTQ) is now the default deployment path for open-weight models, yet its effect on this failure mode has not been tested. We evaluate three precision levels (FP16, INT8, INT4/NF4, via bitsandbytes) across three architecturally distinct ins
top5.summary_zh: 訓練後量化已是部署開源 LLM 的預設路徑,但既有評估多依賴整體基準,未能檢視特定行為失效模式。本文探討量化對「主動干擾」的影響:當脈絡中同一屬性被反覆覆寫,模型擷取最新值的能力會隨覆寫次數對數線性下降。作者於 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 與 Phi-3.5-mini-instruct 上,以 bitsandbytes 分別載入 FP16、INT8 與 INT4/NF4,固定 PI-LLM 鍵值重綁任務,對語意類屬性與數值對照屬性進行比較,並以逐試次配對的 McNemar 檢定與混合效應迴歸驗證。結果顯示 INT4 在高干擾下於三個模型均顯著降低準確率(Qwen 由 81.0% 降至 68.3%),INT8 在其中兩個模型也有較小但真實的損失;效果僅出現於語意相似的干擾物,在數值對照下方向相反,並伴隨同鍵侵入錯誤率上升(21.5%→24.6%);消融實驗進一步指出效應源於量化後的 Transformer 主幹,而非 lm_head 輸出層。限制在於僅涵蓋 bitsandbytes 的 LLM.int8/NF4、提示長度偏短、未測試激活與 KV 快取量化。整體準確率差異僅 1-2 個百分點,凸顯總體指標會掩蓋對長期、可更新、語意稠密應用(如多輪助手與偏好追蹤)至關重要的行為性風險。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology work: counterfactual decomposition of wrong-consensus agreement in GPT-4.1 self-consistency on GPQA/AIME, squarely in scope (LLMs, reasoning/CoT, uncertainty/evaluation). Novelty is moderate: the algebra descends from ensemble bias-variance-covariance decompositions (acknowledged in Sec. 2), with the LLM-specific leave-one-out leak-free per-case-preference null as the genuinely new instantiation; it proposes no new method. Rigor is high for a descriptive study: difficulty-matched nulls, held-out test runs, case-clustered bootstrap CIs, permutation test honestly framed as an ordering claim at n=4 cells (Sec. 5.1), plus shrinkage, tie-break, pooled-p and Dirichlet-multinomial sensitivity analyses. Evidence is strong internally but scoped: claims are descriptive 'benchmark-associated direction' statements, correctly not overclaimed. Generalizability is limited—one model family in the main text, a small underpowered Qwen arm (App. B, n=70, no CIs), unrecorded sampling parameters, and confounded difficulty vs answer-space openness (Sec. 5.1, Sec. 6). Reproducibility is well supported: public per-run parquet data, committed scripts/evidence JSONs with regeneration commands, fixed seeds and reported Monte Carlo SEs (Statements, Sec. 3.1, App. C).

top5.summary: Majority voting over multiple LLM samples is widely used to raise answer accuracy, yet its gain varies erratically: on hard questions it can even backfire. This paper gives a quantitative account of this failure. top5.summary_zh: 以多次取樣後取多數決投票提升 LLM 準確率是自我一致性的標準做法,但在困難題目上甚至可能適得其反。本文首次以反事實分解量化「錯誤共識」下樣本間的凝聚程度:定義一致性指標 Γ(錯誤運行中樣本同意多數答案的期望比例,經參考尺度標準化),並拆解為「機械覆蓋率」φ——以留一法從其他運行估計逐題偏好、建構防洩漏的 i.i.d. 參照——以及偏好無法解釋的殘差。作者基於公開的逐運行資料,對 GPT-4.1 系列在 GPQA-Diamond(四選一)與 AIME(開放域)共八個組合重新分析。結果呈現與基準相關的方向性:GPQA 上逐題偏好即可解釋約 81-93% 的一致性,顯示「共享偏誤主導」之說在此過度宣稱;AIME 上機械偏好僅解釋 59-78%,殘存 1.56-2.80 個 Γ 單位的殘差,且可被允許運行層級偏好異質性的 Dirichlet-multinomial 校準參照完整吸收。論文亦重現困難題上的反噬現象(最難分組投票落差 -0.09),高一致性分組的經驗準確率僅 0.42-0.83(相對基率有 1.2-3.6 倍提升),冠軍答案跨條件翻轉率則達 0.40(GPQA)與 0.82(AIME);軟性加權聚合(AUROC 約 0.77)並未優於硬性多數決。限制包括 i.i.d. 假設未處理溫度取樣相關、主要結論限於 GPT-4.1 家族、Qwen 對照規模過小。其意義在於:高一致性是具等級的證據而非正確性保證,可指導不確定性估計的設計。
